Job Summary:

Are you a Software Engineer interested in joining our core R&D group to develop and enhance our proprietary rendering software (Glimpse); including our state-of-the-art rendering engine, shading system, and scene representation? If the answer is yes, then read on!

For more information on Glimpse

What You’ll Do:

  • Work on all aspects of the renderer, including scene representation, render and sampling engine, raytracer, shading system: everything required for generating highly realistic images for our films.

  • Create and maintain tools that are directly used in our lighting, shading, and compositing workflows.

  • Closely collaborate with technically minded artists to design, implement and rapidly deploy into production.

  • Be part of a small, dynamic and self-motivated team of individuals with varied backgrounds.

  • Take on responsibility, get stuff done, and make our artists happy!

  • Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open-mindedness.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years’ experience developing 3D rendering software using C++ in high performance computing environments.

  • Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Have a background in film, animation, television, visualization, games, or come fresh out of academia with a strong focus on computer graphics.

  • Strong mathematical skills and familiarity with numerical methods, probability and statistics used for rendering such as Monte Carlo integration and importance sampling

  • A talent and passion for optimisation and a working knowledge of efficient spatial data structures.

  • A thorough understanding of photorealistic rendering, light transport and global illumination techniques.

  • A passion for algorithms, optimization, and data structures.

  • Working knowledge of shading technologies such as RSL, OSL, GLSL

  • An ability to work in a challenging environment, take direction and possess good communication skills.

  • Willingness to work in a highly dynamic production environment and collaborate with artistic staff.

  • Real-time rendering experience.

  • Exposure to raytracing and shading technologies such as Embree and OIIO/OpenPGL/RSL/OSL/GLSL.

  • Experience with developing shading or raytracing algorithms on massively parallel architectures such as multi-threaded CPUs and GPUs.

  • Practice in writing high performance code, vectorized code, with a good understanding of parallel programming, compilers and optimization.

  • Familiarity with DCC applications such as Houdini and Maya, including their APIs.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and e-social communication skills.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Developer Platform Teams

The Infrastructure Engineering Organization at Netflix has teams focusing on a number of different areas including: modernization, resilience & reliability tooling, internal application interface development, improving the technical health of systems, and collecting and reporting on the metrics that help Netflix quantify and improve developer productivity.


At the moment we are hiring for following teams:

1. Engineering Operations Tooling area

We are currently expanding following teams in this space:


Availability Tooling

This group builds and owns the tooling that keeps Netflix's Infrastructure Engineering running smoothly, spanning fleet-wide change automation and availability tooling. On the availability side, we invest in cloud fleet monitoring and fleet-wide service dependency graph generation to ensure high availability and resiliency, alongside systems for deploying and monitoring changes at scale.

Knowledge Platform

The Knowledge Platform — born from the merger of our Discovery & Learning (technical documentation) and Support Solutions (developer assistance) initiatives — is how Netflix engineers find answers, whether by reading great documentation or by asking a question and getting an immediate, accurate response. We're reimagining both spaces with cutting-edge GenAI: platforms for hosting and generating technical docum1. entation, and support solutions that deliver fast, high-quality, GenAI-powered responses to developers at scale.



2. Health Integrity of the Paved Road (HIPR)


The Health Integrity of the Paved Road (HIPR) team is (another) one of three pillars in Netflix's System Health, Validation & Insights Platform group. The Paved Road empowers Netflix engineers with the tools and context they need to make well-informed, responsible decisions in pursuit of Netflix’s mission to Entertain the World while maximizing our engineering leverage and scale. The HIPR team's mission is to enable Netflix engineers go (and stay) on the Paved Road effortlessly.

We do that by:

  • Defining what healthy looks like through health primitives, measuring it it, and surfacing it to the right teams at the right time
  • Injecting those primitives as a context ready to be consumed both by humans and agents at the points of code generation and decision making
  • Making sure the road is continuously being repaved, closing a continuous improvement loop


3. Change Systems


The Change Systems team builds and owns the platform infrastructure that powers large-scale change automation across Netflix's engineering organization. We own the systems and tooling that enable rapid, safe deployments and code transformations at enterprise scale, spanning from fleet-wide orchestration to agentic-driven change execution.Our mission is to make change at scale seamless and safe by:

  • Developing composable, extensible platforms where both humans and AI agents are first-class consumers, with robust APIs for provisioning, executing, and debugging changes
  • Building the dependency graph and service catalog systems that give engineers complete visibility into the blast radius and impact of their changes
  • Creating the operational backbone for large-scale code migrations, modernization campaigns, and fleet-wide updates with built-in safety guards and rollback capabilities
  • Enabling GenAI-powered code transformation and agentic tooling to work safely and effectively at Netflix scale, reducing friction and accelerating development velocity

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Software Engineers who are passionate about writing software that will help other engineers write software. The ideal candidate will have a strong generalist background, having built complex applications in Java or other programming languages. This role requires demonstrated experience scaling services and applications to serve hundreds of users and thousands of requests per minute. Engineers in this job will interact with customers and product managers to ensure that the team is delivering the tools and features needed by Netflix. Writing design documents, driving changes across teams and organizations, and ensuring the reliability and success of productivity tools is a significant part of this role. The tools and services delivered by engineers in this role will span multiple parts of the stack (from persistence and data layers through business logic and service APIs to front-end user UX) so familiarity with each of those areas is required, though focus, experience, and expertise may be concentrated on one layer.

  • Software Development: Write software that assists other engineers in their software development processes.

  • Service Scaling: Scale services and applications to efficiently handle hundreds of users and thousands of requests per minute.

  • Design Documentation: Write design documents and drive changes across teams and organizations.
  • Tool Reliability: Ensure the reliability and success of productivity tools.

  • Data Modelling & Analysis: Choose storage solutions and design data models for relation and non-relational datasets. Write queries and reports to power analytics and dashboards for customer teams and organizations.

Who You Are

  • A skilled software engineer with experience in developer platform or productivity team proficient in back-end development (preferably in Java or Python)
  • A meticulous software designer who researches and documents technical tradeoffs clearly and concisely.
  • Able to manage projects independently from design to production.
  • Able to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A developer who is passionate about writing tests for their code and has demonstrable experience solving difficult testing and reliability challenges in complex domains.
  • A problem-solver who can leverage data to make quantitative decisions and seeks out creative approaches in order to derive useful signals from noisy systems.
  • An effective collaborator who can work closely with customer teams and partner teams to create tailored strategies to execute software change campaigns effectively.
  • A passionate advocate for developer productivity using tooling investments for better discovery, learning and support

  • Familiarity with managing applications in AWS and familiarity with the core AWS service and feature ecosystems (EC2, S3, etc.)

Job Summary:

The Pre-Production Technical Director is responsible for supporting creative and visual objectives through pipeline troubleshooting, user support, technical direction, and tool development for front-end craft groups, including Story, Edit, Art, Concept, Design, Visual Development, and Previs. As a technical expert, the Pre-Production Technical Director exhibits a deep understanding of processes, technology, and tools within these domains. They contribute technical expertise to the design and development of artist workflows and tools, ensuring that the pre-production process is efficient and integrated with the overall production pipeline. 

What You’ll Do:

Technical Responsibilities: 

  • Understand the visual requirements for productions and suggest new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools to meet these requirements. 

  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for all technology within the Pre-Production department. 

  • Contribute to the direction, evolution, and maintenance of the technology within the Pre-Production Department. 

  • Design, develop, and write well-maintainable and consistently high-quality code. 

  • Track and resolve the most complex technical issues within Pre-Production in partnership with other TDs and Software Engineers. 

  • Work closely with other TDs and Software Engineers within Pre-Production to drive the technical success of key development initiatives. 

  • Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures within the Pre-Production Craft Group support the creative process. 

  • Provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools. 

  • Take responsibility for the troubleshooting and optimization of Pre-Production tools, software, and workflows. 

  • Actively drive the QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes, ensuring artist workflow is not impacted. 

  • Understand the processes of adjoining departments and provide input where required to maximize pipeline efficiency and quality. 

  • Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline. 

  • Support the organization’s overall technical goals as required.

Bidding & Scheduling Responsibilities: 

  • Be aware of the deadlines for own development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track. 

  • Continuously monitor the scope of the most technically challenging development initiatives within the Pre-Production department and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc. 

  • Prioritize and break down technical projects into organized parts. 

  • Work with the Supervising TD to prepare estimates and pitches as required.

Talent & Performance Management Responsibilities: 

  • Work with the Supervising TD for Front-End to provide technical guidance to Pre-Production TDs with day-to-day issues and escalate through the right channels when necessary. 

  • Work with Technology Talent Management and Supervising TDs to help further develop the skills and abilities of mid-level TDs within the Front End Craft Group. 

  • Mentor mid-level TDs within the team and assist in orientation with senior new starters. 

  • Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things.

Communication Collaboration & Relationship Development Responsibilities: 

  • Strong communication skills for technical ideas, project status, problems, requirements, rollout plans, etc. 

  • Able to communicate with Program Managers to contribute to the scheduling and planning of complex technology initiatives. 

  • Able to discuss complex issues with Senior Software Engineers, developers, and supervisors. 

  • Able to present to small teams (tool demos, Show Contract process, Support Dashboards, etc.). 

  • Good written communication skills for specs, tickets, status updates, etc.

Behaviours: 

  • Takes a collaborative approach, always working towards team goals and success.

  • Is artist-focused, passionate about improving the artist experience and workflow.

  • Acts as a proactive contributor, eager to learn and help the team succeed.

  • Stays supportive and approachable, fostering a friendly and open environment.

  • Is detail-oriented, ensuring high standards in all work.

  • Remains trustworthy and reliable in all responsibilities. 

What You’ll Need:

  • Relevant education in software engineering and/or film creation process.

  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, games and/or VFX feature films.

  • Proven technical achievements within feature animation or VFX.

  • An understanding of traditional techniques appropriate to the Pre-Production craft group. 

  • Comprehensive experience using and troubleshooting in relevant software such as Maya, Flix, Avid, Storyboard Pro, Premiere, Photoshop, and other related software used in the Pre-Production domain. 

  • Comprehensive understanding of technical details within the Pre-Production department. 

  • Ability to code review and troubleshoot problems as they arise. 

  • Expert knowledge in Python as well as PyQt or another GUI toolkit. 

  • Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval. 

  • Solid understanding of C++ is a plus. A strong understanding of USD and its general concepts. 

  • Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid). 

  • Knowledge of code management software such as git and GitHub and code review processes. 

  • Knowledge of software development practices such as Agile and how to apply them in software such as Jira. 

  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math, or Physics, or equivalent combination of education and work experience in animation/VFX.

Microsoft Silicon Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Skype, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.  

Our team is creative and resourceful; we value growth and learning. We want to amplify your abilities so you can do your best work. Join us, and together we will turn groundbreaking hardware designs into reality!  

Microsoft's Silicon Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering organization is seeking a Lead Negotiator, EDA Tools & Strategy to own the commercial strategy, negotiation, and lifecycle governance of Microsoft's Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and silicon engineering technology portfolio. 

This role is the single point of accountability for how Microsoft acquires, deploys, and optimizes EDA tools across a global custom silicon organization. You will lead enterprise negotiations and renewals with the semiconductor industry's largest EDA and IP suppliers, shape the multi-year tooling strategy in partnership with CAD and silicon design leadership, and establish the licensing, consumption analytics, and supplier governance frameworks that turn a multi-hundred-million-dollar tooling portfolio into measurable engineering leverage. You will operate across Engineering, Finance, Procurement, and Legal, influence executive stakeholders without direct authority, and translate deep technical requirements into commercial terms that scale with Microsoft's long-term silicon roadmap.  

#azurehwjobs   #SCHIE   #MILE 

 



Responsibilities

EDA Commercial Strategy & Negotiation Leadership 

  • Serve as Microsoft's lead negotiator for EDA, design IP, and silicon engineering technology agreements, owning deal strategy, negotiation planning, and term structures through executive approval and signature. 

  • Define the multi-year commercial strategy across the EDA supplier portfolio, including renewal sequencing, competitive leverage, bundling and unbundling decisions, and alternative sourcing options. 

  • Build negotiation business cases with modeled scenarios, total-cost-of-ownership analysis, benchmarking, and executive recommendations that balance engineering capability against cost and risk. 

  • Partner with Procurement and Legal to structure enterprise agreements, licensing constructs, and contract terms that scale with silicon program demand and protect Microsoft's long-term flexibility. 

  • Own post-signature contract governance including amendments, true-ups, entitlement compliance, audit readiness, and escalation management. 

 

EDA Portfolio, Licensing & Cost Optimization 

  • Own planning, forecasting, reporting, and financial governance for Microsoft's EDA and engineering tooling portfolio. 

  • Drive license optimization through consumption analytics, peak-demand modeling, license pooling strategies, and reallocation across silicon programs, phases, and geographies. 

  • Partner closely with Finance on budget, accrual, and forecast accuracy, and deliver quantified savings and cost-avoidance targets year over year. 

  • Establish demand management and chargeback models that create accountability for tool consumption across engineering teams. 

 

Supplier Relationship & Performance Governance 

  • Own executive-level relationships with EDA vendors. 

  • Define and operate supplier KPIs, SLAs, quarterly business reviews, roadmap reviews, and escalation frameworks. 

  • Hold suppliers accountable for support quality, roadmap commitments, and delivery against contracted outcomes, and drive continuous improvement plans where performance gaps exist. 

  • Represent Microsoft in supplier executive forums and industry engagements on EDA strategy and ecosystem direction. 

 

Technical Partnership with Silicon & CAD Engineering 

  • Partner with CAD, design, verification, and physical design teams to translate technical tool requirements into sourcing strategy and commercial outcomes. 

  • Build and maintain the multi-year EDA tool roadmap aligned to silicon program milestones, node transitions, and methodology changes. 

  • Evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI-assisted design, cloud and HPC burst compute, and new methodology flows, and drive adoption decisions with engineering leadership. 

  • Ensure tooling strategy is aligned with engineering compute capacity planning and Cloud/HPC infrastructure investments. 

 

Business Intelligence, Analytics & AI Enablement 

  • Own the analytics strategy for EDA dollar spend, license utilization, supplier performance, and portfolio health. 

  • Develop executive dashboards and KPI frameworks that convert tooling, contract, and consumption data into actionable decisions. 

  • Apply AI and automation to renewal readiness, entitlement tracking, contract intelligence, and consumption forecasting to increase speed and accuracy of commercial decision making. 

 

Executive Engagement & Cross-Functional Leadership 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to silicon engineering executives on tooling investment, supplier risk, and commercial strategy. 

  • Lead executive business reviews, negotiation readouts, and investment decision forums, simplifying complexity into clear recommendations. 

  • Build durable partnerships across Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Legal, IT, and external partners, driving outcomes without direct authority. 

  • Raise negotiation, supplier management, and commercial acumen across the broader silicon operations community through mentorship and reusable frameworks.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Microsoft’s cloud infrastructure, spanning site selection, development, and operations. Our global footprint includes more than 400 datacenters in 34 countries, supported by over 165,000 miles of fiber optic cable. These facilities form the backbone of Microsoft Azure and are central to our commitment to reliable, secure, and sustainable digital infrastructure. 
 
As part of the CO+I Cloud Infrastructure Acquisition team, you will join a team of real estate professionals responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and closing strategic land transactions. You will drive market entry and expansion strategies by partnering with legal, finance, energy, engineering, and community engagement teams to enable site readiness and optionality. This role requires strong deal-making expertise, the ability to navigate diverse regulatory and cultural environments, and the leadership skills to build trusted partnerships across internal and external stakeholders. This role requires an exceptional ability to manage complexity, build systems for accountability, and deliver results at scale. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and acquisition of strategic land parcels across AMERS to meet Microsoft’s cloud growth needs. 

  • Develop regional market strategies informed by business demand, competitive dynamics, and regulatory landscapes. 

  • Negotiate complex real estate transactions, ensuring alignment with Microsoft’s financial, legal, and operational requirements. 

  • Manage relationships with brokers, landowners, developers, and government authorities to accelerate deal execution. 

  • Partner with internal teams (engineering, energy, community affairs, legal, finance) to ensure acquired sites can be advanced to development on schedule. 

  • Establish and track portfolio-level metrics on deal velocity, pipeline health, and transaction risk. 

  • Drive due diligence processes, ensuring proactive identification and mitigation of legal, zoning, and entitlement risks. 

  • Represent Microsoft in market engagements, industry forums, and with government stakeholders to advance Microsoft’s position as a trusted, long-term partner. 

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing regional acquisition team, fostering collaboration and operational excellence. 



Qualifications
Required Qualification
  •  Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Real Estate, Project Management, or related field, AND 5+ years relevant experience OR 7+ years equivalent experience.
Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualification
  • Proven experience in site selection, market assessment, and location strategy
  • Expertise in navigating entitlement processes and mitigating regulatory risks
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders and partners
  • Background in industrial land acquisition, including Letter of Intent (LOI) and Purchase and Sale Agreement (PSA) negotiations
  • Experience negotiating utility, energy, and power infrastructure agreements
  • Skilled in managing escalations, resolving complex challenges, and driving successful deal outcomes

Overview

The Consumer eCommerce (CeC) organization is seeking a technically proficient, hands-on Platform Operations Manager to administer, operate, govern, and continuously improve a growing ecosystem of enterprise SaaS platforms supporting digital commerce, content management, marketing, customer engagement, analytics, and related internal business operations.

This role will serve as the primary business-side technical administrator and operational owner for assigned SaaS platforms, ensuring employees, vendors, and external partners have secure, compliant, reliable, and efficient access to the technologies required to deliver business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines practical, hands-on SaaS administration experience with expertise in identity and access management, platform configuration, security and privacy controls, operational excellence, vendor management, and cross-functional leadership.

As the organization modernizes its technology ecosystem, this individual will establish and execute standardized operating models, governance frameworks, administration practices, and lifecycle management processes that ensure enterprise SaaS platforms remain secure, scalable, compliant, reliable, and easy for internal customers to use.

The role requires someone comfortable working directly within platform administration consoles, configuring access and permissions, troubleshooting technical issues, supporting integrations, and implementing operational controls, while collaborating with Engineering, Security, Privacy, Product, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and external technology providers.



Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Day-to-Day Operations

  • Serve as the primary business-side technical administrator for assigned enterprise SaaS platforms, directly managing day-to-day platform administration, configuration, user access, and operational maintenance.

  • Configure and maintain platform settings, administrative roles, user permissions, security configurations, and supported integrations within established change-control boundaries.

  • Monitor platform availability, operational health, service performance, utilization, adoption, and vendor-reported incidents.

  • Troubleshoot platform configuration, authentication, authorization, provisioning, integration, and operational issues, resolving problems within administrative scope and escalating complex technical issues when necessary.

  • Execute approved platform configuration changes, releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities, including testing, impact validation, and post-change verification.

  • Maintain accurate platform inventories, configuration documentation, administrative procedures, operational runbooks, and knowledge resources.

  • Establish and maintain support models, incident response procedures, service-level expectations, escalation paths, and clear operational ownership.

  • Ensure consistent and reliable platform operations while identifying opportunities to reduce manual activities, increase automation, and improve service quality.

Identity, Access & RBAC Administration

  • Define, configure, and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models across supported SaaS platforms, including role hierarchies, permission boundaries, approval workflows, and separation-of-duties controls.

  • Directly administer user accounts, groups, permissions, roles, and access entitlements across assigned platforms.

  • Administer and govern employee, vendor, and external partner access to supported SaaS platforms, including appropriate authorization, time-bound access, periodic reviews, and timely deprovisioning.

  • Establish and execute standardized user provisioning, deprovisioning, access modifications, approval processes, and access lifecycle management.

  • Partner with identity engineering teams to configure, implement, and maintain SSO, Microsoft Entra ID integrations, SCIM provisioning, group-based access controls, and automated provisioning capabilities.

  • Investigate and resolve authentication, authorization, provisioning, and access-related issues.

  • Lead quarterly user access certification reviews, identifying and remediating excessive privileges, inactive accounts, stale entitlements, and unauthorized permissions.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation of access approvals, administrative changes, certification activities, and remediation actions.

  • Apply least-privilege principles and balance secure access controls with efficient internal user experiences.

Platform Governance & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Define, implement, and maintain a consistent operational governance framework across business-managed SaaS platforms within the digital commerce ecosystem.

  • Establish platform operating standards, policies, controls, decision rights, accountability models, and administrative practices across multiple vendors and technologies.

  • Develop and maintain platform-specific operating policies, administrative standards, and control procedures aligned with enterprise technology, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

  • Lead cross-functional platform operations initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Legal, Procurement, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors.

  • Establish and maintain operational governance forums, decision-making structures, escalation mechanisms, and recurring operating rhythms.

  • Define clear roles and responsibilities across business owners, platform administrators, Engineering teams, enterprise technology functions, and SaaS providers.

  • Drive operational readiness for new platform implementations, vendor onboarding, integrations, and major capability launches.

  • Maintain operational risk registers, mitigation plans, key decisions, action tracking, and escalation records, ensuring issues are addressed with clearly accountable owners.

  • Drive measurable improvements in platform governance maturity, operational consistency, security, reliability, and efficiency.

Security, Privacy & Compliance Operations

  • Partner with enterprise Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance organizations to ensure supported SaaS platforms meet applicable enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Implement and maintain approved platform security configurations, administrative safeguards, and operational controls aligned with enterprise policies.

  • Support security assessments, privacy reviews, risk assessments, audit activities, and compliance certifications.

  • Maintain accurate inventories and documentation of sensitive data, platform data flows, integrations, administrative access, and control ownership.

  • Monitor operational control effectiveness, identify gaps, and drive remediation activities with accountable teams and vendors.

  • Support evidence collection, documentation, and validation required for internal audits, compliance reviews, and security assessments.

  • Champion secure-by-design and privacy-by-design operational practices, including least-privilege access, appropriate separation of duties, and controlled administrative changes.

  • Balance enterprise security and governance requirements with platform usability, accessibility, and business productivity.

Platform Integrations, Change Management & Lifecycle Operations

  • Support the operational administration of platform integrations, connectors, authentication configurations, data exchange mechanisms, and related technical dependencies.

  • Work with Engineering, Data, Identity, and vendor teams to troubleshoot integration failures, connector errors, access-related issues, and configuration problems.

  • Maintain operational visibility into integration health, ownership, monitoring, dependencies, and escalation procedures.

  • Establish and execute standardized intake, prioritization, change-management, testing, deployment, and rollback processes for platform enhancements and operational requests.

  • Coordinate platform releases, configuration changes, integrations, incidents, maintenance windows, and operational readiness activities with internal teams and technology providers.

  • Support the technical and operational onboarding of new SaaS vendors, including administrative setup, access controls, identity integration, support arrangements, and operational handover.

  • Ensure new platforms and capabilities have documented administration models, access controls, configuration standards, support procedures, and operational handover before production adoption.

  • Maintain platform lifecycle documentation, including technical configurations, operational dependencies, change histories, and administration procedures.

  • Assess operational impacts and risks associated with technology upgrades, vendor changes, new integrations, and platform capability expansions.

Vendor, Licensing & Platform Portfolio Management

  • Serve as the operational lead for assigned business-managed SaaS platforms, coordinating vendor support, service performance, operational governance, and technical escalations.

  • Manage day-to-day operational interactions with SaaS vendors, including technical support cases, incident resolution, service commitments, and escalation management.

  • Coordinate vendor operational business reviews, governance discussions, service performance assessments, and renewal readiness activities.

  • Monitor software utilization, licensing allocations, administrative privileges, vendor service levels, and operational spend.

  • Identify and drive opportunities to optimize licensing, reduce unnecessary costs, improve software utilization, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Provide operational insights and recommendations to Product, Procurement, Finance, and technology leaders to support vendor evaluations, technology planning, and renewal decisions.

  • Conduct periodic assessments of platform capabilities, operational risks, service maturity, technology dependencies, and improvement opportunities across the SaaS portfolio.

  • Ensure consistent vendor accountability and operational standards across multiple SaaS providers and technologies.

Internal Customer Experience, Support & Enablement

  • Serve as a technical and operational point of contact for internal platform users, administrators, business teams, vendors, and partners.

  • Resolve user access, provisioning, permissions, configuration, and operational support requests within the defined support model.

  • Develop and maintain streamlined onboarding and offboarding experiences, user enablement resources, training materials, and self-service capabilities.

  • Establish clear support processes, response expectations, escalation channels, and knowledge-management practices.

  • Simplify operational processes for platform users and administrators to improve productivity and reduce unnecessary administrative effort.

  • Drive platform adoption, usage best practices, and internal customer satisfaction across supported platform communities.

  • Partner with business and Product teams to identify recurring user challenges, improve platform usability, and prioritize operational improvements.

  • Champion secure-by-design, accessible user experiences that balance business productivity with governance discipline.

Operational Excellence, Automation & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain consistent operational processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), administration standards, and service management practices across supported SaaS platforms.

  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate repetitive administrative activities, including user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, support workflows, monitoring, and operational reporting.

  • Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms for platform health, access compliance, utilization, adoption, incident resolution, service levels, governance effectiveness, and internal customer experience.

  • Measure governance effectiveness through access review completion, remediation closure, policy adherence, control exceptions, and operational accountability.

  • Develop executive-level dashboards and provide structured inputs into quarterly business reviews (QBRs), platform governance discussions, and leadership operating rhythms.

  • Track operational risks, mitigation plans, decisions, escalations, and improvement initiatives through resolution.

  • Monitor operational trends, recurring incidents, service performance, and control effectiveness to identify opportunities for optimization.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort, strengthen security and compliance, improve service reliability, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Drive consistent operational standards and measurable outcomes across the enterprise SaaS portfolio.



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS administration, platform operations, enterprise application operations, IT operations, identity management, or a related technical discipline, OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience administering enterprise SaaS applications, including platform configuration, user administration, permissions management, operational support, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

  • Practical knowledge of identity and access management concepts, including RBAC, SSO, user provisioning and deprovisioning, least-privilege access, and permission lifecycle management.

  • Experience troubleshooting platform configuration, authentication, authorization, integration, or operational issues in an enterprise technology environment.

  • Experience implementing or maintaining standardized operational procedures, platform controls, and technical documentation.

  • Experience collaborating with Engineering, Security, Privacy, Product, IT, or business stakeholder teams to maintain secure and reliable technology operations.

  • Analytical, technical problem-solving, organizational, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise SaaS platforms supporting digital commerce, marketing technology, customer engagement, content management, customer data, analytics, or related business operations.

  • Experience with technologies such as Adobe Commerce, Adobe Experience Manager, Product Information Management (PIM) systems, Customer Data Platforms (including Hightouch), marketing automation platforms (including Braze), analytics solutions, or customer service platforms.

  • Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft Entra ID, SAML/OIDC-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, group-based access controls, RBAC, separation-of-duties controls, and automated identity lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, platform connectors, integration monitoring, and SaaS troubleshooting.

  • Experience automating administrative workflows using scripting, platform APIs, identity tools, or workflow automation solutions.

  • Experience managing incidents, releases, configuration changes, operational readiness, and lifecycle processes across enterprise SaaS applications.

  • Experience implementing security and privacy controls, supporting access certifications, and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust principles, accessibility standards, and enterprise governance frameworks.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional technology or operational initiatives, establishing clear accountability, and delivering measurable outcomes.

  • Experience managing operational governance, vendor performance, and platform lifecycle activities across multiple enterprise SaaS providers simultaneously.

  • Experience optimizing SaaS utilization, licensing, vendor support processes, and operational spend.

  • Experience establishing platform operating models, administration procedures, service-level metrics, governance forums, executive reporting, and operating rhythms.

  • Experience developing operational dashboards, tracking KPIs, managing risks, and driving continuous improvement across enterprise platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize competing operational demands, resolve technical issues, and support multiple business-critical platforms in a complex enterprise environment.

We are looking for a Director, AI Business Process Leader - Microsoft US Federal to join our team. 

In this leadership position, you will guide and develop a team responsible for advancing customer success through Microsoft’s AI and cloud solutions. You will align the team with the organization’s vision, sales frameworks, and business priorities while helping them identify market opportunities, address challenges, and lead end-to-end customer transformation initiatives. The role partners closely with area and organizational leaders to manage pipelines, maintain accurate forecasts, and execute business strategy across core solution areas. You will also strengthen collaboration across teams, connect Microsoft solutions with customer and partner needs, and share market feedback that helps refine strategy and build trust. As a people manager, you will support employee growth and development, oversee project execution, and manage team performance.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.   



Responsibilities

Customer Engagement and Partnership

  • Serves as a customer and partner advocate within the subsidiary/area, offering feedback to solution area leaders to refine strategy and encourage continuous improvement to seize market opportunities and build trust. Advocates for a focus on customer success and supports the development of tailored strategies that meet their unique needs and goals.
  • Encourages the early engagement of strategic partners in the sales process to enhance customer adoption and facilitate value realization.
  • Participates in various rhythms of business (RoB) within the enterprise, taking into account both external (e.g., customer) and internal (e.g., sellers, internal teams) viewpoints.
  • Delivers insights and feedback to internal teams to improve go-to-market (GTM) strategies and execution. Guides team in identifying and aligning sales plays with market and customer needs.
  • Actively seeks to match solution scenarios with customer and partner organizations, focusing on how Microsoft's offerings can complement and add value to their business operations.
  • Acts as a trusted advisor to customers and partners, utilizing insights to foster marketplace success.
  • Engages in conversations with customers that highlight the strategic relationship between Microsoft, partners, and customers' business goals, thereby nurturing ongoing business partnerships.
  • Advocates for customer support resources through Unified Support that aid in accelerating business value realization and transformation.

People Management

  • Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Sales Operations and Pipeline Management

  • Facilitates cross-team collaboration to enhance operational excellence and support the execution of the business strategy. Works to simplify complexity within solution areas and contributes to the development of go-to-market (GTM) strategies for cross-solution plays that support business outcomes.
  • Coordinates the integration of solutions across the full technology stack, engaging stakeholders to demonstrate the business value proposition. Works with team to identify gaps and facilitate the creation of development plans that build technical sales acumen and capabilities across the team.
  • Guides team to utilize technology (e.g., automation, Power Platforms, Sales Agents) to foster business growth across solution areas and ensures the use of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered analytics and forecasting tools to enhance precision.
  • Encourages team to identify new revenue streams across the subsidiary and supports sales execution efforts to capitalize on market-specific opportunities and align with AI-enhanced sales methodologies and practices.
  •  Implements aspects of the enterprise sales strategy, adapting the corporate framework into practical plans within the local market context to enhance revenue and business growth. Manages and directs organizational resources and helps build a sales pipeline to gain market share and compete in key growth areas.
  • Helps identify opportunities for customers to use technology in ways that transform their business operations and accelerate growth.
  • Collaborates with area or organization leader to ensure an accurate forecast through pipeline management and a deal-based forecast in each of the core solution areas.
  • Monitors management of the sales pipeline and opportunities by reviewing overall pipeline progress to identify stalled deals and areas where guidance is needed.
  • Supports the active management of opportunities, helps address potential roadblocks, and provides input to ensure sales targets and business objectives are met.
  • Assists in the development and execution of sales strategy to optimize return on investments (ROI) and optimizes resources that drive impact across the solution area with operational vigor.

Sales Strategy and Execution

  • Guides and supports team in anticipating, identifying, and addressing threats and gaps in the market across all solution areas.
  • Leverages deep knowledge and interpretation of market trends and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven market intelligence tools to generate insights, influencing decisions that drive the organization forward.
  • Develops tailored business solutions that respond to customer demands and market signals and validates that proposals meet customers’ strategic needs.
  • Implements and oversees strategic sales plans for each solution area that respond to customer demands, industry needs, local regulations, and market trends to stimulate business growth and capture total addressable market (TAM) across the subsidiary.
  • Develops a pipeline of diverse talent that responds to the needs of the market and enhances the organization's ability to realize the total addressable market (TAM).
  • Guides team to lead end-to-end artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud-driven transformation initiatives for customers. Implements AI- and cloud-powered wins that both enhance customer business capabilities and demonstrate the transformative impact of cutting-edge AI technologies and cloud services Coaches team on how to differentiate Microsoft’s offerings from stakeholders by leveraging unique selling propositions to create advantage and capture market interest.
  • Encourages teams to pursue innovation and excel in achieving market impact with innovative solutions. Promotes innovation and agility through AI and cloud adoption, aligning solutions to customer priorities and business outcomes.
  • Manages and aligns team with the organization's vision and customer success objectives, ensuring adherence to sales frameworks and guidelines.
  • Leads conversations around leveraging innovative solutions, ensuring that these innovations create a noticeable impact on the market.
  • Promotes the integration of security principles in all customer engagements to uphold trust and compliance.
  • Encourages innovation and problem-solving within team to stay ahead in the technical sales landscape.

Ready to shape the future of AI? Join Azure Storage and help build the foundational platform powering the next generation of AI agents, frontier models, and intelligent cloud services.

Every breakthrough in AI depends on storage. From training the world's largest models to enabling autonomous AI agents that reason, plan, and act, Azure Storage provides the critical data foundation behind Microsoft's AI ecosystem. As AI workloads continue to grow exponentially, we are reimagining how storage systems operate at hyperscale, pushing the boundaries of performance, scalability, reliability, and intelligent automation.

Azure Storage is one of Microsoft’s largest and most critical cloud platforms, storing and protecting exabytes of customer data across regions worldwide. The platform provides a comprehensive storage portfolio, including Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen2 for object storage and analytics workloads, Azure Files for shared file storage, and Azure Disks and Elastic SAN for high-performance block storage. Azure Storage powers AI, analytics, cloud-native applications, enterprise workloads, backup, and archival solutions, delivering industry-leading scalability, durability, availability, and security for customers around the globe.

Microsoft Security's Economics and Analytics team provides rigorous scientific analyses that inform decisions on business strategy, product performance, and industry dynamics. We use a variety of tools, including experimentation, econometric analysis, machine learning, and economic theory to develop insights that drive executive action. We work on ambiguous, high-profile problems and bring a unique and valued perspective to the Security division.  

We are looking for a Senior Economist to join our team. This person will focus on the division’s operational efficiency. Example workstreams include helping to optimize GPU capacity; determining where we can use less expensive AI models for the same business outcomes; and creating insights on how we can organize and work more efficiently. The ideal candidate will have sharp economic intuition and deep technical skills combined with the gumption to start hacking away at difficult problems. Their crisp writing will give executives easy access to complex ideas. Does that sound like you? If so, please apply. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities

  • Discover the division's biggest opportunities to improve efficiency and help formalize them as scientific questions that can be answered with data and theory 

  • Estimate the causal effects of product, operational, and resource-allocation decisions on cost, utilization, customer outcomes, and revenue. 

  • Formulate resource allocation decisions as optimization problems 

  • Define measures that connect resource usage, including tokens, compute, and capacity, to productive utilization and business outcomes. 

  • Determine the appropriate micro-level unit of analysis, such as a feature, workflow, agent, or service, so that efficiency signals support actionable product and resource-allocation decisions. 

  • Work with product and engineering to instrument and collect the right data 

  • Translate analytical findings into decision rules, forecasting tools, and optimization systems; partner with business, product, and engineering teams to implement them and measure their realized impact. 

  • Write clear, accessible reports to communicate your analysis for executive consumption

    • AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics predictive analytics, research) OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)

  • 4+ years of experience applying economics, statistics, causal inference, or optimization to complex business, policy, or product decisions.

  • Strong collaboration and partnership skills, with experience working across teams and guiding or mentoring less-experienced colleagues.

Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind the cloud. CO+I is responsible for delivering over 200 Microsoft web portals, Live and Online Services around the world including infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for a passionate individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services.  

We are looking for a Director, Cost Management - Air Gap Cloud to join our team. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.    

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.



Responsibilities

Cost & Estimation Leadership

  • Lead the Air-Gapped Cloud Cost and Estimation function, establishing strategy, operating rhythms, standards, priorities, and measurable outcomes across the portfolio.
  • Establish consistent estimating methodologies from feasibility and conceptual planning through progressively refined construction estimates.
  • Drive development and governance of Basis of Estimate documentation, including assumptions, clarifications, exclusions, quantities, unit rates, productivity assumptions, benchmarks, and estimate validation.
  • Establish consistent Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) alignment to enable transparent comparison of estimates, forecasts, commitments, and actual costs.
  • Lead estimate validation using quantity analysis, unit-rate analysis, historical data, benchmarking, market intelligence, and risk analysis.
  • Develop scalable cost models and estimating approaches supporting scenario planning, feasibility analysis, design alternatives, value engineering, and portfolio planning.

Current AGC estimating materials emphasize quantity-led estimating, CBS/WBS mapping, unit-rate analysis, benchmarking, and detailed Basis of Estimate development.

Cost Management & Portfolio Governance

  • Establish the operating framework connecting estimates, budgets, forecasts, Estimate at Completion (EAC), cash flow, risk, changes, commitments, and actual costs.
  • Establish clear accountability and governance for major cost artifacts throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead portfolio-level analysis to identify cost trends, variance drivers, systemic risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Establish benchmarking and cost-performance capabilities that improve future estimates and inform investment decisions.
  • Partner with Finance to strengthen portfolio forecasting, EAC accuracy, cash-flow visibility, and cost governance.
  • Present executive-level cost information that translates complex construction and financial data into clear risks, decisions, and recommendations.

Preconstruction & Estimating Excellence

  • Lead development and continuous improvement of estimating standards, templates, cost models, reference data, benchmarks, and controls.
  • Ensure estimates appropriately capture project scope, quantities, labor, materials, equipment, indirects, escalation, procurement assumptions, construction strategy, and risk.
  • Partner across Design, Construction, and Procurement to identify scope gaps, overlaps, assumptions, exclusions, and cost ownership early in the lifecycle.
  • Establish effective cost benchmarking using historical project and market information.
  • Evaluate escalation, commodity, labor, and market impacts and translate those findings into actionable cost insights.
  • Promote early identification and quantification of cost and scope risks to reduce avoidable downstream changes.

Construction Cost Control

  • Provide leadership for cost management throughout procurement and construction execution, including change evaluation, forecasting, payment review, and financial closeout.
  • Establish mechanisms for evaluating cost impacts associated with design development, procurement decisions, field changes, schedule impacts, and construction risk.
  • Ensure accurate and timely visibility into project and portfolio financial performance.
  • Provide cost information and recommendations that support project governance, funding, and business decisions throughout delivery.

People Leadership

  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a diverse team of cost-management and estimating professionals.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, goals, decision rights, and accountability across the organization.
  • Build technical depth and succession capability through coaching, standards, knowledge sharing, and structured development.
  • Create an environment where people surface risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, collaborate effectively, and continuously improve.
  • Foster a culture of growth mindset, inclusion, customer focus, accountability, and One Microsoft collaboration.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a Cost and Estimation leader across Air-Gapped Cloud Delivery & Execution.
  • Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement/Supply Chain, Finance, E2E Program Management, Security, and business leadership.

Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment.

Documents are one of the richest forms in which human knowledge is created and communicated, combining language, visual structure, tables, images, and domain-specific conventions. Our team is developing the next generation of document intelligence systems that can perceive, understand, and reason over this complex multimodal content. As a Research Intern, you will investigate new models and learning techniques that advance the state of the art in document understanding, from fundamental research to challenging real-world scenarios. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to evaluate new ideas at scale and translate research advances into practical AI capabilities. We are seeking candidates with strong machine learning research experience and an interest in multimodal AI, computer vision, natural language processing, or related areas.

Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. The Contact Center AI team is building the conversational AI runtime that powers the next generation of intelligent, agentic customer engagement across chat, digital channels and real-time voice. We deliver Contact Center AI as a highly available, enterprise-grade service that integrates cleanly with Azure and a broad ecosystem of first- and third-party products, enabling any surface to embed rich contact center experiences and advanced AI capabilities out of the box. We transform Microsoft’s advances in foundation models, multimodal systems, and AI agents into production-ready capabilities that help customers resolve complex needs with speed, consistency, and trust. Our mission is to deliver a world-class agentic platform where Copilot agents can reason, plan, act, collaborate with other agents, and transition seamlessly to human experts—turning frontier AI into dependable customer outcomes on a global scale.

Our charter spans the full Microsoft Copilot Studio (MCS) runtime: intelligent agent authoring, orchestration, and invocation; secure tool and connector execution; knowledge grounding and retrieval; and a dynamic evaluation system that continuously measures quality as agents, models, data, and customer behaviors evolve. We use targeted evaluations, and drift detection to identify regressions early, understand their causes, and iterate rapidly—creating a closed learning loop that improves accuracy, resilience, and consistency over time.

As a Principal Software Engineer on the team, you will set the technical direction for the services at the heart of this platform - architecting and shipping production-grade systems across the agentic stack, from real-time voice and orchestration to Copilot agents, tool invocation, and the Copilot Studio runtime that brings them to life. You will take on the hardest problems, pioneer experiences that have never been built, and raise the technical bar for engineers across teams. We are an AI-first organization: we rethink every workflow in an agentic way, innovate quickly, and collaborate closely with our partners and customers in an agile, fast-paced, high-energy environment. If this opportunity excites you, come and talk to us!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Build agentic experiences on the Microsoft Copilot Studio (MCS) runtime - setting the direction for agent orchestration, planning, grounding, memory, multi-agent coordination (A2A), knowledge sources, connectors, the Tool Gateway, and the control plane that ties them together.

  • Pioneer real-time voice agents - low-latency, speech-to-speech experiences with sub-second turn-taking, barge-in, interruption handling, and graceful human hand-off that feel natural in live calls.

  • Build scalable, resilient backend services using event-driven, CQRS, and service mesh patterns, with high-throughput APIs (REST, gRPC), owning the full service lifecycle - CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, on-call, and SLA-driven reliability (99.9%+) - and optimizing for latency, throughput, and cost at enterprise scale.

  • Be customer obsessed - Understand and anticipate the needs of our customers who need to react to an evolving business and technology landscape.

  • Champion Responsible AI - Embed fairness, safety, privacy, grounding, and reliability into everything you build.

 

In short, we are looking for some great engineers to come and do what great engineers truly love to do: Solve complex problems by building great software.

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

Overview

The Spatial AI Lab is part of the Applied Sciences Group, a Microsoft research and development organization dedicated to creating next-generation human–computer interaction technologies, leveraging the latest AI developments and exploring new hardware capabilities and device form factors. Our scientists and engineers bring deep expertise in computer vision and multimodal AI, with a particular focus on spatial and embodied AI. 

About the internship 

We are seeking Research Interns in Computer Vision, Machine Learning and Robotics, broadly defined, for our Spatial AI Lab in Zurich. As an intern, you will collaborate with one or more mentors and use the cutting-edge hardware and software we are creating. During the 12-week internship, you will work on a stimulating, open-ended research project that seeks to advance the state of the art. An internship at Microsoft will not only enhance your career but also let you take part in exciting research breakthroughs. Interns work, learn, and network with some of the world’s top researchers and engineers. 

This call covers four research directions, described below. The exact project will be shaped jointly by you and your mentors, based on research opportunities and your background. The start date of the internship could be the 1st of each month, no later than 1st of April 2027. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Direction A – Multimodal Embeddings 

Text–image embedding models such as CLIP and SigLIP are foundational building blocks for search, retrieval, and multimodal AI. In this direction, you will study how these models organize information in their embedding spaces and develop new methods that make embeddings more expressive, flexible, efficient, and interpretable, with applications such as semantic search. 

Example research topics 

  • Geometry and expressivity of multimodal embedding spaces (e.g., cone effect, modality gap) 

  • Updating embedding models while preserving compatibility with existing embeddings 

  • Multi-vector, hierarchical, and composable embeddings 

  • Explainable and steerable embeddings 

  • Generative search, efficient retrieval, and quantization for inference 

  • Benchmarking retrieval beyond web-scale data, such as private collections 

What we look for 

Research experience in multimodal representation learning, text–vision embedding models, contrastive learning, neural information retrieval, or embedding adaptation and compression (e.g., knowledge distillation, quantization). 

Direction B – Image Understanding and Editing 

Advances in visual intelligence are creating new opportunities for models that interpret rich image content and reason about what makes an image meaningful. In this direction, you will investigate models that build a context-aware understanding of images (scene composition, geometry, appearance, salient regions, objects, and their relationships) and explore how this understanding can power downstream applications.  

Example research topics 

  • Richer visual representations and combining complementary visual signals 

  • Context-aware scene and image understanding, and its use for image editing 

  • Generalization, robustness, and reliable evaluation of visual understanding 

  • Efficient architectures, model compression, or on-device deployment (optional extension) 

What we look for 

Research experience in image understanding, visual representation learning, computational photography, multimodal learning, or generative image editing, with a strong background in modern discriminative, generative, or vision–language models. Experience with efficient neural networks is a plus. 

Direction C – Robot Learning for Manipulation and Real-to-Sim-to-Real 

Real-world observations and demonstrations are a rich source of experience for robot learning. In this direction, you will work on manipulation with stationary and mobile bimanual robots, exploring how physical experience, such as videos and demonstrations, can inform simulation, and how simulated experience can improve real-world policies. 

Example research topics 

  • Real-to-sim-to-real learning and policy robustness 

  • Video–action models, world–action models, and vision–language–action (VLA) policies 

  • Learning from human demonstrations, including 3D reconstruction and tracking of hand–object interactions 

  • Physics-based and differentiable simulation for manipulation 

What we look for 

Research experience in robot learning (imitation or reinforcement learning, sim-to-real transfer), bimanual or mobile manipulation, 3D reconstruction and pose estimation, or physics-based simulation; familiarity with tools like PyTorch, ROS, and MuJoCo; and experience deploying policies on real robots. 

Note: Robot-learning projects in this direction involve hands-on work with physical robots and require presence at our Zurich lab for the full duration of the internship. 

Direction D – Image Generation and Efficient Visual Generative Models 

In this direction, you will explore compact and efficient visual generative models across image and video generation, and action-conditioned visual prediction. You will choose a focus based on your interests and background. 

Example research topics 

  • Video generation: extending image generation to coherent sequences conditioned on text or images 

  • World modeling: lightweight models that predict future visual observations from context and actions 

  • Architecture distillation: transferring the capabilities of large image generators into different, smaller architectures, including latent-to-pixel-space distillation 

What we look for 

Research experience in generative modeling (e.g., diffusion or flow-based models), image or video generation, model architecture distillation, temporal learning, or world models. 

 



Responsibilities
  • Review relevant work and establish strong, reproducible baselines within the agreed project scope. 

  • Prototype, train, and evaluate new models and methods for your research direction. 

  • Design controlled experiments covering quality, model behavior, robustness, and efficiency. 

  • Own the research workflow end to end, from problem formulation and implementation through analysis, iteration, and clear documentation. 

  • Work closely with mentors and other researchers, seek feedback, contribute to a shared codebase, and present your findings at the end of the internship. 



Qualifications

Required qualifications 

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Robotics, AI, or a related field. 

Preferred qualifications (one or more of the following) 

  • At least one year of research experience in an area related to one of the research directions above. 

  • A strong background in deep learning and modern neural network architectures. 

  • Skills in algorithmic problem-solving and software development (e.g., Python, C++). 

  • Experience with tools like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and OpenCV (for robotics: ROS, MuJoCo, or Unity). 

  • Publication(s) in top-tier conferences or journals in related fields (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, IJCV, TPAMI, CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, IJRR, T-RO). 

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and writing skills.
