Overview

Build the intelligence system that helps Azure Product Marketing make faster, data driven decisions. The Azure Product Marketing team needs a trusted, connected view of the business across customers, products, markets, launches, campaigns, and commercial outcomes. You will partner across product marketing, finance, business planning, sales, data engineering, data science, and marketing operations to establish a scalable intelligence platform and turn complex data into decision-ready insight.

As the Azure Product Marketing Business Insights Lead, you will set the strategy and operating model for the Azure PMM intelligence platform and lead Azure insights and analytics reporting. You will define a shared measurement framework, prioritize data products and dashboards, improve data quality and governance, and translate performance signals into recommendations that shape product marketing strategy, investments, go-to-market execution, and business reviews.

This opportunity will allow you to create a durable intelligence capability for Azure Product Marketing, deepen your expertise at the intersection of marketing strategy and data platforms, and directly influence portfolio, go-to-market, and investment decisions through actionable business insight.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Deliver the vision, roadmap, governance, and adoption strategy for the Azure PMM intelligence platform.
  • Build an intake and prioritization process for data and analytics demand.
  • Create clear communications and governance frameworks to enable and empower PMM teams to succeed while also ensuring they’re aware and leveraging central intelligence assets.
  • Lead Azure insights and analytics reporting, including executive scorecards, recurring business reviews, portfolio deep dives, self-service dashboards, and concise narratives that distinguish signals, implications, recommended actions, and open questions.
  • Partner with data engineering, data science, finance, business planning, sales, privacy, security, and source-system owners to integrate data, improve quality, document lineage, manage access, and establish trusted definitions.
  • Create an insight-to-action operating model that converts analysis into decisions, named owners, follow-through, and measurable learning, while reducing duplicate reporting and inconsistent metrics.
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary virtual or direct team, strengthen analytics fluency across PMM, and communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical senior stakeholders.
  • Work across the broader organization to understand and when applicable leverage other data assets while also sharing the PMM intelligence solutions when applicable.
  • Take a hands-on role in leading and building the Azure PMM intelligence platform.


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 4+ years experience in business OR Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 6+ years experience in business OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 8+ years marketing or sales experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 12+ years experience in business OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years direct people management experience or indirect people management experience, including leading virtual and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience leading analytics, business intelligence, measurement, or insights programs and translating complex data into clear recommendations for senior business and marketing stakeholders.
  • Experience creating alignment across multiple stakeholders at varying levels in the organization.
  • Experience leading a managed governed portfolio (report governance or similar) with a blended model of centralized and business unit (or similar team) solutions.
  • Hands-on technical expertise with Azure, Fabric, OneLake, Power BI, pySpark, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with change management and/or complex solution rollouts to multiple business units.

Overview

The Global Partner GTM, Programs, & Operations (GPO) organization within GCPS (Global Channel Partner Sales) brings together the go-to-market strategy, programs, and platforms to activate the Partner Channel to accelerate customers transformation with Secure AI and Agents.

The Global GCPS CSA (Cloud Solution Area) strategy team, within GPO, is a team of CSA aligned leaders focused on design and deliver Cloud GTM execution strategy that accelerates CSP partners to deliver customer success while empowering the partner ecosystem. Within this team we are looking for a Cloud & AI (CAIP) Channel Strategy Lead-Agent Builders focused on transforming CSP (Cloud Solution Provider) partners into Agent Builders and Sellers.

The Microsoft Dataverse Intelligence Platform organization is building the next generation AI-native business data and intelligence platform for Microsoft. Our mission is to help customers turn enterprise data, business knowledge, and operational processes into actionable intelligence that powers copilots, agents, business applications, and autonomous workflows.

We build and operate the intelligent foundations that connect business data, semantic understanding, governance, analytics, process intelligence, and AI-powered execution at cloud scale. Our platform powers Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot experiences, and thousands of customer solutions worldwide. We enable organizations to securely transform business data into intelligence, intelligence into action, and action into measurable business outcomes.

As AI reshapes how software is built and how businesses operate, we are investing deeply in AI-native platforms, intelligent data systems, agent orchestration, enterprise governance, and hyperscale infrastructure that will power the next generation of business applications.

We are hiring for a Principal Software Engineer role within our Dataverse Intelligence Platform organization. These roles span several high-impact engineering areas, including:

  • AI-native business applications and intelligent agents

  • Business data platforms and semantic intelligence

  • Process Intelligence and AI-powered automation

  • Enterprise knowledge, retrieval, and grounding systems

  • Distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and platform engineering

  • AI-native developer experiences and platform services

In these roles, you will provide technical leadership across complex, interconnected platform systems that serve millions of users and power mission-critical business processes worldwide. You will help define platform strategy, drive architecture, modernize services, advance AI-native engineering practices, and influence technical direction across multiple product areas.

Whether your background is in distributed systems, large-scale data platforms, AI infrastructure, retrieval and grounding systems, enterprise software, business applications, cloud services, or production AI systems, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of Microsoft's AI-powered business platform.

You will partner closely with engineering, product, research, data science, security, and business teams to solve ambiguous technical challenges, build durable platform capabilities, and deliver customer impact at global scale.

The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. The Databases organization delivers trusted, scalable operational AI ready databases that power application development across cloud, hybrid, and on premises environments. Our portfolio includes SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, supporting developers as they build AI native applications and run critical workloads at global scale.​

People remain central to judgment, creativity, leadership, and accountability, while agents help the organization move with greater speed, continuity, and scale.

We value deep technical thinking, rapid experimentation, and turning promising ideas into systems that can operate reliably at scale. You will work alongside engineers with expertise across these areas and have the opportunity to help shape both the technology we build and how we build it.

Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment.

Brain-Computer Interfaces Research Project

The Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI) project at Microsoft Research (MSR) aims to make BCI technology practical and accessible for the general population. The team develops noninvasive approaches that use fewer electrodes and custom signal-acquisition devices to improve usability. Its work focuses on interactive BCI systems that use electroencephalographic (EEG) and other biosignals to respond within seconds.

 

This effort brings together researchers from several groups across Microsoft Research. Learn more about the project, its research areas, and its publications at: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/project/brain-computer-interfaces/.



Responsibilities

Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer.

Additional Responsibilities

Summer Research Interns in the MSR BCI project work on well-defined projects that encourage open exploration and collaboration under the guidance of dedicated mentors. The Research Internship concludes with a final presentation open to all Microsoft employees, and the project work may also lead to a peer-reviewed scientific publication.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a Doctorate Degree program in Computer Science or a related STEM field.
  •  

Other Requirements

  • Research Interns are expected to be physically located in their manager’s Microsoft worksite location for the duration of their internship.

After you submit your application, a request for letters may be sent to your list of references on your behalf. Note that reference letters cannot be requested until after you have submitted your application, and furthermore, that they might not be automatically requested for all candidates. You may wish to alert your letter writers in advance, so they will be ready to submit your letter. 
  •  

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ year(s) experience with brain-computer interfaces and processing EEG or other biological signals.
  • Experience applying AI and machine learning to process EEG, biosignals, and related sensor data.
  • Experience implementing algorithms in practical systems.
  • Hands-on system design and implementation skills, including experience with real-time data processing.
  • Coding skills in Python, or C/C++, or MATLAB.

Microsoft continues to invest by quadrupling its cybersecurity investment to $20 billion over the next five years, to provide its customers with solutions that integrate across the ecosystem by connecting all of your identities, endpoints, apps, emails, docs and clouds to help you close critical gaps in coverage, reduce risk, and save costs with a streamlined security portfolio.  With thousands of global security experts worldwide and the cutting edge AI- based Security innovations, Microsoft is ideally placed to think outside of the box and protecting customers, and partners around the world.

Being part of this team will allow you to maintain and develop your deep technical expertise across Microsoft and non-Microsoft cloud-based security solutions, architectures, programs, and technologies.

  • Scale Customer Engagements: Remediates blockers; leads and ensures technical wins for Microsoft Security and adjacent technologies. Coaches team in addressing customer digital transformation and leveraging insights to align new or changing technology to customer security needs.

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND proven technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience

This role will focus on defining and mainstreaming our partner incentives, programs, sales strategy and resources to support the success of Microsoft’s Security offers. The position will be responsible for working collaboratively across GCPS Sales, Partner Marketing, GS&O, SME&C, and other stakeholder teams across the company to translate the strategy into a set of actionable plans across all markets.   

 The role engages regularly with Solution Area Product Marketing Groups (PMG), Solution Area GTM teams (CSA), Global Sales and Operations (GS&O) and  across many commercial and technical roles to identify opportunities that strengthen partner investment, programs, messaging, and engagement across the go-to-market journey to accelerate Security billed revenue and consumption.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

The Windows Cloud Experiences team builds the Windows App, the unified client for connecting to Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, and remote PCs. We create secure, reliable, and high-performance client experiences that bring together native Windows capabilities and cloud-powered services across devices and form factors. 

We are looking for a principal engineer who combines deep Windows systems expertise with broad architectural leadership. You will turn complex operating-system, networking, identity, remoting, performance, and reliability challenges into a coherent technical strategy for Windows App. This role is centered on native Windows client and platform engineering, with impact that spans multiple teams and partner organizations. 

As a Principal Software Engineer on Windows App, you will set the technical direction for critical areas of the native Windows client and lead architecture from customer scenarios through implementation, release, and live-site operation. You will work across application, platform, and service boundaries to make remote Windows experiences secure, responsive, dependable, and deeply integrated with the operating system. 

You will operate as a technical leader across teams, creating clarity in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning engineering investments with the product vision, and guiding durable decisions in complex codebases. You will grow other technical leaders through design guidance, architecture reviews, debugging support, and mentoring.

We build and operate shared inferencing services that enable partner teams to deploy and run models at scale while meeting enterprise expectations for trust, compliance, and operational excellence, across broad M365 environments and large geographic footprints for performance-based routing and collocation patterns.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data & AI Solution Architect with deep database expertise to join our Customer Success team. The role will focus on helping strategic enterprise customers design, modernise, optimise and operate highly available, secure and resilient database platforms on Microsoft Azure.
The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience across SQL Server, Azure SQL and enterprise database environments, with the ability to go beyond architecture and help customers diagnose complex database issues, optimise workload performance and improve the availability and operational health of business-critical database platforms.
While the role sits within Data & AI, the primary requirement for our team is deep database architecture and engineering capability, complementing our existing Data & Analytics expertise.


Responsibilities

  • Lead architecture and technical engagements for mission-critical database workloads across Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance and SQL Server on Azure VMs.
  • Assess existing customer database estates and develop migration, modernisation and optimisation strategies.
  • Provide deep technical guidance on database performance tuning, including query performance, indexing, execution plans, resource utilisation, configuration and workload optimisation.
  • Diagnose complex production database performance and reliability issues and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Advise customers on database and cluster architecture, configuration, scaling, capacity planning and operational best practices.
  • Design high availability and disaster recovery architectures aligned with customer business continuity requirements.
  • Review and optimise database environments for performance, reliability, security and cost.
  • Support customers with SQL Server and Azure SQL migrations, upgrades and platform modernisation.
  • Provide technical leadership for database resiliency, backup, recovery, failover and business-critical workload scenarios.
  • Evaluate workload requirements and recommend the appropriate Azure database deployment model.
  • Provide architectural guidance across other Azure database technologies, including Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Database for MySQL and Azure Cosmos DB, where required.
  • Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, health assessments and troubleshooting sessions with customer database, infrastructure and application teams.
  • Work across customer application and infrastructure architectures to identify upstream or downstream dependencies affecting database performance.
  • Partner with Microsoft engineering, support and specialist teams to resolve complex customer database challenges.
  • Help customers establish an AI-ready operational data foundation, connecting modern database platforms with emerging AI use cases where relevant.


Qualifications

Core Database Expertise

  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL technologies.
  • Strong expertise in database architecture, administration, optimisation and troubleshooting.
  • Proven experience with SQL performance tuning, including query optimisation, indexing strategies, execution-plan analysis and resource bottleneck investigation.
  • Experience diagnosing CPU, memory, I/O, locking, blocking, concurrency and database performance issues.
  • Strong understanding of database configuration, workload management, scaling and capacity planning.
  • Experience managing and optimising highly available or clustered database environments.
  • Strong knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup/recovery and failover architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server migration and modernisation to Azure.
  • Strong understanding of Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance and SQL Server on Azure VMs and the architectural considerations for choosing between them.
  • Understanding of database security, identity, networking, encryption, monitoring and operational controls.

Broader Technical Expertise

  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and other Azure database technologies is highly desirable.
  • Understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking, storage, monitoring and security as they relate to enterprise database workloads.
  • Ability to understand application architectures and identify how application behaviour impacts underlying database performance.
  • Understanding of modern Data & AI architectures and how operational database platforms provide the trusted data foundation for enterprise AI workloads.
  • AI fluency and ability to engage customers on how database modernisation supports their broader AI strategy.

Customer & Architecture Skills

  • Proven experience leading complex technical engagements with enterprise customers.
  • Ability to move between architecture-level discussions and deep technical troubleshooting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose complex production issues across application, database and infrastructure layers.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into pragmatic architecture and operational recommendations.
  • Strong communication, presentation and technical whiteboarding skills.
  • Comfortable engaging with DBAs, application developers, platform engineers, enterprise architects and senior technology stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300) or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Relevant Azure architecture certifications are desirable.
  • Experience supporting large, complex and regulated enterprise environments.
  • Experience with mission-critical workloads requiring demanding performance, availability, scalability and recovery objectives.
  • Experience modernising large on-premises SQL Server estates to Azure.
  • Experience performing database health assessments, performance reviews and production optimisation.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for someone who can walk into a complex customer database environment and confidently answer:
Why is the database slow? Where is the bottleneck? How should we tune it? Is the database or cluster configured correctly? Will it scale? Is the HA/DR design sufficient? And what should the customer modernise on Azure?
The successful candidate should combine deep DBA/database engineering expertise with cloud architecture skills, while having enough Data & AI fluency to connect database modernisation to the customer's broader AI strategy.

Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud business is expanding, and the Cloud Supply Chain (CSCP) organization is responsible for enabling the hardware infrastructure underlying this growth. CSCP’s vision is to empower customers to achieve more by delivering Cloud and AI capabilities at scale. Our mission is to deliver the world's computer with an industry-leading supply chain. The CSCP organization is responsible for traditional supply chain functions such as plan, source, make, deliver, but also manages supportability (spares), sustainability, security, and decommissioning of datacenter assets worldwide. We deliver the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform for external customers. Our infrastructure is supported by more than 300 datacenters around the world that enable services for more than 1 billion customers in over 90 countries. 

The Spares Supply Chain (SSC) organization within CSCP designs, plans, sources, distributes, supports, recovers, and continuously improves the hardware ecosystem that enables Azure fleet availability. Our scope spans the product lifecycle from early engineering engagement and new product introduction (NPI) through deployment, service, repair, reuse, and end-of-life disposition. Our mission is to ensure the right replacement material is available when needed, failed material is recovered, repaired, or appropriately dispositioned, inventory is replenished, and operational and financial records are reconciled. We measure success through service continuity, supplier accountability, recovery performance, lifecycle cost, and the ability to scale reliably. 

We are looking for a Director, Spares Sourcing Strategy to join our team and set the long-term sourcing direction that builds sustainable advantages through the supply chain. Well-defined and executed sourcing and supply chain management ensures reliable on-time performance, optimized cost, prevents urgent and unplanned investments, and provides accurate and timely information across the supply base and internally across the infrastructure organization. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. 

As a Director, Spares Sourcing Strategy, you will own the multi-year sourcing vision and strategy for the spares hardware portfolio, translating Azure fleet growth, technology transitions, and lifecycle economics into sourcing strategies that secure continuity of supply, cost advantage, and supplier accountability. You will lead our most complex, ambiguous, and cross-organizational problems, bringing structured thinking and durable solutions that scale, and you will influence senior leaders across Sourcing, Planning, Engineering, Quality, and Finance. This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of the spares supply chain while making a meaningful impact on Azure fleet availability.

Help shape how millions of people find what they need. Search sits underneath almost everything people do with Microsoft Copilot and inside our apps. It's how people find answers, files and context, and it's how AI agents find what they need to act, including when writing code. When search is great, people barely notice it. When it isn't, nothing else works. Our team's job is to make it great, and keep it that way.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager who is equally curious about customers and technology. You'll build a deep understanding of how people use our products and where the experience delights or disappoints them. You'll combine customer signals, product telemetry and research into a clear picture, and turn that picture into action. You'll find the opportunities that matter most and make sure they move forward, whether that means helping an existing owner or taking on the work yourself and delivering it.

This role suits a builder PM who is comfortable with ambiguity and is equally at ease setting strategy and doing hands-on work. You might come from search, from AI, or from a customer-facing product role, and you need to have the technical depth to dig into how systems really work. Experience with search, retrieval or ranking or with agentic or AI-assisted coding tools is a plus. Curiosity, sound judgment and a habit of finishing what you start matter most.

Customer and Market Insight

Product Strategy and Definition

  • Prioritize investments. Identify long-term, customer-informed investment opportunities. Evaluate tradeoffs with partners across the organization, and guide others toward the features and experiences that will deliver on objectives and key results (OKRs).

Embedding AI in Product Management

  • Build AI systems for scale. Build AI-powered systems, agents and automated workflows that help the team scale how it analyzes feedback, evaluates sentiment and generates insights, combining AI output with human judgment.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Lead through influence. Bring engineering, data science, research and design partners around a common vision. Provide thought leadership, and be the person leaders turn to with hard questions about search and customers.

Overview

We are building and operating frontier-scale AI supercomputers used to train the world’s most advanced models. The backend network is a critical part of the machine: a single degraded NIC, switch, link, or path can reduce training performance or disrupt jobs spanning thousands of GPUs. 

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Network Production Engineer to own the production health and operations of our multi-rail Ethernet backend network built on MRC and RDMA technologies. You will bridge network engineering, distributed systems, hardware health, and production operations to ensure the network delivers predictable performance at extreme scale. 

Your mission is simple: make the network invisible to researchers by maximizing large-job success, minimizing performance degradation, and recovering quickly when failures occur. 



Responsibilities

Own Production Network Health 

  • Own the availability, performance, and operational readiness of the MRC Ethernet backend network. 

  • Define and operate service-level indicators for packet loss, congestion, link health, path diversity, bandwidth, tail latency, collective performance, and job impact. 

  • Detect slow or degraded components before they cause training failures or reduce model FLOPs utilization. 

  • Build health models that correlate switch, NIC, host, topology, and application telemetry. 

Operate the Network at Frontier Scale 

  • Participate in on-call rotation and lead the response to high-severity network incidents. 

  • Diagnose failures spanning GPUs, NICs, switches, cables, firmware, drivers, network operating systems, MRC, NCCL, Kubernetes, and training workloads. 

  • Develop automated mitigation mechanisms, including path avoidance, node quarantine, workload relocation, and safe component remediation. 

  • Create operational procedures for maintenance, upgrades, rollback, capacity expansion, and topology changes. 

Improve Large-Job Reliability and Performance 

  • Work directly with training teams to investigate collective-performance degradation, stalls, timeouts, job restarts, and unexplained MFU loss. 

  • Translate low-level network signals into clear job-level impact. 

  • Establish network qualification gates for admitting nodes and racks into large training pools. 

  • Run failure-injection and resilience testing to validate behavior under link, NIC, switch, and path failures. 

  • Improve placement and routing policies for jobs spanning racks, rows, and network planes. 

Automate Fleet Operations 

  • Build production-quality software and automation for network validation, monitoring, diagnosis, remediation, and fleet-wide change management. 

  • Replace manual investigation with deterministic workflows and actionable alerts. 

  • Automate firmware, driver, configuration, and network operating-system compliance checks. 

  • Maintain authoritative network inventory, topology, and configuration state. 

  • Reduce mean time to detect, isolate, mitigate, and permanently resolve failures. 

Drive Cross-Company Execution 

  • Lead technical investigations involving internal infrastructure teams, cloud and datacenter operators, Azure Networking, NVIDIA, switch and NIC teams, and network-software partners. 

  • Own incidents through resolution, even when the underlying failure crosses organizational boundaries. 

  • Produce clear root-cause analyses with corrective actions, owners, and completion dates. 

  • Convert recurring production failures into requirements for future network, server, and accelerator architectures. 

  • Create runbooks and train engineers across regions to provide reliable round-the-clock coverage. 

What Success Looks Like 

Within the first year, you will: 

  • Establish clear operational ownership and measurable service levels for the MRC backend network. 

  • Build end-to-end visibility from physical links and network paths to collective performance and training-job health. 

  • Materially reduce network-caused job interruptions, degraded-performance hours, and unresolved incidents. 

  • Reduce detection and isolation time from hours to minutes through automation. 

  • Safely qualify and release new racks and network capacity into production. 

  • Create a scalable operating model that supports increasingly large training jobs without proportional growth in manual operational effort. 

Primary success metrics include: 

  • Large-scale training job success rate and goodput 

  • Network-attributed lost GPU hours 

  • Collective performance and tail latency 

  • Mean time to detect, isolate, mitigate, and resolve failures 

  • Percentage of failures detected before workload impact 

  • Change failure and rollback rates 

  • Automated remediation coverage 

  • Time from hardware availability to production-ready capacity 

 



Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Significant experience operating large-scale datacenter or high-performance computing networks in production. 

  • Deep understanding of Ethernet, RDMA, RoCEv2, congestion control, routing, load balancing, and lossless or near-lossless network design. 

  • Experience debugging complex failures across switches, NICs, hosts, drivers, firmware, and distributed applications. 

  • Strong Linux systems knowledge and proficiency in Python, Go, C++, or another systems-oriented programming language. 

  • Experience building monitoring, automation, diagnostic, or remediation systems for production infrastructure. 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead high-severity incidents and coordinate resolution across multiple engineering teams. 

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate telemetry into a defensible root cause. 

  • Willingness to participate in a global 24/7 on-call rotation. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience operating GPU training clusters or other tightly coupled distributed-computing systems. 

  • Knowledge of MRC or other multi-rail, multi-plane, multipath Ethernet transports. 

  • Experience with NCCL, collective communications, CUDA, GPUDirect RDMA, and distributed training frameworks. 

  • Familiarity with ConnectX-class NICs, modern Ethernet switch ASICs, SONiC, SAI, and switch telemetry. 

  • Experience with InfiniBand and the operational differences between InfiniBand and Ethernet-based AI fabrics. 

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Slurm, workload placement, and cluster-health certification. 

  • Experience with streaming telemetry, gNMI, Prometheus, Datadog, Kusto, eBPF, or equivalent observability systems. 

  • Experience managing fleet-wide firmware, driver, or network operating-system changes. 

  • A track record of improving reliability through automation rather than recurring manual intervention. 

Attributes We Value 

  • You treat the network as part of the training system, not as an isolated infrastructure layer. 

  • You are equally comfortable analyzing packet-level behavior, reading code, and coordinating a production incident. 

  • You stay accountable until the user-visible problem is resolved. 

  • You distinguish symptoms from root causes and measurements from assumptions. 

  • You automate recurring operational work and eliminate entire classes of failure. 

  • You communicate clearly under pressure and establish unambiguous ownership. 

  • You optimize for usable training capacity, reliable job execution, and researcher velocity.

Overview

Microsoft is helping define a new era of scientific and industrial innovation: one where agentic AI, cloud-scale compute, data, simulation, and human expertise come together to accelerate breakthroughs that once took months or years. As customers look to transform how they discover new materials, medicines, products, processes, and research insights, they need more than a platform — they need deeply technical partners who can turn ambition into working solutions. This role has three distinct dimensions: shaping customer outcomes, leading technical delivery, and scaling R&D motions.

We are seeking an Industry Architect, executive presence, and leadership ability to shape complex R&D opportunities. You will work directly with R&D leaders, scientific researchers, account teams, industry leaders, and Microsoft product engineering to identify high-value R&D scenarios. The Industry Architect serves as the strategic bridge between scientific innovation, business outcomes, and Microsoft’s AI technologies, shaping high-value opportunities from pre-sales through delivery and leading first-of-its-kind MVPs and cutting-edge production deployments. 

This is a role for builders who thrive in ambiguity, move comfortably from high level customer needs to whiteboard to code, and are energized by solving complex customer problems in the real world. You will help customers reimagine R&D workflows through Microsoft AI while also shaping the repeatable patterns, product feedback, and delivery motions that scale this frontier AI business across industries. If you are excited by the opportunity to co-engineer with customers, unlock new scientific and industrial possibilities, and help establish one of Microsoft’s most strategic AI growth motions, this role is for you.



Responsibilities
  • Build executive presence and credibility with R&D leaders, with the mindset to drive strategic, first-of-its-kind R&D engagements.
  • Lead R&D opportunities from pre-sales through delivery, including technical scoping, use case qualification, customer readiness, data and compute assessment, solution feasibility, business value definition, staffing models, success criteria, effort estimates, and phased delivery plans.
  • Partner with account teams, Industry Advisors, Customer Success, Product Engineering, and Services teams to shape R&D engagements from early opportunity through implementation, drive cross-functional alignment across Microsoft.
  • Bridge business objectives, scientific requirements, and technical implementation teams to ensure successful end-to-end solution delivery. Work side-by-side with customer scientists, researchers, computational teams, engineers, executives, and UX researchers to articulate specific R&D outcomes and roadmaps, align technical delivery with business outcomes, and establish trusted advisor relationships.
  • Translate customer R&D, scientific, engineering, or advanced computing challenges into product backlogs, epics, user stories, tasks, research objectives, success metrics, scientific workflows, and target-state AI architectures on Microsoft Discovery and Azure.
  • Lead design and delivery of MVPs, proof-of-concepts, and production-ready solutions across Discovery workflows, agents, integrations, simulations, and data pipelines.
  • Own technical workstreams across the engagement lifecycle: qualification and planning, discovery and design, implementation and build, and post-go-live optimization
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and provide scientific and technical oversight throughout the engagement, ensuring solutions are scientifically credible, technically feasible, aligned to customer goals, and applicable to scientific and engineering workflows.
  • Develop reusable patterns, reference architectures, delivery playbooks, technical assets, and leading practices that help scale R&D patterns across customers, industries, and regions. Capture product feedback and field learnings to influence the Microsoft Discovery roadmap, engineering priorities, and repeatable industry motions.

Success in this role looks like

  • Scientific Credibility: Earns deep trust from research leaders by demonstrating deep understanding of R&D problems and research workflows.
  • Technical Credibility: Earns trust with R&D IT and computational teams by demonstrating proven understanding of HPC, simulation, scientific workflows, data pipelines, security, and production operations.
  • Problem Framing and Solutioning: Shapes ambiguous R&D and science problems into clear hypotheses, workflows, architectures, delivery plans, risks, and decision points.
  • R&D Product Lifecycle Management: Establishes and manages high-quality product roadmaps and product backlogs for delivery teams, connecting scientific priorities to engineering execution.
  • R&D Outcome Ownership and Accountability: Establishes, monitors, and presents R&D outcomes to external and internal stakeholders throughout pre-sales and delivery, including impact on cycle time, experiment throughput, decision quality, cost-to-discover, or speed of scientific insight.
  • Continuous Learning and Cross-Industry Adaptability: Stays curious about how R&D operates across industries, learns beyond their primary domain, and is willing to apply their skills across adjacent R&D-intensive sectors when customer needs, scientific opportunities, or business priorities require it.
  • Field learnings improve Microsoft Discovery product direction and delivery playbooks.
  • Customers view Microsoft as a trusted technical partner for frontier AI and R&D transformation.


Qualifications
  • Extensively experienced professional in science, engineering, technology consulting, product management, data science, machine learning, AI, or a related field.
  • Direct experience in materials science or industrial research and development, including chemistry, polymers, advanced materials, formulation science, computational materials, specialty chemicals, manufacturing research and development, energy materials, or related materials-focused domains.
  • Demonstrated understanding of scientific methods, experimentation, data-informed decision making, and research and development workflows.
  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, data science, simulation, or advanced analytics to business or scientific challenges.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with technical specialists and business stakeholders.
  • Effective communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across teams and drive organizational outcomes.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills in evolving and complex environments.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Doctor of Philosophy, Master of Science, or equivalent experience in Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated understanding of data science and machine learning, including algorithms, exploratory data analysis, model development, and model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud services (for example, Foundry and AI Search), agentic AI architectures, knowledge graphs, microservices, containers, and scientific high-performance computing.
  • Experience with product management, Agile delivery practices, and backlog management.
  • Experience working across large organizations and collaborating with engineering, research, product, and sales teams.
  • Track record of leading innovative initiatives and new solution development programs.
  • Experience using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools.

Overview

Microsoft Research AI for Science seeks a motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to design and lead experimental data-generation campaigns for the next Biomolecular Emulator (BioEmu) model. Microsoft Research AI for Science focuses on the development of machine learning and artificial intelligence methods for transforming molecular simulation and discovery of novel materials, drugs and chemical reactions. The BioEmu project aims to model the dynamics and function of proteins, how they change shape, bind to each other, and bind small molecules. This approach will help us to understand biological function and dysfunction on a structural level and lead to more effective and targeted drug discovery. Our BioEmu-1 model was published in Science (see our blog post for links to our open-source software and other resources and this explainer video).   

This role is suited for researchers with either an experimental or computational background who are excited about connecting machine learning models with real-world biological measurements. They shall combine strong scientific judgement with clear communication, quantitative data interpretation and effective coordination across disciplines. The position does not include a dedicated wet-lab bench; experimental execution will primarily be carried out through external partners. This role emphasizes scientific ownership, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and scalable systems thinking, moving beyond one-off experiments or models to build reusable, high-impact data and modeling pipelines. 

Why this role is exciting 

You’ll be running very large-scale data generation campaigns to train next-generation AI methods that can make a meaningful impact on how biomolecular modeling is done and improve success rates in drug discovery. You provide your expertise on technical and design level, making decisions about and creating datasets that have crucial impact on our AI models. It’s an opportunity to bridge state‑of‑the‑art ML with meaningful biomedical impact in a highly collaborative research environment. 



Responsibilities

1.Experimental campaign design, including areas such as

  • Design scalable campaigns for biomolecular interactions, conformational dynamics and related protein measurements.  
  • Select systems, constructs, assays and controls based on scientific value, feasibility, diversity, throughput and cost.  
  • Anticipate bottlenecks and define success criteria, contingency plans and follow-up experiments.  

2. CRO and external-partner leadership, including areas such as

  • Translate research goals into clear work packages, milestones and experimental requirements. 
  • Coordinate parallel programs with CROs and academic collaborators, review progress and guide corrective iterations.  
  • Provide scientific direction on protein production, assay development and biophysical or structural characterization.  

3. Data quality and interpretation, including areas such as

  • Review raw and processed experimental outputs, including binding curves and kinetic measurements. 
  • Diagnose artifacts, failed fits and systematic assay problems using quantitative and biophysical reasoning.  
  • Define reproducible QC criteria and scalable triage processes beyond manual review.  

4. Dataset construction and model integration, including areas such as 

  • Convert heterogeneous experimental outputs into traceable, model-ready datasets with appropriate metadata and provenance. 
  • Work with computational researchers to prioritize systems, evaluate model predictions and design informative follow-up experiments.  
  • Use basic scripting and data-analysis tools to organize, inspect and summarize experimental datasets.  

5. Collaboration and research impact, including areas such as

  • Communicate experimental findings, limitations and risks to biological and computational collaborators.  
  • Drive projects from ambiguous questions to usable datasets, scientific conclusions and publications.  
  • Contribute to the experimental data strategy for future BioEmu models. 


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:   

  • PhD in Biology, Biophysics, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Protein Science, Bioengineering, Computational Biology, Molecular Modelling, or a related field, with experience designing, conducting, or analyzing biomolecular experiments and/or computational studies.
  • Strong quantitative understanding of experimental measurements and their limitations. 
  • Ability to coordinate complex projects and communicate clearly across experimental and computational teams. 
  • Experience working with real-world biological, structural or biophysical datasets. 
  • Ability to independently own and deliver research projects.  

Preferred/Additional Qualifications: 

  • Experience managing CROs, vendors or distributed experimental collaborations. 
  • Expertise in protein-protein interactions, binder design, affinity optimization or high-throughput assay development. Familiar with techniques such as protein expression and purification, binding assays (SPR, BLI, ITC, cryo-EM), structural biology (X-ray crystallography, NMR), Mass Spec (HDX-MS, Cross-link Mass Spec). 
  • Practical Python or equivalent scripting skills for data analysis, QC and workflow automation.
  • Experience in designing, curating or standardizing datasets for machine-learning applications. Interest in model-guided experimental design, drug discovery or therapeutic applications.

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

The Cloud Apps and Identity Research (CAIR) team researches and builds protections against advanced attacks targeting identities and cloud applications. Our work spans threat research, detection, investigation, risk, and disruption, with an increasing focus on protecting identities across third-party identity providers and SaaS applications such as Okta and Salesforce. We are expanding how we do security research through AI and agentic systems, building RAG-based and coding agents that help researchers discover coverage gaps, analyze attacks, author and validate detections, and investigate threats at scale. As a Senior Security Researcher, you will combine deep security research and threat hunting expertise with hands-on experience in AI agents, evaluation, and quality validation, helping turn emerging attack techniques into scalable protection for customers.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Research third-party identity and SaaS attacks: Research attacker tradecraft and emerging threats targeting identities, applications, authentication flows, sessions, privileges, and data across third-party identity providers and SaaS platforms, including Okta and Salesforce.

Overview

Microsoft Quantum has assembled a talented and diverse international team to create the world's first scalable quantum computing system. Our full-stack approach involves exciting innovations from physics on the quantum plane to providing global quantum services. With new developments happening at every part of the stack, it is more important than ever to understand and control how the individual components come together to form a stable, sensitive, integrated system.

Our Systems Integration team is looking for a Quantum Systems Stability & Sensitivity Engineer with a passion for hands-on troubleshooting to help characterize and improve the stability and sensitivity of the world's first topological quantum computer. The focus of this role is electrical interference, pickup, vibration, and long‑term drift in quantum hardware and instrumentation, particularly as affected by rack layout, cabling, and fridge vibration. You will own investigations and fixes of current systems, support rack buildout and upgrades across our sites, and participate in the design of future systems.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  



Responsibilities

This role combines hands-on experimental work with systematic problem solving. Key responsibilities of the role:

  • Investigate and resolve sources of electrical interference, signal pickup, mechanical vibration, and long‑term drift that affect quantum hardware and instrumentation.
  • Characterize how rack layout, cabling, grounding, shielding, and fridge vibration influence system stability and measurement sensitivity.
  • Build and validate test racks, including baseline measurements of system noise and stability.
  • Support rack buildout and upgrades across our sites — including hands-on assembly, cabling, grounding/shielding work, and on-site validation — which will require regular travel to other Microsoft Quantum locations.
  • Perform expert-level troubleshooting of room temperature and cryogenic systems, including instrumentation faults, environmental noise, and mechanical issues.
  • Contribute to the design of future systems, recommending improvements to layout, cabling, shielding, grounding, and vibration isolation.
  • Analyze, document, and communicate the results of investigations and corrective actions to cross-disciplinary teams.

Microsoft’s Creative, Advertising & Integrated Marketing team is looking for a Creative Director, Design to join the design organization supporting Windows, Surface and Services.  

Reporting to the Head of Design, you’ll translate brand vision and visual identity into distinctive, scalable design systems and exceptional customer-facing experiences. You’ll lead the design expression of major campaigns, launches and brand initiatives across digital, web, social, OOH, retail, experiential, photography, product storytelling and other visual touchpoints.  

You are first and foremost a design creative: a conceptual thinker, systems builder and exceptional visual craftsperson with deep expertise in brand identity, typography, composition, imagery and art direction. You know how to take a powerful idea and build a visual system around it, creating work that is both creatively distinctive and capable of scaling across channels, markets, and formats.  

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. You’ll lead design projects with internal teams and agency partners, establish compelling visual directions, and guide work from early exploration through refinement, production and final delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative Directors in Copy and Art & Film to ensure campaign ideas and brand systems strengthen one another without losing the integrity of either.  

You’ll be accountable for raising the quality and consistency of design across the work you lead while helping the Head of Design evolve the broader visual expression of Windows, Surface and Services.  



Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities 

  • Translate brand strategy, consumer insights, cultural observations and product truths into distinctive, relevant and memorable design ideas.  

  • Lead the design expression of major campaigns, launches and brand initiatives across digital, web, social, OOH, retail, experiential, photography, product storytelling and other customer-facing touchpoints.  

  • Develop visual concepts and design systems that reinforce the central creative idea while building recognition and equity for the brand.  

  • Work in close partnership with the Head of Design to evolve and apply the visual identity systems for Windows, Surface and Services.  

  • Turn foundational brand principles into compelling and scalable visual expressions, including typography, color, composition, layout, imagery, iconography, graphic language and other design elements.  

  • Lead internal design teams and agency partners from brief through visual exploration, system development, production and final delivery, inspiring exceptional craft at every stage.  

  • Establish the design direction for projects, providing clear creative guidance, thoughtful critique and actionable feedback to designers, art directors and external partners.  

  • Develop and art direct photography, key art, illustration, typography and other visual assets required to support brand and campaign design systems.  

  • Partner with the Creative Director, Art & Film to ensure the design system and film expression share a coherent visual world, while respecting clear ownership of filmmaking, directing, production and motion-led storytelling within the Art & Film function.  

  • Partner with Creative Directors in Copy to ensure language, hierarchy, typography and visual expression work together as a unified experience.  

  • Collaborate with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Retail, Digital, Product Design and other internal partners to create cohesive design experiences across customer touchpoints.  

  • Present and represent design thinking to creative leadership, marketing partners and senior stakeholders, clearly articulating the rationale behind the work and advocating for the strongest design outcome.  

  • Lead and creatively direct brand design agencies, design studios, photographers, illustrators, typographers, image-makers and other specialist partners.  

  • Ensure final work adheres to the core design idea and established brand principles while allowing room for experimentation, evolution and creative innovation.  

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing design systems, tools and frameworks so teams can execute with greater clarity, consistency and quality.  

  • Maintain a strong point of view on contemporary brand design, typography, image-making, technology, fashion, culture and visual communication, bringing that perspective into the work.  

  • Lead multiple design initiatives simultaneously while maintaining creative clarity, systems coherence, high standards and exceptional attention to detail.  

  • Mentor designers and art directors, helping them strengthen their conceptual thinking, systems thinking, visual judgment and executional craft.

Overview

The AI Monetization Product Team within the AI Experiences organizattion at Microsoft is responsible for building and scaling advertising, commerce, and revenue-generating experiences across Microsoft's AI and consumer ecosystem. Monetization decisions are only as good as the data behind them. Sales, Finance, Product, and leadership teams rely on trusted reporting to understand revenue performance, product adoption, customer value, forecasting, and the health of the business. Today, too much of that work depends on fragmented datasets, inconsistent definitions, and one-off reporting solutions that are difficult to scale or trust.

At Microsoft AI Monetization, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Reporting & Data Platform to own the product direction for the data and reporting capabilities that help the business run. You will partner with Engineering, Sales, Finance, CRM, Analytics, and Product teams to turn their most important questions into durable platform capabilities: canonical data models, governed metrics, semantic layers, reusable datasets, and self-service reporting experiences.

This is not a dashboard-production role. You will build the foundation that allows other teams to create consistent reporting and insights on top of a shared source of truth. The role requires solid product judgment, comfort with data infrastructure, and a platform mindset: deciding what should be common, reusable, reliable, and easy for others to build on.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

AI Experiences employees who live within a 50- mile commute of adesignated Microsoft Hub in the U.S. are expected to work from the officeat least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and mayvary by jurisdiction.​

 



Responsibilities
  • Own the roadmap and delivery of reporting and data-platform capabilities that give Monetization teams a consistent, trusted understanding of the business.
  • Define and execute the product roadmap for shared reporting and data-platform capabilities, balancing immediate business needs with investments that make future reporting faster, more reliable, and more self-service.
  • Partner with Sales, Finance, CRM, Analytics, Product, and Engineering teams to understand the decisions they need to make and translate those needs into prioritized data products and reporting capabilities.
  • Drive the definition of canonical business metrics, semantic models, and reusable data assets for key domains such as revenue, performance, customer value, product adoption, seller insights, forecasting, and planning.
  • Enable teams to build on the platform through governed datasets, clear definitions, reusable dimensions, APIs, documentation, and access patterns--reducing duplicate pipelines and inconsistent reporting.
  • Work with engineering and data teams to shape requirements for data ingestion, integration, modeling, quality, reliability, observability, governance, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Lead cross-functional tradeoffs across data sources, reporting experiences, and platform investments; communicate priorities, risks, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Establish success measures for data quality, reporting reliability, platform adoption, time-to-insight, and reduction of manual reconciliation work.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional products or platforms.
  • Experience with reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data products, or data platforms.
  • Technical fluency in modern data infrastructure, including data pipelines, data modeling, warehouses or lakehouses, semantic models, APIs, and reporting tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous customer or business needs into clear product requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans.
  • Solid data sense and comfort with metric definitions, data quality, reconciliation, and the operational realities of maintaining trusted business data.
  • Experience influencing partners across engineering and business functions without direct authority.

The team develops and operates modern validation platforms, automation frameworks, telemetry systems, and AI-powered engineering solutions that help identify regressions, quantify release quality, and reduce deployment risk across consumer, enterprise, cloud, and OEM environments. 

Our mission is to help engineering teams make better release decisions faster through trusted validation signals, actionable insights, scalable automation, durable platform services, and responsible use of AI technologies. By transforming validation from a collection of isolated tests into an intelligent engineering platform, we help ensure that monthly Windows security releases meet rigorous standards for reliability, security, and customer quality. 

Position Summary 

As a Software Engineer on the Validation team, you will contribute to software, services, automation systems, and AI-enabled solutions that improve validation effectiveness, engineering productivity, and the quality of monthly Windows security releases. 

You will work with experienced engineers, validation specialists, and cross-functional partners to design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain cloud services, automation frameworks, telemetry pipelines, quality analytics platforms, and agent-based engineering experiences used to assess release readiness and security-fix quality. 

This role provides an opportunity to build expertise in cloud-native services, engineering productivity systems, AI-assisted development workflows, large-scale reliability analysis, and modern validation technologies while helping deliver monthly Windows security updates at global scale. 

Impact Statement 

In this role, you will help modernize how the quality of Windows security fixes is validated and measured at scale. Your contributions will improve validation efficiency, strengthen confidence in monthly security releases, accelerate issue detection, and help deliver secure, reliable, and high-quality Windows updates to customers around the world.

Overview

Microsoft Frontier Company is redefining how enterprises transform — bringing agentic AI, cloud-scale computing, data, simulation, and human expertise together so customers turn ambition into measurable business impact. As customers look to reinvent how work gets done — redesigning business processes, operating models, and human-agent ways of working across industries and functions — they need more than a platform. They need experts who can understand their business outcomes, reinvent new ways of working, and enable their employees to adopt that change at speed.  

The AI Workforce Reinvention Architect will be the expert on the ground with customers developing the new ways of working, deploying agents and AI to enable and reinforce those patterns, and empower customers to own the behavioral transformation as they evolve from AI experimentation to AI-native operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end operations reinvention with the end results being a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a one-off program. You will embed AI-first ways of working into culture, processes, and performance systems, working directly with business, technology and HR leaders, along with Microsoft account teams, industry specialists, and engineers.  

This is a role for people who do the higher-judgment human work that technology can inform but not perform. You will help customer reimage how people and agents work together – while shaping repeatable patterns specific to industries and functions. If you’re energized by making change stick rather than launching programs that fade, this role is for you.  

In this role you bring a unique blend of technical, industry, and change management expertise. Your edge is translating a customer’s business outcomes into a tangible operating model, powered by agents, with a clear path for adoption. Customers feel confident investing in frontier transformation because they see a viable plan for their teams to transform in parallel.  

 

Microsoft Frontier Company redéfinit la manière dont les entreprises se transforment en réunissant l’IA agentique, l’informatique à l’échelle du cloud, les données, la simulation et l’expertise humaine afin d’aider ses clients à convertir leurs ambitions en résultats commerciaux mesurables. Alors que les entreprises cherchent à réinventer la façon dont le travail est effectué en repensant les processus métier, les modèles opérationnels et les modes de collaboration entre humains et agents dans tous les secteurs et fonctions, elles ont besoin de plus qu’une simple plateforme. Elles ont besoin d’experts capables de comprendre leurs objectifs d’affaires, de concevoir de nouvelles méthodes de travail et de permettre à leurs employés d’adopter rapidement ces changements.

L’Architecte en Réinvention de la Main-d’œuvre par l’IA sera l’expert de terrain auprès des clients. Il ou elle développera de nouvelles méthodes de travail, déploiera des agents et des solutions d’IA pour soutenir et renforcer ces pratiques, et aidera les clients à prendre en charge leur propre transformation comportementale à mesure qu’ils évoluent de l’expérimentation de l’IA vers des opérations nativement alimentées par l’IA. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la réinvention complète des opérations, avec pour objectif un cycle continu et permanent d’amélioration plutôt qu’un programme ponctuel. Vous intégrerez des méthodes de travail fondées sur l’IA au sein de la culture, des processus et des systèmes de performance, en collaborant directement avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’activité, des technologies et des ressources humaines, ainsi qu’avec les équipes de compte Microsoft, les spécialistes de l’industrie et les ingénieurs.

Ce poste s’adresse à des personnes capables d’accomplir des tâches humaines à forte valeur de jugement, que la technologie peut éclairer sans pour autant les exécuter. Vous aiderez les clients à repenser la collaboration entre les personnes et les agents tout en développant des approches reproductibles adaptées à des secteurs et fonctions spécifiques. Si vous êtes motivé par l’idée d’ancrer durablement le changement plutôt que de lancer des programmes qui s’essoufflent avec le temps, ce rôle est fait pour vous.

Dans ce rôle, vous apporterez une combinaison unique d’expertise technique, sectorielle et en gestion du changement. Votre valeur ajoutée résidera dans votre capacité à transformer les objectifs d’affaires du client en un modèle opérationnel concret, soutenu par des agents intelligents, avec une feuille de route claire pour l’adoption. Les clients seront confiants dans leurs investissements en transformation de pointe parce qu’ils verront un plan crédible permettant à leurs équipes d’évoluer en parallèle.



Responsibilities
 

Workforce Reinvention 

  • Define new ways of working and employee roles based on the customer’s industry, function, and business outcomes/KPIs 

  • Design and deploy agents and AI systems that empower and scale employees and teams to execute 

  • Deliver retraining programmes ensuring no employee is left behind 

  • Embed AI adoption into performance evaluations and onboarding processes 

  • Protect employee privacy to maintain trust and stay on the right side of regulations  

Strategic Change Leadership 

  • Design and execute comprehensive operating model changes powered by AI with enterprise scale, structured as a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a fixed, one-off sequence 

  • Conduct AI/Agent readiness assessments to identify organisational barriers and enablers 

  • Develop AI literacy plans that position AI and agents as new ways of working, not tools 

  • Establish and lead AI Council and Champion networks to drive grassroots adoption through the informal networks of trusted peers 

Adoption Programme Delivery 

  • Implement a structured adoption framework powered by workplace adoption analytics and role-based enablement 

  • Coordinate communications, training, and champion efforts across thousands of users 

  • Drive behavioural change by creating recognition rather than pushing content at them

Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Facilitate business and technology leadership workshops and roundtables to design for required impact and scale  

  • Ensure cross-functional collaboration across IT, HR, operations, and business unit leadership on how work will change and their hands-on role  

  • Build trust through responsible experimentation and transparent communication

Définir de nouvelles méthodes de travail et de nouveaux rôles pour les employés en fonction du secteur d’activité, de la fonction et des objectifs d’affaires/KPI du client 

Concevoir et déployer des agents ainsi que des systèmes d’IA permettant aux employés et aux équipes d’accroître leur efficacité et leur capacité d’exécution 

Mettre en œuvre des programmes de requalification professionnelle afin qu’aucun employé ne soit laissé pour compte 

Intégrer l’adoption de l’IA dans les évaluations du rendement et les processus d’intégration des nouveaux employés 

Protéger la confidentialité des employés afin de maintenir la confiance et de respecter les exigences réglementaires  

Leadership stratégique du changement 

Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des transformations complètes du modèle opérationnel alimentées par l’IA à l’échelle de l’entreprise, dans le cadre d’un cycle continu et permanent plutôt que d’une initiative ponctuelle 

Réaliser des évaluations de préparation à l’IA et aux agents afin d’identifier les freins et les leviers organisationnels 

Élaborer des plans de maîtrise de l’IA qui présentent l’IA et les agents comme de nouvelles façons de travailler, et non comme de simples outils 

Mettre en place et diriger des conseils de gouvernance de l’IA ainsi que des réseaux d’ambassadeurs afin de favoriser l’adoption à la base grâce aux réseaux informels de collègues de confiance 

Mise en œuvre des programmes d’adoption 

Déployer un cadre structuré d’adoption fondé sur les analyses de l’adoption en milieu de travail et sur un accompagnement adapté aux différents rôles 

Coordonner les communications, la formation et les initiatives des ambassadeurs auprès de milliers d’utilisateurs 

Favoriser le changement comportemental grâce à la reconnaissance plutôt qu’à une diffusion excessive de contenu 

Déployer les programmes de formation à l’échelle mondiale : sessions en direct, tutoriels à la demande et communautés internes de soutien 

Mobilisation des parties prenantes 

Animer des ateliers et tables rondes avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’activité et des technologies afin de concevoir des solutions répondant aux objectifs d’impact et d’échelle requis  

Assurer une collaboration transversale entre les équipes TI, RH, opérations et les responsables des unités d’affaires concernant l’évolution du travail et leur rôle actif dans cette transformation  

Établir un climat de confiance grâce à une expérimentation responsable et à une communication transparente 

Suivre les statistiques d’utilisation et les commentaires qualitatifs, ajuster les programmes pour maintenir l’élan et mesurer le succès en fonction de la pérennité du changement après 90, 180 et 360 jours
