Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 
 

Our Mechanical Engineering team is responsible for developing the server, rack, and infrastructure platforms that power Microsoft's global cloud and AI services. We partner closely with electrical, thermal, manufacturing, supply chain, and datacenter operations teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable hardware solutions from concept through deployment. 
 

The Principal Mechanical Engineer will lead the design and deployment of future high density, liquid-cooled systems in Azure datacenters. 

 

#SCHIE 



Responsibilities

 

  • Lead Mechanical Development: Deliver innovative mechanical designs for server and cooling systems, integrating thermal, structural, and electrical constraints with a deep understanding of server architecture and adjacencies. 

  • Predictive Analysis & Empirical Validation: Apply advanced modeling (FEA, CFD, tolerance analysis) and empirical testing to validate structural, thermal, and reliability performance. 

  • Design for Manufacturing & Reliability: Ensure manufacturability, cost-efficiency, and long-term reliability through material selection, tolerance control, supplier engagement, and understanding of tooling and manufacturing processes. 

  • Drive for Results: Set clear goals with measurable outcomes, manage risk, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality hardware solutions across product lines. 

  • Strategic Thinking: Translate business and customer needs into scalable mechanical strategies that align with long-term product and platform vision. 

  • Technology Pathfinding: Develop and explore innovative design strategies that anticipate future trends, opportunities, and industry shifts. 

  • Develop Technical Talent: Mentor engineers to become thought leaders, fostering growth through challenging assignments and continuous feedback. 

  • Engineering Rigor & Agility: Balance innovation with disciplined execution, ensuring quality as a key participant in structured design reviews, test planning, and root cause analysis. 

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with electrical, thermal, reliability, and other domains to deliver cohesive, customer-focused solutions. 

  • Invent & Protect: Identify and develop intellectual property, encouraging patent filings and contributing to Microsoft’s innovation portfolio. 

  • Tool & Process Advancement: Evaluate and implement new tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve design quality and team productivity.

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:  

    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

  • Expertise in CAD software (e.g., PTC Creo,) understanding of mechanical design principles, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, manufacturing processes, and validation.

  • Experience with development of specifications, interface control documents, and managing design requirements. 

  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve mechanical design issues and optimize system performance. 

  • Experience with cabling and networking interconnect technology.

We are hiring a Principal Design Architect to take on the hardest, most ambiguous design challenges at the center of that vision. We are a team of product designers, UX researchers, content designers, data scientists, and technical writers. Together with our PM and Engineering partners, we design product experiences that are trusted, human-centered, and easy to use, enabling our users to manage, protect and secure their digital environments with peace of mind. 

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role for a designer who thrives on strategic, cross-cutting problems rather than a single product surface. You will move fluidly from deep user research to design thinking and prototyping to cross-functional leadership, setting direction where none exists and carrying an ambiguous problem all the way to a shipped, validated solution. You will partner closely with design, product, research, and engineering leaders across the organization, and you will help our most strategic work scale beyond any one individual 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Own core strategic design challenges that cut across the entire Security UX, rather than a single feature or product area.
  • Drive design thinking, concepting, and high-fidelity prototyping to shape and validate solutions with customers before they are built.
  • Provide cross-functional leadership that aligns design, product, research, and engineering partners to turn a strategic direction into a shipped experience.
  • Flex across the most pressing cross-cutting problems as they emerge, bringing structure and momentum to work that spans multiple teams.
  • Help scale the team's strategic capacity so that our most complex problems are not dependent on a single designer. 
  • Use the Design System as a creative medium, not just a set of components, evolving its visual language and fit-and-finish to meet new interaction models and product ambitions by showing what great looks like in exemplar experiences. 


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, User Experience, Interaction Design, or related field AND 7+ years experience working in product or service design
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, User Experience, Interaction Design, or related field AND 9+ years experience working in product or service design
    • OR equivalent experience (e.g., demonstrated experience working in product or service design or using design thinking to solve problems).

Additional or preferred qualifications:

  • Principal-level design experience, with the judgment and independence to operate as a senior individual contributor without direct reports.
  • Depth across the full design craft: user research, interaction and experience design, and rapid prototyping.
  • A track record of cross-functional leadership on ambiguous, strategic problems, influencing partners without formal authority.
  • Systems thinking, with the ability to reason about complex enterprise scenarios such as multi-tenant administration, RBAC, and partner ecosystems.
  • Comfort setting direction in ambiguity and carrying a problem from research through to a validated, shipped outcome. 
  • Experience designing for security, IT administration, or other complex enterprise domains; adjacent complex industries such as healthcare are welcome. 
  • Familiarity with data-informed design and measuring experience outcomes. 
  • Experience contributing to a shared design system or a composable, cross-product experience.

Overview

Microsoft’s Creative, Advertising & Integrated Marketing team is looking for a Group Creative Director - Art & Film, to lead the creative vision and craft of advertising and video storytelling across Windows, Devices and Services.  

This is a senior creative leadership role for someone whose foundation is in advertising, art direction or filmmaking. Someone who understands how a powerful insight becomes an idea, how an idea becomes a story, and how every creative decision, from casting and cinematography through to edit, grade, music and sound, can make that story memorable.  

The GCD Art & Film will lead the development of major advertising campaigns and hero creative, partnering with Copywriters, art directors, creative directors, strategists, producers, agencies and world-class production partners to create work that earns attention and builds our brands.  

The role requires exceptional creative judgment and a highly developed feel for moving image. You should instinctively understand story, performance, visual storytelling, shot selection, editorial rhythm, pacing, music and sound design, and recognize when each of those elements is helping or hurting an idea.  

To be successful, the GCD Art & Film should understand how audiences actually experience creative today. Combining creative instinct with curiosity about audience behavior and performance signals, from qualitative research to attention/audience-retention curves, using data as a key input into creative judgment rather than allowing it to replace judgment.  

Above all, this is a role for someone who cares deeply about the work and the craft to make it excel. 



Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities 

Lead advertising and film  

  • Set the creative ambition for major Windows, Surface and Services advertising campaigns, launches and cultural moments, leading work from brief and insight through concept, script, production and final delivery.  

  • Originate and shape breakthrough ideas with Copywriters, Art Directors, Creative Directors and agency partners, creating work that can extend across film, social, digital, OOH, DOOH, retail and emerging formats.  

  • Lead the creative development of film and moving-image storytelling across live action, animation, motion design and VFX, with a sophisticated understanding of story, performance, cinematography, production design and visual storytelling.  

  • Bring exceptional judgment to filmmaking craft, including narrative structure, shot selection, editorial rhythm and pacing, color and grade, music, sound design and finishing, understanding how each decision shapes the emotional impact of a story.  

  • Partner with creative production leadership to identify and engage exceptional directors, production companies, cinematographers, editors, VFX artists, animators, composers and sound designers, bringing together the right talent for the creative ambition.  

  • Lead creatively through production and post-production, protecting the strength of the idea while continually looking for opportunities to make the work more distinctive, surprising and beautifully crafted.  

  • Hold the work to a world-class standard for ideas, storytelling and execution, knowing when exceptional craft can elevate an idea and when simplicity and restraint will make it stronger.  

Build work for how audiences watch today  

  • Understand modern viewing behavior across broadcast, streaming, YouTube, social and emerging platforms, and create stories designed to earn and sustain attention.  

  • Use audience-retention curves, drop-off points, completion rates, qualitative research and other creative-performance signals to better understand how audiences experience the work.  

  • Translate those signals into creative hypotheses around openings, narrative clarity, pacing, product integration and emotional payoff.  

  • Balance evidence with creative instinct, using data to sharpen creative judgment rather than replace it.  

 

Raise the creative bar  

  • Lead and mentor Creative Directors, Editors and Motion Graphics artists.    

  • Be hands-on in the work, giving clear, specific creative direction that materially improves both the idea and its execution.  

  • Build a culture of rigorous critique where teams understand not simply what should change, but why.  

  • Develop talent with deep expertise in advertising, filmmaking, art direction and motion storytelling.  

  • Champion ambitious ideas while knowing when subtraction, restraint and simplicity will make the work stronger.  

Partner across the creative organization  

  • Partner closely with creative leaders across copy, design, production, strategy, IMC and advertising to create work where idea, story, craft and brand expression reinforce one another.  

  • Collaborate with Creative Strategy to translate customer, cultural and business insight into creative opportunity.  

  • Work closely with creative production leadership throughout development, production and post to ensure the creative ambition is realized at the highest level of craft.  

  • Partner with Integrated Marketing, Advertising, Media, Product Marketing, Social, Retail and Communications to turn ideas into connected customer experiences.  

  • Present and defend creative work with senior leaders, clearly articulating the central idea and the creative reasoning behind key executional decisions. 



Qualifications
 

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Certificate in Design, Fine Arts, Human Computer Interaction, Visual Communications or related art field AND 8+ years experience in art design or a related art field working on computer games or entertainment OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years people management experience (e.g., serving as a Lead Artist, Art Manager, Creative Director, etc.).

 Preferred qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in advertising, creative direction, art direction, film or related creative disciplines, including significant experience at Creative Director, Group Creative Director or Executive Creative Director level.  

  • An exceptional portfolio of advertising and filmmaking that demonstrates not only outstanding ideas, but a highly developed command of filmmaking craft: compelling storytelling, performance, cinematography, editorial judgment and pacing, color and grade, music, sound design and finishing.  

  • A body of work that demonstrates the ability to turn strong creative ideas into beautifully crafted films that hold attention, create emotion and leave a lasting impression.  

  • Deep experience developing integrated campaigns for globally recognized consumer brands.  

  • Demonstrated creative leadership across the complete filmmaking process, from concept and script through production, editorial and finishing.  

  • Experience collaborating directly with directors, production companies, cinematographers, editors, VFX studios, composers, sound designers and other specialist creative partners.  

  • Ability to give precise, constructive creative direction across multiple disciplines while protecting the central idea.  

  • Strong understanding of contemporary culture, entertainment, social platforms and changing audience behavior.  

  • Exceptional taste, creative judgment and communication skills.    

  • Experience at a creatively recognized advertising agency, production-led creative company or equivalent in-house creative organization.  

  • A portfolio that includes recognized, culturally resonant or category-defining advertising and film work.  

  • Experience leading creative for technology, entertainment, gaming, consumer electronics or other highly competitive consumer categories.  

  • Fluency in interpreting creative-effectiveness research and behavioral signals, including audience-retention data and attention patterns, with the judgment to distinguish meaningful creative insight from optimization noise.  

  • Experience with emerging production techniques and AI-assisted creative workflows across ideation, pre-visualization, production and post-production.  

  • Strong relationships across the advertising and film-production community.  

  • A track record of attracting, developing and inspiring exceptional creative talent.

Overview

Microsoft Windows & Devices team is on a journey to deliver iconic end-to-end products across hardware, software, and services that people love and use every day. A fundamental part of our strategy is having desirable and powerful devices that enable the experiences people want. Creating these new experiences and devices involves close partnership between hardware engineers, software engineers, designers, and manufacturing along with the various industry partners that closely collaborate to create industry defining firsts. Our obsession for the right experience with our passion to enable everyone to do and be their best is reflected in the devices that Windows ships. 

We are seeking a driven Principal Software Engineer with a background in Windows development to actively contribute towards the delivery of high quality, compelling Windows experiences on innovating silicon platforms. The candidate will play a key role across multiple phases of silicon development, platform validation, and product enablement. Responsibilities include prototyping and evaluating new hardware and software designs, bringing up new SoCs and platforms, validating hardware and firmware features, debugging system-level issues, analyzing performance, and developing scalable automation frameworks and regression test suites. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

The candidate will work closely with architects, silicon design teams, firmware developers, operating system engineers, and system integration teams to define requirements, enable new capabilities, optimize platform performance, and drive resolution of complex hardware and software issues throughout the product lifecycle. 

Success in this role requires a self-starter who thrives in ambiguous environments, takes ownership of technically challenging problems, and effectively drives collaboration across internal Microsoft teams and external silicon and hardware partners. 

  • Collaborate with teams across Microsoft and the Windows Ecosystem (Independent Hardware Vendors (IHVs) & Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs)) to debug reliability and stability issues across a wide variety of platforms. 
  • Develop kernel and user mode components for Windows to enhance diagnostic and debugging capabilities at scale that meet our security and privacy standards. 
  • Envision processes and develop infrastructure that efficiently integrates the new diagnostic data for teams in Windows, IHVs and OEMs to put into practice. 

The ideal candidate combines deep low-level system knowledge with a passion for problem solving, automation, and product quality, and is excited to influence next-generation silicon platforms from initial bring-up through production readiness. 



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or other relevant field of study combined with similar relevant work experience. 
  • 7+ years of experience in software and/or product development. 
  • Demonstrated experience with C/C++ design, coding, debugging and testing skills. 
  • Solid communication skills required, including the ability to clearly express technical concepts in verbal and written forms. 
  • Solid understanding of SoC architecture, platform bring-up, boot flows, and system initialization.  
  • Experience with silicon validation, hardware debugging, and root cause analysis across hardware, firmware, and software layers.  
  • Knowledge of platform technologies and peripherals including PCIe, NVMe, USB, I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, and power management.  
  • Solid understanding of operating system fundamentals, including memory management, scheduling, interrupts, synchronization, and multithreaded programming.  
  • Experience developing, debugging, and optimizing device drivers in Windows or Linux environments.  
  • Familiarity with Plug and Play architecture, device enumeration, power management, and driver lifecycle management.  
  • Experience with kernel debugging, crash dump analysis, hardware debuggers, and JTAG-based bring-up and validation tools.  
  • Proficiency in designing maintainable, modular, and reusable software components with a focus on scalability and long-term supportability.  
  • Experience developing automated validation frameworks, test infrastructure, and regression suites for pre-production and production hardware.  
  • Solid analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to debug issues across silicon, firmware, drivers, operating systems, and applications.  
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver solutions that scale across multiple product generations and architectures.  
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and applying Scrum methodologies to deliver high-quality engineering outcomes.

Overview
As a Senior Critical Environment Technician (CET) - Electrical SME in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, working closely with Management to address operational, risk and safety situations, mentoring other CE Technicians, having a hands-on understanding on how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 
In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays. 
 
Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties


Responsibilities
Critical Environment Culture
  • Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures are met, to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance to applicable Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations, and Microsoft requirements. Recognizes safe versus unsafe working conditions and responds accordingly (e.g., stop/pause tasks, stand down vendors where necessary). Escalates immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed and promotes a safe working culture to empower less experienced team members. Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs. Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EHS) objectives. Actively maintains safe working conditions at all times. Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.
  • Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
  • May travel up to 25%, typically domestically for training and/or supporting another site. May work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours such as evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
Equipment and Systems Maintenance
  • Processes method statement of work (MSOW) documents. Coordinates activities and associated schedules with contractors. Performs inspections of equipment in a facility. Participates in testing and commissioning activities. Advises engineer partners or project management colleagues on project scope process or execution methodology. Presents for review and approval MSOW in their area of responsibility.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert, performing troubleshooting independently for multiple equipment, systems, subsystems, and component types. Documents issues found in troubleshooting process within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Ensures equipment and system settings are consistent with established parameters and designs. Determines when troubleshooting efforts are deemed adequate and communicates or escalates to suppliers, engineers, or more experienced colleagues as needed. Has a hands-on understanding of how equipment in all disciplines work and how to troubleshoot to subsystem level. Provides consultation to less experienced colleagues with troubleshooting systems and problems. Oversees less experienced colleagues, or directly troubleshooting systems and investigates root causes.
  • Performs various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs for multiple disciplines and multiple equipment types of increasing complexity with no supervision, while serving as a subject matter expert for one discipline - in consideration of Task Hazard Analysis (THA), Method Statement of Work (MSOW), or varying permit requirements. Communicates and/or escalates maintenance activities per established process and procedure. Prioritizes maintenance activities as required and/or appropriate. Documents tasks or issues during maintenance activities within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Provides consultation to colleagues on maintenance and repairs through deep understanding of equipment, systems and their interrelations. Follows recommended maintenance schedules. Oversees everyday, complex, large-scale tasks for a single discipline or equipment across disciplines. Ensures follow up action items are addressed in a timely manner. Masters the maintenance of all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and understands levels of risk (LORs) associated with varying types of maintenance across all disciplines. Plans, coordinates, and presents maintenance items for review and approval in their area of responsibility.
  • Prepares and submits highly complex reports as assigned following preexisting scripts and templates, or using ad hoc methods required to support trending and analysis (e.g., Root Cause Analysis [RCA] reports) and may review prior reports delivered by less experienced team members. Develops methods of operating procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and/or digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) for highly complex and/or interdependent equipment and disciplines to ensure safe and reliable execution. Reviews completed work using approved tools and procedural templates from less experienced technicians for accuracy and completeness. Completes and provides coaching to support less experienced technicians for mandatory, technical, and procedural training assignments. Analyzes findings from reports and documents observations.
  • Provides necessary escort to third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site based on all procedure levels of risk (LOR). Takes part in getting third-party work underway (e.g., making sure systems are properly energized/deenergized), ensuring the work is started and completed in a safe manner in accordance with standard practices, procedures, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations. Ensures work performed by suppliers/vendors is performed to scope, all documentation is performed correctly, and escalates as appropriate. Overview

The Senior Technology Strategist leads global, cross-functional teams to develop and execute technology strategies for some of Microsoft’s largest and most complex customers. This role combines deep industry expertise, knowledge of Microsoft’s product and solution portfolio, and trusted executive relationships to identify customer needs, manage account risks, create demand, and accelerate business transformation.Serving as the voice of the customer and an internal advocate, the Technology Strategist aligns Microsoft, partner, and customer teams around long-term business outcomes. The role shapes account plans and technology roadmaps, identifies opportunities to increase adoption and consumption, and demonstrates how Microsoft technologies and services can address future business needs better than competing alternatives. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  



Responsibilities

Customer and Industry Insights
Synthesize business, customer, competitor, and industry insights, drawing on global best practices, case studies, and team expertise to support forecasting, account management, and subsidiary planning.
Bring alternative perspectives that help customers adapt their strategies, plans, business models, and solutions.
Orchestrate global teams to gather information, assess performance indicators, and identify risks within customer accounts.
Apply deep industry expertise to identify relevant Industry Sales Kits, partners, market trends, growth opportunities, and barriers.
Work with customers and partners to develop innovative solutions and integrate Microsoft technology into new areas of their business.

 

Differentiated Value Proposition
Act as a technology mentor and trusted advisor to customer leaders, including technical and business decision-makers at the CXO level.
Build relationships beyond the core customer team, align Microsoft capabilities to customer priorities, and challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas.
Lead business transformation through digital technologies by connecting customer strategy, industry context, and Microsoft capabilities to measurable outcomes.
Engage corporate, cross-industry, and partner resources to accelerate transformation and capture customer wins for broader reuse.
Articulate how Microsoft technologies and services can support long-term growth and meet future business needs better than competing alternatives.

 

Education and Thought Leadership
Create enablement plans for large, high-stakes customers using existing and emerging readiness resources.
Drive customer skilling initiatives with account executives and Enterprise Skills Initiative teams.
Motivate and align customer, partner, and Microsoft technical resources around the customer’s transformation agenda.
Deliver regular industry and technology briefings to executives, technical teams, and business decision-makers to strengthen execution and competitive advantage.

 

Account Planning and Stakeholder Mapping
Orchestrate internal teams and the partner ecosystem—including global systems integrators, consulting partners, Microsoft Industry Solutions, the Specialist Team Unit, and the Customer Success Unit—to secure the right technical resources.
Own the technical portion of account plans for large, critical, or strategic accounts and capture required inputs in the MSX Dynamics 365 Account Plan.
Establish account-planning and review practices that align quota attainment, consumption goals, opportunity pipelines, and customer consumption gaps with quarterly and fiscal objectives.
Coordinate complex account teams across technologies, geographies, and functions; drive forecasting, business tracking, accountability, and execution.
Create stakeholder maps, orchestrate coverage plans, and establish execution frameworks across multiple customer business areas.
Partner with account executives to set and refine strategy, share account-planning outputs with customers, and continually realign plans to customer expectations.

 

Technology Sales, Demand Generation, and Orchestration
Guide customers into the era of AI and the Industrial Metaverse through targeted strategies aligned to their business priorities.
Define the foundational technology capabilities required to realize value, build a mid-term strategy, and develop an immediate pipeline of billed and consumption opportunities.
Lead Account Strategy Envisioning with customers, partners, and the extended account team to connect Industry Sales Kits and Horizontal Solution Plays to desired business outcomes.
Create and qualify early-stage opportunities with technical decision-makers, maintain pipeline velocity, resolve blockers, and advance opportunities through the Microsoft Customer Engagement Methodology lifecycle.
Develop customer-focused pitches and demand-generation plans across appropriate channels in partnership with account executives and technical teams.
Coach peers on opportunity initiation, mapping Microsoft priorities to customer opportunities, and applying standards and best practices.

 

Technology Strategy and Roadmapping
Analyze the overall customer environment and identify business and technology gaps that Microsoft solutions can address.
Serve as the strategic link between Microsoft and the customer, aligning the customer’s long-term business strategy with the actions and resources required for execution.
Develop trusted, multi-horizon technology and business roadmaps—typically spanning three or more years—for prominent, complex, or strategic accounts.
Validate strategies and roadmaps with customer stakeholders and incorporate new capabilities, organizational changes, and program dependencies.
Translate customer objectives into an effective industry technology architecture using Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays, including cloud services and consumption-intensive workloads.

 

Trusted Advisor and Customer Advocacy
Maintain broad knowledge of Microsoft’s product portfolio, solutions, and strategy, and apply it to customer business and technology needs.
Coordinate with internal and external industry experts to deepen knowledge of the customer’s industry and competitive landscape.
Represent the voice of the customer by sharing insights, feedback, and challenges with product, engineering, and other internal teams; establish feedback loops and drive action.
Escalate urgent customer issues to the appropriate Microsoft stakeholders and help coordinate solutions.
Provide technical guidance to internal teams and coach subsidiary resources on account strategy, customer context, and industry best practices.
Build executive-level security thought leadership using Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives; position security as a business enabler and orchestrate execution with security specialists.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 7+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, practice building, or related technical/sales/industry experience OR equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years of experience in business consulting, consultative selling, or change management.
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical, support, or partner teams.

Overview
 

Microsoft's Windows, Devices, and Services Marketing organization is seeking a Senior Social Strategy Lead to translate our highest-priority business goals into breakthrough social marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, consideration, advocacy, and growth at scale.  

This role sits at the center of Microsoft's most visible product launches, cultural moments, and brand initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strategic rigor, creative excellence, audience understanding, and campaign leadership to build social experiences that inspire participation and deepen customer connection across platforms.  

The Senior Social Strategy Lead will be responsible for developing the end-to-end social strategy for major campaigns, connecting integrated marketing objectives to platform-native content, creator partnerships, community engagement, and cultural relevance. This individual will influence senior stakeholders, align diverse teams, and ensure social marketing is embedded early in campaign development to maximize impact.  

Success in this role requires a leader who can move seamlessly between strategic planning, creative development, stakeholder influence, and campaign execution while maintaining a relentless focus on customer behavior, business outcomes, and measurable impact.



Responsibilities
 

Social Strategy Leadership 

  • Lead social strategy development for priority product launches, seasonal moments, integrated campaigns, and brand initiatives. 

  • Translate business objectives, audience insights, cultural trends, and integrated campaign platforms into clear social marketing strategies. 

  • Define channel roles, content priorities, customer journeys, and engagement approaches. 

  • Ensure social marketing is represented early in campaign development and strategic planning processes. 

  • Serve as the primary social strategy partner to Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, and Go-to-Market stakeholders. 

  • Present recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and strategic decisions to senior leaders with clarity and confidence. 

Campaign Management 

  • Build full-funnel social marketing strategies that connect awareness, consideration, engagement, and action. 

  • Develop integrated social ecosystems that align content, channels, community engagement, creators, and customer participation. 

  • Establish channel-specific approaches grounded in audience behavior, platform best practices, cultural relevance, and business goals. 

  • Create scalable frameworks and repeatable approaches that elevate campaign effectiveness across the organization. 

  • Drive strategic alignment across multiple teams to ensure a cohesive customer experience throughout campaign lifecycles. 

Content Strategy 

  • Write clear, insight-driven creative and content briefs for internal teams, agency partners, and production partners. 

  • Translate campaign platforms into social-first concepts designed for participation, conversation, discovery, and advocacy. 

  • Guide creative development from concept through launch while protecting strategic intent and platform relevance. 

  • Provide actionable feedback that improves creative quality while ensuring accessibility, brand standards, product accuracy, and customer impact. 

  • Champion innovative storytelling approaches that resonate with audiences where they spend time and engage most deeply. 

Creator & Community Strategy 

  • Define the role of creators and community engagement within broader marketing campaigns. 

  • Partner with Creator Partnerships teams to identify and activate creators who can authentically connect products and audiences. 

  • Develop participation strategies that encourage meaningful engagement, advocacy, and customer conversation. 

  • Ensure creator, community, earned, and owned approaches work together as part of a unified campaign strategy. 

Measurement & Optimization 

  • Partner closely with Social Intelligence and Analytics teams to define success metrics and measurement plans. 

  • Interpret campaign performance insights and translate learnings into future strategic recommendations. 

  • Contribute strategic perspectives to campaign reviews, performance discussions, and best-practice development. 

  • Apply audience, cultural, and performance insights to continuously improve campaign effectiveness. 

Innovation & AI Transformation 

  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to accelerate insight generation, strategic planning, creative development, and workflow efficiency. 

  • Identify opportunities to modernize social marketing practices, improve team effectiveness, and scale impact through innovation. 

  • Stay ahead of changes in platform capabilities, creator ecosystems, customer behavior, and digital culture. 



Qualifications
 

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 3+ years integrated marketing (e.g., digital, relationship, social media, campaign), event management, marketing strategy, business planning, marketing operations, or related work experience OR equivalent experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading social strategy for large-scale consumer marketing campaigns, product launches, or brand initiatives. 

  • Significant experience developing end-to-end social marketing strategies across multiple platforms and audiences. 

  • Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing principles and customer journey planning. 

  • Deep expertise across major social platforms, creator ecosystems, audience behaviors, and platform-native creative. 

  • Experience writing creative briefs and guiding creative development from strategy to execution. 

  • Proven ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive alignment across highly matrixed organizations.

  • Strong program management, planning, prioritization, and stakeholder communication skills. 

  • Ability to evaluate performance insights and translate data into actionable strategic recommendations.

AI systems are rapidly becoming more capable, autonomous, interconnected, and embedded in products people depend on. As models gain memory, tools, identity, and the ability to act across systems, new risks can emerge through long-running interactions, coordinated agents, and behavior spanning accounts, products, and time—often beyond what any individual product or runtime control can see. Within the Artificial Generative Intelligence Security (AeGIS) team, the AI Safety Platform (AISP) is Microsoft's shared AI observability, detection, investigation, and hunting platform built for this new landscape. We connect fragmented activity across Microsoft's AI estate and turn it into reusable detections, investigation-ready evidence, threat intelligence, and customer protection. 

 

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Software Engineer for a deeply consequential technical builder role at the intersection of cybersecurity and generative AI. You will lead through code and ideas: defining detailed architectures, building large-scale data and detection systems, working through security and privacy reviews, and partnering with cross-company leaders, product engineers, applied scientists, threat hunters, and incident responders from early exploration through production operation. The ideal candidate is deeply curious about how AI systems work, how they break, and how to make them safer and more robust. 

 

We are a mission-driven, collaborative team that leans into uncertainty, learns quickly, and builds on one another's ideas. Our people bring a wide range of backgrounds, disciplines, and life experiences, and we believe that diversity makes both our engineering and our judgment stronger. We want someone energized by technically fascinating problems and by the responsibility to protect users at the scale of some of the world's most widely deployed AI platforms. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Design detection infrastructure for attack signatures, pattern matching, behavioral anomaly detection, model-assisted analysis, and emerging research techniques. Apply emerging AI security research to detection, evaluation, observability, and safer implementation patterns.

Develop high-volume data integrations and correlation pipelines that turn multi-source telemetry into investigation-ready evidence, threat intelligence, trends, and reporting.

  • Review designs and code, mentor engineers and scientists, and raise the technical bar across teams.

Shape the platform & infrastructure strategy behind M365 and Copilot. This role takes on the hardest technical and strategic problems spanning storage, performance and scale, fleet and capacity, and LLM infrastructure, connecting decisions across the stack into a coherent platform strategy. 

The M365 Core Platform team is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead high-impact initiatives across Storage Fabric, Performance & Scale, Fleet & Capacity, and LLM API. This is a broad role for someone who can move fluidly across these systems, go deep quickly, and drive problems that do not fit neatly within a single team. 

AI is changing how infrastructure needs to be built and operated. Demand moves at software speed while physical capacity moves at infrastructure speed. Models, hardware, and workloads change continuously. Storage, compute, GPUs, routing, caching, reliability, efficiency, and product policy are increasingly interconnected. 

As a Principal Product Manager, you will take on a small number of the organization's highest-impact strategic problems at a time. You will develop the technical and product thesis, understand the system and its constraints, identify architectural choices and tradeoffs, align teams around a direction, and drive the work to measurable customer, capacity, performance, or efficiency outcomes. 

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use AI agents, automation, data analysis, and rapid prototyping to investigate problems, test hypotheses, model tradeoffs, and accelerate decisions. The role requires systems thinking, technical depth, product judgment, and the ability to operate with significant ambiguity and autonomy. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Connect demand, supply, workload characteristics, model efficiency, infrastructure efficiency, and economics to drive capacity and investment decisions.

  • Define success metrics and communicate complex technical and economic tradeoffs to senior leaders in a way that enables decisions.
  • Mentor PMs and technical leaders and raise the organization's ability to reason about infrastructure as an interconnected system.

Program Leadership

The Machine Intelligence team at Microsoft Research Cambridge conducts foundational research aimed at understanding and advancing machine intelligence. We explore the principles that enable intelligent systems to learn, reason, remember, adapt, communicate, and act effectively in complex environments.

Our research focuses on advancing the core capabilities of future AI systems, including memory and retrieval, reasoning, efficient learning and inference, agentic behaviour, novel model architectures, optimization algorithms, alignment, and human-AI collaboration. We combine theoretical, empirical, and systems research to develop the scientific foundations of the next generation of intelligent systems.

We are seeking a Principal Research Manager to lead and expand this research agenda. The successful candidate will help define the long-term scientific direction of the team, build and mentor outstanding researchers, and drive programs that advance the state of the art in machine intelligence. They will work across disciplines and organisations to connect foundational research with emerging opportunities in products, science, and society.

The most suited candidate combines a distinguished research record with a demonstrated ability to lead people, shape strategy, and identify important scientific questions before they become mainstream. They are excited by both scientific discovery and the challenge of building an environment in which researchers can do their own unique work.



Responsibilities
  • Define and evolve a research agenda that advances the state of the art in machine intelligence.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of researchers, fostering a culture of scientific excellence, collaboration, and inclusion.

  • Drive ambitious research programs from conception through execution and impact.
  • Build collaborations across Microsoft Research, product groups, academia, and other external partners.
  • Communicate research vision, progress, and insights to technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify opportunities to translate foundational research into meaningful impact for products, science, and society.
  • Help shape the long-term direction of machine intelligence research within Microsoft Research.


Qualifications

Required

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in machine learning, computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • An internationally recognized research record with demonstrated contributions in machine learning, artificial intelligence, or related disciplines.

  • Deep technical understanding of modern machine learning methods and the scientific judgment required to identify significant research opportunities.
  • Proven ability to define research strategy, execute against long-term goals, and deliver scientific or real-world impact.

Preferred

  • Experience building partnerships across academia, industry, and product organizations.

Location available - South Paris

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting expertise to quickly identify the cause(s) of issues to quickly identify the cause of issues.

The Strategic Initiatives Director is responsible for leading the orchestration and execution of large, complex strategic engagements with the most strategic customers in the Area, as well as leading area-level initiatives that drive sustainable business growth. This is a senior role that combines strategic sales with generalist problem-solving, with responsibilities around building organizational capability thought leadership, coaching, and apprenticeship. 



Responsibilities

Strategic engagement leadership 

Proactively identifies and determines high-impact parties to partner with/sell to through orchestrating a customer assessment of their current needs and defining a value proposition to meet those needs. Prioritizes and pursues large and transformative market opportunities and trends for Microsoft that provide opportunities for customers to leverage Microsoft platforms/products by identifying, quantifying, and qualifying opportunities. Evaluates opportunities and leads overall planning in cooperation with various internal functions in region and HQ (e.g., field sales, industry and solution specialists, partner development org) to identify and prioritize goals and objectives for an achievable target. 

Leads end-to-end functional thinking and discussions to design and drive customer strategic deals for a commercial strategic framework that are aligned with business objectives and customer current state and needs at an appropriate motion and cadence in cooperation with customers. Oversees that strategic deals incorporate relevant market factors (e.g., competitive, economic, industry specific) to drive optimal results and return on investment. Ensures prospective pipelines and opportunities are built into deals across customers. Empowers a strong customer presence through a deep customer focus and strategic development, attracting and committing customers to the journey through the integration of customer feedback. Drives understanding of customer needs, gains internal customer alignment, and mobilizes partners to achieve the strategy. Facilitates the incorporation and feedback of other internal teams (e.g., product, engineering, finance, legal, sales, marketing) and executive-level leaders to help inform the strategy. 

Provides thought leadership and commercial coaching to peers, team members, and account teams in order to strengthen the team's commercial capability as a durable asset of the organization. 

 

Stakeholder Management 

Identifies appropriate executive-level stakeholders within customers to connect and work with in pursuit of new business generation. Acts as the voice and a trusted advisor for customers/partners across the organization to design and oversee plans/programs. Builds trusted advisor partnerships with executive-level leaders and managers, representing the organization to area/regional leadership. Secures cross-organization investment and resourcing for strategic partnerships - including engagement with HQ teams - and holds those commitments to delivery. 

 

Deal execution 

Leads discussions with customers to align on customer and Microsoft needs and define desired outcomes for strategic customer and partner engagements. Shapes and drives negotiations with existing and new customers and partners, aligning long-term priorities to develop strategically important deals. Identifies and engages key senior stakeholders across Microsoft (e.g., product, engineering, finance, legal, sales, and marketing), secures their support, and drives internal alignment to advance negotiations.

Orchestrates the creation of an action plan that spans across the end-to-end strategic landscape to ensure the deal is properly closed through the integration of reports, risk analyses, driving agreements, and assessing value in strategic deals. Leads conversations and coordinates with Microsoft's legal team to ensure that contracts are signed, that the deal is effectively closed, and that there is compliance between teams. 

Serves as the escalation point and final commercial reviewer for deals led by other team members, and formally mentors less experienced team members through deal cycles so that deal-making capability is transferred, not concentrated.

Continuously evaluates performance and stakeholder feedback to identify gaps, incorporate lessons learned, and improve strategic plans and execution. Drives in-flight adjustments and process improvements to strengthen customer centricity, technological intensity, and execution simplicity.

Apart from strategic customer/partner engagements, lead Area-level strategic projects prioritized by the Area VP to help improve organizational effectiveness and efficiency.

We bring together Microsoft's AI platform, customer expertise, and end-to-end execution capabilities to accelerate adoption, drive transformation, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Microsoft's AI Business Solutions (ABS) organisation is building a specialist team focused on customer consumption of agentic technologies (principally Copilot, Cowork and Copilot Studio). The Solution Sales Specialist, ABS Consumption, works with enterprise customers to identify the roles and recurring business processes where agentic capability creates durable, measurable value, and then supports those customers from initial concept through to production deployment. 

The role combines consultative customer engagement with technical fluency. The specialist partners with account teams, solution engineers, customer success resources and Microsoft partners to establish a named business sponsor, a defined user cohort and an agreed value case in each engagement, and works those engagements through to sustained production use. Success is measured by repeat customer usage, realised customer value and eligible consumption revenue, rather than by licence volume or activity metrics.

Deliver persona-based scenario workshops and executive briefings that demonstrate applied capability against the customer's own business processes.

Capture and publish repeatable implementation patterns from each engagement so that proven approaches can be reused by other account teams, the solution engineering community and Microsoft partners. 

Collaborate with partner organisations to extend proven patterns to a broader set of customers, contributing to partner enablement materials and joint customer engagements. 

Maintain current knowledge of the Microsoft agentic product portfolio, the landscape and the industry and regulatory considerations affecting customer adoption.

Compliance Management - The ability to supervise and observe the organization's conformity to various standards, procedures, rules, and regulations. 

Project Quality Assurance - Knowledge of and the ability to apply systematic and continuing processes of making sure that the project is meeting specified requirements. 

Quality Assurance - Knowledge of and the ability to follow systematic and continuing processes of checking to see whether a product, service, or process is meeting specified requirements. This includes knowledge of quality measurements and defined standards. 

Regulatory Compliance - Knowledge of the rules, regulations, sanctions and other statutory requirements, guidelines and instructions relating to local and/or international governing bodies and organizations, both internally and externally. 

Risk Analysis - Knowledge of Risk Management and Analysis, the process of measuring, or assessing risk and then developing strategies to manage the risk. This may include the ability to identify or develop strategies to transfer the risk to another party, avoid the risk, reduce the negative effect of the risk, and accept some or all of the consequences of a particular risk. 

Construction Planning and Logistics 

Construction - Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in the construction, repair, and engineering of buildings, houses, or other structures such as highways, roads, and bridges.

Construction Management - Knowledge of specialized, project management techniques to oversee the planning, design, and construction of a project, from its beginning to its end. 

Construction Planning - The ability to plan how the team will manage and execute a construction project. 

Construction Processes - Knowledge of the design process (creating the description of a new facility, usually represented by detailed plans and specifications) and the construction planning process (identifying activities and resources required to make the design a physical reality). 

Scope Management - The ability to manage scope over the course of a project, including determining which changes are essential, estimating their impact on the project, ensuring that changes do not expand scope beyond acceptable levels, and keeping a change record to track progress. 

Managing Vendor and Stakeholder Relationships 

Conflict Resolution - The ability to manage conflict, disharmony, and strife among people and situations, while recognizing and addressing sensitivities. 

Incident Handling - The ability to lead and direct others in the process of resolving escalated problems through communication. 

Influence Others - The ability to garner support for initiatives by gaining the respect of others and inspiring trust and confidence. 

Negotiation - The ability to achieve mutually satisfying agreements in negotiations with others by listening to their objectives, acting as the company's representative to effectively communicate the company's objective, and seeking common ground and collaborative solutions. 

Team Facilitation - The ability to lead and orchestrate cross-functional teams to complete objectives. This includes the skills of communicating and collaborating with others, leveraging resources and tools, and coordinating processes. 

Vendor Management - Knowledge of the process through which products and services are purchased for use by the corporation and the ability to identify, select, and manage vendors and suppliers who provide products and services to the company. This includes knowledge of the development of RFI's and RFP's and the ability to incorporate necessary technical requirements into contracts. 

Project Management and Judgement 

Change Management - The ability to define and implement procedures and/or technologies to deal with changes in the environment. This may include adapting to change, controlling change, and/or affecting change. 

Decision Making - The ability to make decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. This includes the ability to define, diagnose, and determine an appropriate resolution, recommendation, or decision while considering alternatives and factors (e.g., resources, costs, tradeoffs). 

Incident Management - The ability to identify, record, classify and apply a structured response process to manage incidents until the affected service is restored. Includes knowledge of the progression of an incident through occurrence of the incident, detection of the incident, diagnosis of the cause of failure, repair of the problem, recovery of the problem back to the live infrastructure and restoration of the service. 

Multitasking - The ability to process and attend to multiple types of information and/or perform multiple tasks simultaneously. 

Problem Solving - The ability to identify problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions. 

Project Management - Knowledge of and the ability to carry out the process of planning, organizing, and managing tasks and resources to accomplish a well-defined objective. This includes the ability to manage and provide project deliverables, optimize the contribution of the people involved, and assess the impact of project decisions on quality, productivity, schedules, cost, performance, etc. 

Project Planning - The ability to manage a project schedule, defining and sequencing activities, estimating activity durations, and developing and controlling the schedule. 

Vendor Selection and Evaluation - The ability to evaluate and select vendors who meet specifications and requirements. This includes knowledge of the development of RFI's and RFP's and the ability to incorporate necessary technical requirements into contracts. 

Other: 

Creativity - The ability to apply ingenuity, inventiveness, and imagination to the inclusive design and construction of a product, service, program, or initiative. 

Oral Communication - The ability to make a verbal message understood and to receive/understand messages during in-person or remote (e.g., telephone) interactions. 

Presentation Skills - The ability to prepare effective presentations in content and function, and to speak competently to the level of the audience.

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

 

The next generation of cloud infrastructure is increasingly constrained not just by compute capability, but by power, performance efficiency, rack density, and how effectively every watt of infrastructure is converted into useful work. 

We are looking for an experienced Principal Platform Power & Performance Engineer to help shape the power and performance architecture of Azure Compute and AI infrastructure. 

In this role, you will work at the intersection of silicon, servers, firmware, operating systems, accelerators, workloads, and datacenter infrastructure. You will characterize real systems, identify efficiency bottlenecks, influence platform architecture, and develop optimizations that improve performance per watt while preserving workload performance and reliability. 

The impact goes well beyond benchmark tuning. Your work can influence how Azure platforms are designed, configured, provisioned, and operated across Compute and AI infrastructure. 

Come join this exciting and growing Cobalt team through our monumental evolution of cloud hardware at Azure and Microsoft!    

 

#SCHIE 



Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end power and performance characterization of next-generation Azure compute platforms, from silicon and server bring-up through workload-level validation. 

  • Analyze the interaction between CPU/GPU utilization, memory, PCIe/I/O, firmware, OS power management, thermals, cooling, and workload behavior. 

  • Identify opportunities to improve: 

    • Performance per watt 

    • Idle and low-utilization efficiency 

    • Energy proportionality 

    • Rack power efficiency and density 

    • Workload throughput within platform power constraints 

  • Develop and evaluate dynamic power/performance-management strategies across idle, partially utilized, and fully loaded systems. 

  • Profile representative cloud and AI workloads to understand where energy is consumed and determine which system-level optimizations deliver meaningful efficiency improvements. 

  • Partner closely with silicon vendors, OEM/ODM partners, firmware teams, OS engineers, Azure Compute and AI infrastructure teams, and datacenter engineering teams to drive improvements from concept through production. 

  • Influence silicon features, BIOS/firmware policies, OS power management, platform controls, thermal strategies, and future hardware architecture using measured engineering data. 

  • Build telemetry and analysis methodologies that connect low-level platform behavior with workload performance and infrastructure-level efficiency. 

  • Diagnose complex cross-layer performance and power issues spanning hardware, firmware, kernel/OS, drivers, accelerators, and workloads. 

  • Translate engineering findings into recommendations that can influence fleet efficiency, capacity utilization, power provisioning, infrastructure cost, and future platform roadmaps. 

  • Provide technical leadership across multiple platform programs, define methodology and strategy, and drive ambiguous cross-organizational problems from investigation to deployment.

  • Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience
  • OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience
  • OR equivalent experience.

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:

Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in server systems/platforms development and validation in computer architecture, systems engineering, platform performance, or power/performance engineering. 

  • Deep understanding of modern server architecture including: 

    • CPU microarchitecture and power states 

    • Memory subsystems 

    • PCIe and high-speed I/O 

    • BIOS/UEFI and firmware 

    • OS/kernel power management 

    • Thermal and cooling behavior 

  • Hands-on experience with platform performance analysis using tools such as Linux perf, hardware performance counters, tracing/profiling tools, telemetry systems, or equivalent Windows/Linux tooling.

  • Experience debugging performance or power issues that cross multiple hardware/software layers. 

  • Proven scripting and data-analysis skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Kusto, or similar technologies. 

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate detailed engineering analysis into decisions for architecture, product, and leadership audiences. 

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly relevant: 

  • Large-scale cloud or hyperscale infrastructure 

  • AMD, Intel, Arm, NVIDIA, or other modern CPU/GPU platforms 

  • GPU and AI/ML workload characterization 

  • Power capping, DVFS, CPU/GPU power states, memory power management, or PCIe power management

  • AI training or inference performance 

  • Performance-per-watt benchmarking 

  • Firmware or BMC-based platform controls 

  • Thermal and fan optimization 

  • Workload-aware or utilization-aware power management 

  • Capacity, rack-density, or datacenter power optimization

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantage to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for engineers with a passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

 We are looking for a Design Verification Engineer to join the team.



Responsibilities

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

  • Own or lead verification of components used in Fabric Interconnect
  • Learn about the design and interact with partner teams to define verification strategies and test plans
  • Develop UVM-based or Formal verification environments and run and debug simulations to drive quality
  • Apply random-stimulus and coverage-based techniques to find bugs and meet test plan goals
  • Innovate to improve verification efficiency through methodologies or tools
  • Apply industry leading generative AI solutions to verification work
  • Coach and mentor others in your areas of expertise
  • Demonstrate Microsoft core values: Customer Focus, Adaptability, Collaboration, Growth Mindset, Drive for Results, Influence for Impact, Judgement, and Diversity & Inclusion
