Overview

The Frontier Transformation Framework helps our customers become Frontier Firms: organizations where AI is part of the operating system the business runs on. The difference between a transformation and a one-off deployment is what happens after go-live. Without a deliberate improvement and optimization discipline, returns erode: adoption plateaus, agents drift, prompt libraries go stale, and high-value agents are starved while low-value ones persist. Intelligent Optimization is the operating discipline that makes AI value compound over time rather than dissipate. The Frontier Transformation team is how the Microsoft Frontier Company, the organization this role sits within, delivers this: a small, senior human-agent team in which each member carries one of the Framework's eight capabilities into the customer, directs a set of digital co-workers to deliver at a scale headcount alone could not, and is designed to fade into a customer counterpart who can carry the work forward. 

We are seeking a Frontier Intelligent Optimization SME to make AI value compound across strategic customer engagements. In this role, you will establish and run the Intelligent Optimization Framework as a permanent operating rhythm, grounded in kaizen and strong facilitation, that redesigns and reruns workflows to outcomes. You will solve the last-mile problem, embedding what gets built into how work actually gets done through standard work, clear ownership, and an execution cadence that makes new ways of working stick, working directly with business owners, operators, champions, and the Value, Skilling, Change, and engineering leads. 

This is a role for people who are energized by making change hold rather than launching it, who can read measurement signals and turn them into the next round of improvement, and who believe a program that ships once and leaves is just a release, not a transformation. You are designed to fade into a customer counterpart who owns the improvement rhythm after the engagement ends. If you are excited by turning AI deployments into value that compounds cycle after cycle, this role is for you. 



Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities 

  • Establish and run the Intelligent Optimization Framework as a permanent, always-on operating rhythm rather than a one-off activity, grounded in kaizen and strong facilitation. 
  • Redesign and rerun workflows to outcomes, running structured improvement cycles in which each measurement cycle feeds and improves the next.
  • Solve the last-mile problem by embedding new ways of working into standard work, clear ownership, and a disciplined execution cadence.
  • Read the Copilot Dashboard and other measurement signals to find where usage is shallow, which roles are stuck, and where behavior change is or is not landing, and convert those signals into prioritized improvements.
  • Continuously refine prompt libraries, enablement materials, and agent configurations based on usage data and Work IQ behavior signals.
  • Detect and correct agent drift, retire or rework low-value agents, and direct further investment toward high-ROI agents.
  • Establish standard work, ownership, and review cadences that make improvements durable and repeatable across teams.
  • Facilitate improvement events and retrospectives that treat friction and feedback as inputs to the next cycle rather than one-off fixes.
  • Capture reusable improvement patterns and playbooks that raise the quality and speed of every subsequent cycle.
  • Transfer the optimization discipline, cadences, and tooling to the customer's own people so the rhythm is sustained after the engagement fades.
  • Recommend and drive the discontinuation of workflows, agents, and enablement assets that are not returning value (including work the engagement itself originally built) to ensure capacity flows to the most important value. 

Success in this role looks like 

  • AI value compounds cycle after cycle rather than plateauing after initial deployment.
  • Adoption deepens, agents stay tuned and current, and prompt libraries and enablement stay fresh.
  • New ways of working stick because they are embedded in standard work, ownership, and an execution cadence.
  • Investment flows to high-ROI agents while low-value ones are reworked or retired.
  • The customer runs the intelligent optimization rhythm independently after the engagement fades.
  • Low value work is deprioritized and stopped. Subtraction is accepted by the customer as a normal part of the improvement rhythm. 


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
    • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) 
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Proven track record running continuous improvement or operational excellence programs that delivered sustained, measurable results.
  • Hands-on experience with kaizen, Lean, or comparable improvement methodologies and facilitation of improvement events.
  • Experience establishing standard work, ownership models, and execution cadences that make change durable.
  • Experience with quality assurance or evaluation practices for production systems.
  • Ability to read operational and adoption metrics and translate them into prioritized improvements.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder-management skills across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work directly with operators and business owners to embed new ways of working into daily operations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. 

Additional or Preferred Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
    • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or equivalent continuous improvement certification.
  • Experience improving AI or automation solutions in production, including managing model, prompt, or agent performance over time.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot adoption and the Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights, and with using usage signals to drive improvement.
  • Understanding of agent operations, including drift detection, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience linking improvement work to value and P&L outcomes.
  • Industry depth in one or more sectors such as Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Energy, or Government.
  • Experience transferring a continuous improvement capability into a client's own organization.

Do you have a passion for turning data into business value with AI? Are you interested in helping Microsoft customers design & deploy cutting-edge data and AI solutions on Microsoft Azure?  
As a Data & AI Consultant you will be responsible for delivering high quality solutions and business outcomes based on the Microsoft data and AI platform. You will have the opportunity to help us create & deliver the next generation of data and AI solutions for our most strategic customers. Our Consulting team offers a collaborative culture where you can contribute your knowledge & experience while learning together as we create cutting-edge data and AI solutions for our customers.

Responsibilities

Demonstrate the ability to adapt to modern technologies and learn quickly. 

Ability to deliver results through teamwork while achieving individual billable attainment goals. 

Ability to focus on customers, proven ability to be client focused, create results, proactive, and collaborate with others. 

Demonstrate a passion for mentoring, supporting peers & sharing knowledge. 

Consume and contribute best practices, lessons learned, and intellectual property (IP) to the global Microsoft community with a focus on continuous improvement. 

Foster senior level client relationships and engage with senior level Microsoft and client stakeholders to drive solution success. 

Display strong time, project, and priority management skills. 

Express excellent communication skills, presentation skills, written skills, customer/partner relationships and expectations management.



Qualifications

Qualifications and Experience: 

  

Need to have a deep technical background with 10+ years of technology-related experience, including 4+ years delivering data and AI solutions on Microsoft Azure (Experience on AWS or GCP will be an added advantage). Require in depth expertise in the following functional areas. 

  

Data Platform & Engineering: 

  • Designing and implementing modern data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL. 

  • Building scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs and Stream Analytics. 

  • Lakehouse and medallion architecture, including Delta and Parquet formats. 

  • Data modelling, query optimization and performance tuning. 

  • Migrating and modernizing legacy data warehouses and on-premises data estates to Azure. 

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python and PySpark. 

  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (ARM, Bicep or Terraform). 

  

AI & Machine Learning: 

  • Designing and delivering generative AI solutions with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and agentic patterns, including retrieval augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering and orchestration frameworks. 

  • Azure Machine Learning for model development, deployment and MLOps. 

  • Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence and Cognitive Services. 

  • Evaluation, grounding and Responsible AI practices. 

  • Copilot and Copilot Studio extensibility. 

  

Governance, Security & Analytics: 

  • Data governance, lineage and cataloguing with Microsoft Purview. 

  • Securing data and AI workloads using Microsoft Entra ID, private networking, Azure Key Vault, RBAC and encryption. 

  • Power BI semantic models and enterprise reporting. 

  • Cost management and platform optimization.

  • DP-900: Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals 

  • AI-900: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals 

  • DP-700: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate

Identifies, navigates, communicates, and influences key customer technical, business, and executive-level stakeholders (including partners). Synthesizes and combines various insights from their team and customer industry regarding business and Information Technology objectives for customer organizations using partnership with other account team leaders. Understands, identifies, and aligns Microsoft solutions, cross-cloud and technical capabilities. Drives conversations with customers to demonstrate alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account. In partnership with key stakeholders and executives, develops and delivers strategic roadmaps for executing program planning and customer-facing program review, prioritizing engagements, and influencing key stakeholder and executive expectations to address agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities to deliver ongoing customer success. Leverages and improves upon methods for identifying, monitoring, and mitigating actual and potential blockers to consumption through data analysis and customer feedback. 

This role sits in the Customer Success Account Management discipline, which maintains an understanding of customers’ industry and business processes — which may include an industry or vertical focus such as Banking, Healthcare or Manufacturing. It promotes adoption of technology by helping customers optimise the utilisation of products, demonstrating features beyond core functionality and ensuring best-practice adoption, and acts as primary point of contact for the customer in a post-sales production environment. 



Responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management 

  • Synthesizes and combines various insights from their team and customer industry regarding business and Information Technology objectives for customer organizations using partnership with other account team leaders. 

  • Identifies customer priorities with shared accountability for the creation of shared customer account plans in support of customer security and resiliency needs and customer objectives specific to the customer's business transformation programs and common to the industry. 

  • Provides leadership to the team to execute support, security, and consumption delivery programs. 

  • Uses industry trends and program delivery progress to identify priority area to drive customer environmental health outcomes. 

  • Shares industry trends with customers in terms of Microsoft current practices for their industry. 

  • Builds and coaches others on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder engagement strategy and models. 

  • Creates, influences, and evolves healthy, strategic relationships with key customer stakeholders, partners, and technical professionals to lead quality and secure solution delivery and health using partnerships with other account team leaders and lead orchestration across internal/external stakeholders. 

  • Expands and holds accountability for executive customer and partner relationships with a focus on leading the definition of business outcomes and how to align Microsoft strategy to customer business priorities. 

  • Identifies, navigates, communicates, and influences key customer technical, business, and executive-level stakeholders (including partners). 

  • Guides and leads conversations to facilitate the achievement of customer business objectives by leveraging their investment in Microsoft.

  • Holds, maintains, and nurtures internal stakeholder relationships. 

  • Influences and challenges senior/executive internal stakeholders. 

  • Leads business value conversations at customer executive levels and coaches others to communicate effectively in business value conversations and incorporates a focus on security and resiliency. 

Customer Success Leadership

  • Leverages, improves upon, and streamline Microsoft delivery management methodologies, processes, and tools to improve and mitigate risks to customer operational health.

  • Leads escalation management and communications for delivery programs in the customer account. 

  • Drives conversations with customers to demonstrate alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account. 

  • Embraces the organizational and customer success strategy to maximize customer's investments and value. 

  • Drives and agrees upon a long-term approach to fuel adoption of Microsoft technology and services in alignment with the customer's goals and objectives, and includes security as a core component. 

  • Drives account team planning, promoting business and technical needs for change to challenge customer thinking that drives transformation towards modern digital approaches. 

  • Aligns with the account team to link Customer Success Plans (CSPs) with account plan priorities and develop bookable programs of work. 

  • Challenges the customer and influences their strategic decision making, driving the case for change towards improved operational health and security. 

  • Leverages and improves upon methods for identifying, monitoring, and mitigating actual and potential blockers (including security and compliance concerns) to consumption through data analysis and customer feedback. 

  • Mobilizes resources to address actual and potential blockers to consumption, ensure delivery on and continuously refine Customer Success Plans (CSPs), and identify opportunities for consumption optimization. 

  • Holds accountability for identified consumption milestones and their completion. 

  • Partners with customers to understand their business objectives and priorities, identify cross-selling and add-on opportunities, optimize usage, drive adoption, prioritize Microsoft products and services delivery to meet the most critical agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities, and develop and execute CSPs to meet them in order to manage consumption holistically across the entire portfolio. 

  • Proactively drives business growth strategies. 

Technical Relevance 

  • Understands, identifies, and aligns Microsoft solutions, cross-cloud and technical capabilities (e.g., Azure, Security, Modern Work, Dynamics) to expand upon and accelerate customer needs and priorities. 

  • Leverages deep foundational industry, technical expertise, and visionary mindset to enable customer success. 

  • Articulates cross-cloud technology, solutions, and services in a compelling way to internal and external stakeholders. 

  • Evangelizes Microsoft's position in the customers' cloud technology marketplace against competitors. 

  • Leverages understanding of the customer's technology platform and Microsoft's technology roadmap to enable customer digital transformation. 



Qualifications

Required / minimum qualifications 

  • Bachelors or Master's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science, or related field AND 10+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND 6+ years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR equivalent experience. 

Additional or preferred qualifications 

  • Microsoft or competitor equivalent (e.g., AWS) certification in relevant technologies (e.g., Azure, 365). 

  • Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification or equivalent service management certification. 

  • Project Management Institute (PMI) or equivalent Project Management certification. 

  • Prosci or equivalent certification.

Overview

Join the Microsoft Devices Operations (MDO) team as a Senior Sourcing Engineer for Integrated Components (ICs), where you will own the end-to-end sourcing strategy and business performance for critical semiconductor technologies that power Surface, Xbox, and other programs.

This high-impact role serves as the accountable leader for supplier strategy, commercial outcomes, supply continuity, and long-term category health. You will shape sourcing decisions from early technology engagement and product development through commercialization and lifecycle management, partnering closely with Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Operations, and Legal teams to deliver resilient, cost-effective, and industry-leading hardware solutions.

Success in this role requires a unique combination of technical acumen, commercial expertise, strategic thinking, and executive influence. You will build and lead relationships with some of the world's most critical semiconductor suppliers, drive complex negotiations, develop long-term sourcing and resiliency strategies, and navigate dynamic market conditions to ensure Microsoft maintains a competitive advantage.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy and supply chain performance for assigned semiconductor and IC categories, from technology selection and supplier engagement through commercialization, production, and lifecycle management.
  • Serve as the single accountable leader for supplier strategy, commercial outcomes, supply continuity, risk management, and overall business performance within the category.
  • Develop and execute long-term sourcing strategies that align supplier roadmaps, technology capabilities, capacity plans, and commercial frameworks with Microsoft Devices product and business objectives.
  • Lead executive-level supplier relationships, driving strategic partnerships, commercial negotiations, Product Supply Agreements, and performance commitments that deliver competitive advantage and sustained value.
  • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Finance, Operations, and Legal to influence critical design, sourcing, and business decisions, balancing technology requirements, cost, quality, resiliency, and time-to-market.
  • Drive end-to-end supplier selection and qualification processes, evaluating technical capabilities, manufacturing readiness, capacity, financial health, and long-term strategic fit.
  • Own supply chain resiliency strategies, including multi-sourcing, alternate source qualification, capacity planning, and business continuity initiatives to mitigate risk and ensure uninterrupted supply.
  • Anticipate and resolve systemic supply chain challenges impacting quality, cost, delivery, lead times, or capacity, leading cross-functional teams to deliver sustainable solutions.
  • Lead contracting activities and commercial governance, ensuring agreements appropriately address business objectives, intellectual property protection, supply commitments, operational flexibility, and risk allocation.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, supply assurance, and operational performance through data-driven decision making, supplier performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Champion strategic initiatives with internal stakeholders and suppliers, influencing decisions across organizational boundaries and driving alignment on complex, high-impact business priorities.
  • Provide thought leadership on market dynamics, supplier ecosystems, technology trends, and sourcing best practices, shaping long-term category and supply chain strategy.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Materials Science, or related field AND 3+ years experience in procurement, supply chain, sourcing, engineering, operations, or relevant sales-related roles.
    • OR Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Materials Science, or related field AND 4+ years experience in procurement, supply chain, sourcing, engineering, operations, or relevant sales-related roles.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience sourcing semiconductors, ASICs, SoCs, memory, connectivity solutions, power management ICs, or other advanced electronic components.
  • Demonstrated experience owning business outcomes across the full supplier lifecycle, from technology selection and supplier strategy through commercialization, production, and ongoing supply chain performance.
  • Experience managing strategic sourcing and supplier relationships within the semiconductor or electronics industry.
  • Experience in supplier negotiations, commercialization, capacity planning, and supply chain risk management.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive complex business decisions.
  • Demonstrated analytical and commercial acumen with a track record of improving cost, quality, and supply performance.
  • Experience leading supplier qualification, contracting, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor technologies, market trends, and global supplier ecosystems.
  • Effective communication, stakeholder management, and executive engagement skills.

Overview

The AI Transformation team within Microsoft Frontier Company is reimagining how the company operates in the age of AI. We work across the business to transform critical end-to-end workflows, bringing people, AI agents, and systems together to create fundamentally new ways of working.

Our team is multidisciplinary, including design, applied AI, engineering, program leadership, and business transformation to move rapidly from opportunity to working solution. We operate with a builder mindset: hands-on, highly collaborative, comfortable with ambiguity, and biased toward action. Our goal is not simply to add AI to existing processes, but to build AI-native operating models and reusable solutions that improve how Microsoft Frontier Company works and accelerate transformation at scale.

We are looking for an AI Experience Designer with deep expertise in human-centred product design, and design research to help improve how MFC operates. The people running MFC handle work that is complicated and rarely tidy. This role exists to put better evidence in their hands and take the mechanical weight off them, so that more of their day goes into the work only they can do. Agents are our medium, alongside the wider AI capability we will be building. What is undecided is what a good agent experience looks like in the hands of the people who depend on it.

This is a product design role first. You will study the work as it is done, prototype, test with the people doing it, and ship. What differs is the material. You are not designing software that waits to be told what to do. You are designing for systems that act on someone's behalf, while that person still carries the outcome.

You will work on the coherence of agent experiences across MFC: the interaction patterns, the moments of handover, the points where a person steps back in. Human judgement is not a fallback in this work. It is something you design for on purpose, wherever consequence or ambiguity means a person should hold the decision. The role requires comfort in ambiguous problem spaces and the ability to frame the right question before an answer is available.

You will do this alongside a globally distributed team of Engineers, Data Scientists, Technical Program Managers, and other Designers. None of it is solved by design alone.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • ​Learn how people work today: what they are trying to get done, what they have to keep track of, where they hesitate, and what they do when a tool does not fit. Then design better ways for them to work with agents and the AI capability around them. This includes permissions, consent, delegation, revocation, and clear limits on what an agent may do and on whose behalf.
  • Design so that people can see when an agent is at work and decide for themselves how far to rely on it. The Enterprise Architect joins the Americas Markets & Industries (AMI) Office of the CTO to work directly with Microsoft's most strategic customers in Canada. Based in Toronto, you will partner with senior technology leaders to shape the technical strategy behind their most ambitious cloud and AI initiatives, translating business objectives into strategies and patterns that deliver measurable outcomes at enterprise scale. You will engage across a broad range of technologies, solve complex business and technical challenges, and help customers accelerate innovation while building secure, resilient, and scalable platforms. 

 

As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with customer executives, architects, engineers, and Microsoft account teams to guide technology decisions, remove obstacles, and drive successful adoption of Microsoft's platform capabilities. You will provide technical leadership throughout the customer journey, share best practices across the field, mentor technical communities, and help raise the quality and consistency of Microsoft's engagements across Canada.

 

As part of the AMI Office of the CTO, you will help connect customer needs, industry trends, and real-world implementation experience back into Microsoft. You will collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to ensure customer feedback influences our products and strategy while strengthening Microsoft's ability to serve Canadian enterprises in addition to broader divisional initiatives and customers. We value curiosity, collaboration, technical excellence, customer obsession, and a growth mindset, and we're looking for a leader who can navigate ambiguity, build trusted relationships, and create meaningful impact for customers and Microsoft alike.  Based in the Greater Toronto Area, you will be required to meet customers on site frequently in the Microsoft Toronto location. 

 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Design

Trusted Advisor

Thought Leadership

You will work across application, platform, and service boundaries to make remote Windows experiences feel secure, responsive, dependable, and deeply integrated with the operating system.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving team that values technical depth, customer focus, engineering craftsmanship, and end-to-end ownership. You will also help other engineers grow through design guidance, code reviews, debugging support, and mentoring.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and ship native Windows client features using modern C++, C# and integrate deeply with Win32, WinRT, COM, Windows services, and operating-system APIs.
  • Work on Windows App scenarios across resource discovery, connection setup, authentication, OS integration, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop secure, scalable, and maintainable components that span processes, threads, services, client applications, and cloud-backed experiences.
  • Diagnose complex problems using debuggers, dumps, traces, logs, and telemetry, including issues involving concurrency, memory, networking, latency, and operating-system integration.
  • Partner with Windows, Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, identity, security, design, and product teams to deliver coherent end-to-end customer experiences.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Production experience designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping software in modern C++ and C# is also valuable.
  • Experience building native Windows applications, platform components, services, or other systems-level software.
  • Solid software design, debugging, problem-solving, and performance-analysis skills.
  • Knowledge of Windows systems technologies such as Win32, WinRT, COM, RPC, Windows services, inter-process communication, and core Windows APIs.
  • Experience debugging multi-process, multi-threaded, performance-critical native code, including memory, concurrency, latency, and reliability issues.
  • Experience with Windows App SDK, WinUI, XAML, WebView2, MSIX, or related Windows client technologies.

Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantage to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the SCIPS (Shared and Custom IP & Silicon) team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Security IP Design Engineer to join the team.

#SCHIE #CSME



Responsibilities

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

· Own end-to-end development of security IPs from architecture and microarchitecture definition through silicon validation.

· Collaborate with architecture, SoC, firmware, verification, and physical design teams to deliver high-quality IP solutions.

· Develop high-performance, power-efficient RTL designs and drive PPA optimization across the design lifecycle.

· Lead design signoff activities including CDC, RDC, LINT, synthesis, STA, and timing closure.

· Implement and integrate hardware security technologies such as cryptographic accelerators, root-of-trust, secure boot, and key management.

· Drive pre-silicon and post-silicon debug, silicon bring-up, and root-cause analysis of complex system issues.

· Mentor engineers and champion design excellence through reviews, automation, and continuous methodology improvements.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.

The role combines industry insight, enterprise-grade engineering, change leadership and Microsoft’s Intelligence + Trust platform to create differentiated outcomes that customers can own, operate and continuously improve. 

 

This sales-aligned technical leadership role combines executive engagement, transformation strategy, architecture, commercial accountability and end-to-end deal orchestration. The successful candidate brings rounded technical leadership across cloud infrastructure, applications, data, security and AI, with sufficient depth to shape enterprise-scale architectures and mobilise specialists when required. They connect customer priorities to a robust transformation roadmap, a credible and optimised consumption plan, the right commercial construct, and a practical path to production and value realisation.

Business and Commercial Outcome Leadership — Translates customer priorities into measurable business outcomes, adoption milestones, consumption growth and a credible commercial construct. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Microsoft is one of the largest enterprise service companies in the world.

Security represents one of the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. The Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is accountable for managing and prioritizing cybersecurity risks for Microsoft. This team oversees the company’s overall cyber defense, including the security of Microsoft products and business operations, and collaborates with Engineering teams to advance Secure Future Initiative (SFI) objectives. 

Security is a core priority for Microsoft, and Identity and Access Management protections are essential to protecting Microsoft at global scale. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing team of Software Engineers, building the next generation of cloud-native platform services that power Microsoft's tenant management and identity ecosystem. This role combines deep technical leadership with people leadership to deliver highly scalable distributed systems, modern engineering platforms, intelligent automation, and AI-native engineering practices that strengthen Microsoft's security posture while simplifying engineering operations



Responsibilities
  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of Software Engineers building secure, cloud-native platform services that power Microsoft's tenant lifecycle management, orchestration, identity governance, and application governance capabilities.
  • Define the engineering vision, technical strategy, and architecture for next-generation platform capabilities spanning tenant lifecycle automation, workflow orchestration, and AI-enabled engineering experiences.
  • Drive the design and delivery of scalable distributed systems, APIs, platform services, and data-driven solutions that improve security, operational efficiency, and developer productivity.
  • Partner across engineering, product, identity, security, data, and infrastructure teams to translate customer needs into integrated platform capabilities while driving cross-organizational execution.
  • Champion engineering excellence by fostering AI-native software development, modern engineering practices, secure-by-design principles, high-quality architecture, testing, code quality, and operational readiness.
  • Lead platform modernization through cloud-native architectures, API-first design, Infrastructure as Code, automation, CI/CD, observability, and data-driven engineering practices.
  • Establish operational excellence by building resilient services with comprehensive monitoring, telemetry, live-site readiness, incident management, and continuous service improvements.
  • Drive execution across multiple engineering investments by managing technical priorities, dependencies, resources, and delivery commitments while balancing long-term platform strategy with near-term business objectives.
  • Build an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture by attracting, developing, and mentoring exceptional talent while empowering engineers to innovate, collaborate, and grow.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years of technical engineering experience designing and building large-scale software systems with coding experience in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++ or C#
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of people management experience leading high-performing Software Engineering teams delivering cloud-native applications, distributed systems, platform services, or enterprise engineering platforms.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating highly available, mission-critical distributed systems or cloud-native platform services at enterprise scale.
  • Experience leading engineering organizations through architecture evolution, platform modernization, and delivery of complex technical initiatives using modern engineering practices, including secure software development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Demonstrated success driving cross-organizational execution and influencing engineering strategy across multiple teams and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years of technical engineering experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10+ years of technical engineering experience
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of people management experience leading multiple engineering teams.
  • Experience building enterprise-scale identity, security, governance, tenant management, or platform engineering solutions.
  • Experience building and operating cloud-native services using Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, containers, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and modern platform engineering practices.
  • Experience leading platform modernization initiatives involving workflow orchestration, automation frameworks, platform APIs, infrastructure as code, and developer platforms.
  • Experience driving engineering excellence through architecture governance, engineering quality, reliability engineering, telemetry, observability, live-site operations, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience leading AI-native engineering transformations by integrating AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, and data-driven engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence long-term technical strategy and build trusted partnerships across engineering, product, identity, security, infrastructure, and executive leadership.
  • Proven track record of attracting, developing, and retaining diverse engineering talent while building an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.

As a Critical Environment CMMS Technician, you will play a key role in supporting the operational integrity of Microsoft’s datacenters by coordinating administrative, procurement, vendor and maintenance activities. You will be managing the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) and ensure that all preventive and corrective maintenance activities are accurately tracked, scheduled, and completed in alignment with compliance standards and operational protocols. You will work closely with technicians, internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure work orders, purchase orders, documentation and systems are accurately managed and completed in accordance with established processes, compliance requirements and operational standards.

 

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.  

 

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 400+ datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.  

 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals.

  • Build and maintain accurate Planned Preventive Maintenance Schedules, ensuring alignment with CE standards and scope items.

  • Ensure consistent application of CMMS practices across the campus in alignment with regional and global requirements.

  • Analyze CMMS data trends to identify performance gaps, risks, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Develop and maintain maintenance plans within the CMMS in alignment with approved preventive maintenance strategies, ensuring all required activities are accurately configured and scheduled in the system.
  • Support CE inventory management by maintaining accurate records within CMMS.
  • Create, modify, and maintain asset, location, and equipment data as required.

  • Monitor statistics and key performance indicators in Power BI’s to ensure compliance with internal requirements, established standards, and applicable processes.

  • Highly organized and detail oriented, with strong coordination and communication skills.

  • Experience with vendor coordination and incident response.

Overview

At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a fast-growing, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business. 

Within SME&C, our Customer Success organization empowers Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) partners to build durable, AI-first support practices through our Unified for Partners (UFP) Practice Builders. As more customers are served through the partner channel, our partners play an increasingly central role in resolving cases independently and driving customer outcomes. The Principal Partner Success Manager (PSM) is the delivery-oriented specialist who helps partners mature their support capabilities and become self-sufficient—reducing escalations to Microsoft and delivering the best experience and fastest resolution for customers. 

As a Principal Partner Success Manager, you will work with a portfolio of top partners to benchmark their support maturity across organizational, operational, and technical dimensions using the Support Capability Benchmark. You will co-author a joint execution plan with Customer Success Account Managers (CSAMs) and Service Managers, and deliver the technical briefings, success programs, and operational intellectual property (IP) that build partner support self-sufficiency. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone energized by improving how partners operate. Your core measure of success is helping partners reduce their escalation rate to Microsoft while lifting case deflection and self-resolution. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities

Support Capability Benchmarking 

  • Benchmark Customer Success Capability. Lead structured Support Capability Benchmark assessments with assigned partners to baseline support maturity across organizational posture, operational capability, and technical capability; surface strengths and priority gaps. 

  • Prioritize. Prioritize the highest-impact focus areas with the partner and map each to the right Microsoft proactive services, learning paths, and certifications. 

Joint Execution Planning 

  • Co-author the plan. Co-author a joint, partner-endorsed execution plan with Customer Success Account Managers (CSAMs) and Service Managers, securing partner sign-off on goals, owners, and milestones. 

  • Align to priorities. Align the plan to the partner’s business priorities and to Microsoft’s support self-sufficiency outcomes. 

Support Self-Sufficiency & Deflection 

  • Drive self-sufficiency. Drive partner support self-sufficiency by analyzing top call drivers and the partner’s support operations, and by scaling support best practices that increase case deflection and self-resolution. 

  • Reduce escalations. Own reduction of the partner’s escalation rate to Microsoft as your core accountability, helping partners resolve more cases independently. 

 

Capability Delivery 

  • Deliver enablement. Deliver Support Technical Briefings, Support Success Programs, and operational IP that mature the partner’s organizational, operational, and technical support posture across Azure, Microsoft 365, and identity and security. 

  • Position services. Position proactive services and case-enablement assets (for example, incident readiness, reliability and observability, and Well-Architected reviews) to create measurable deflection. 

Rhythm of Business 

  • Review progress. Track progress against the execution plan and contribute to Partner Success Delivery Reviews (PSDRs) with sponsoring partner leaders, adjusting focus as the partner matures. 

  • Orchestrate the team. Orchestrate delivery across the account team (CSAM, Cloud Solution Architect, Service Manager, and Partner Development Manager) and engage Microsoft technical resources when specialized help is needed. 

Trusted Advisor 

  • Advise partners. Serve as a trusted support-delivery advisor to partner support and services leaders, building durable relationships grounded in outcomes rather than transactions. 

Other 

  • Embody our Culture and Values. 



Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years of experience in customer success, support delivery, technical account or service management, partner management, consulting, or related field 

    • OR equivalent experience. 

  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English fluency　（English resume required）

Additional or Preferred Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s Degree AND 10+ years relevant experience, OR Master’s Degree AND 8+ years relevant experience, OR equivalent experience. 

  • Experience working with or within Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) partners, systems integrators, or managed service providers. 

  • Working knowledge of support operations concepts such as incident and escalation management, monitoring and observability, root cause analysis, case deflection, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 

  • Experience conducting maturity assessments or capability benchmarks and translating findings into actionable improvement plans. 

  • Experience delivering technical briefings, workshops, or proactive services to technical and business audiences. 

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure AZ-104 / AZ-305, Microsoft 365 MS-102, Security SC-300, or ITIL). 

  • Technical breadth across one or more Microsoft cloud areas (Azure, Microsoft 365, and/or identity and security).

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties.

Develops awareness of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation components: Incident Management and Change Management.

Microsoft Quantum is working to build scalable quantum computing systems through advances in quantum devices, cryogenic complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (Cryo-CMOS) electronics, advanced packaging, system architecture, software, and cloud infrastructure. This work brings together disciplines across the computing stack to help scientists tackle problems that are beyond the reach of today’s computing platforms. Learn more about our team at Microsoft Quantum.

We are seeking a Senior/Principal Power Signal Integrity Engineer to help define the electrical architecture of next-generation Cryo-CMOS quantum control systems. You will design and analyze power delivery, signal integrity, and electrical isolation strategies across silicon, package, and board-level implementations. In this role, you'll help solve one of the industry's hardest mixed-signal problems: getting large-scale digital control systems to work alongside extremely sensitive qubit control and measurement circuitry. This work draws on expertise in power delivery networks, mixed-signal integration, electromagnetic coupling, and silicon-package-board co-design.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Define and drive power integrity and signal integrity strategy for next-generation Cryo-CMOS quantum control systems.
  • Own electrical integrity across silicon, package, PCB, interconnect, and system-level implementations.

Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment.

 

The Data Systems group at Microsoft Research works on problems in data management in the era of cloud computing and artificial intelligence. We work on large-scale cloud data platforms including aspects such as resource management, storage, hardware-accelerated query processing, query optimization, and auto-tuning. Another area of interest is discovery and curation of data in the context of data lakes. We are also exploring how to enable users and AI agents to interact with data systems safely and efficiently.

 

Our research innovations have been incorporated into Microsoft products and services including SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Microsoft Fabric, Dynamics 365, Microsoft Excel, and Power Query. Our research has also led to open-source software.

 

Our work has also had significant impact on academia. We publish at top venues including SIGMOD, VLDB, CIDR, OSDI, and NeurIPS. Our research has received multiple best-paper, influential-paper, and test-of-time awards, including Best Paper and Best Paper Honorable Mention at VLDB 2026 and Best Industry Paper at SIGMOD 2026.

 

As a Research Intern, you will collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to advance the state-of-the-art in data systems. Research Internship projects emphasize research innovation with the potential for real-world impact.



Responsibilities

Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer.

Required Qualifications

  • Accepted or currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science or related STEM field.

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) powers the infrastructure behind Microsoft's Intelligent Cloud, delivering the foundational technologies that support services including Azure, Microsoft 365, Teams, Bing, Xbox Live, and more. As Microsoft continues to advance AI innovation, SCHIE is developing AI-native silicon and system-level solutions that enable next-generation AI training and inference at hyperscale.
 
The Platform Systems Engineering (PSE) team is seeking a Principal AI Network Hardware Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, bring-up, validation, optimization, and deployment of networking infrastructure for Microsoft's MAIA AI platform. This role combines networking hardware, systems architecture, AI infrastructure, and large-scale deployment to deliver industry-leading AI performance and reliability.
You will work across the networking stack, spanning high-speed SerDes, optics, cables, NICs, PHYs, switch silicon, AI communication frameworks, and distributed training systems. As a Principal engineer, you will influence architectural direction, guide technical strategy, and collaborate across silicon, firmware, hardware, software, validation, manufacturing, and Azure engineering teams.
This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI networking infrastructure and drive technologies that power Microsoft's next generation of hyperscale AI systems.
 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 


Responsibilities

AI Network Architecture & System Integration 

  • Define and develop networking requirements for large-scale AI training and inference clusters. 

  • Collaborate with silicon, system software, firmware, hardware, and Azure infrastructure teams to deliver scalable networking solutions from concept through datacenter deployment. 

  • Participate in architecture reviews and influence next-generation AI networking roadmaps. 

  • Define network concepts of operation, serviceability requirements, telemetry requirements, and operational models for AI infrastructure. 

Layer 3 / Layer 4 Networking 

  • Lead design and validation of IP-based AI networking solutions spanning TCP/IP, UDP, routing, congestion management, flow control, QoS, and traffic engineering. 

  • Analyze transport-layer behavior and performance characteristics across large-scale distributed AI workloads. 

  • Evaluate network protocol implementations and debug issues impacting latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability. 

  • Drive optimization of network communication paths supporting distributed AI training and inference. 

RDMA & AI Fabric Technologies 

  • Design, validate, and optimize RDMA-based networking solutions for AI clusters. 

  • Analyze RDMA performance, congestion behavior, packet loss, retransmissions, and collective communication efficiency. 

  • Work closely with networking vendors and software teams to optimize AI fabric performance and workload scalability. 

  • Develop validation methodologies for AI traffic patterns and collective communication workloads. 

Performance Characterization & Validation 

  • Develop and execute networking validation strategies covering functionality, performance, scale, interoperability, resiliency, and reliability. 

  • Characterize network behavior under AI training and inference workloads. 

  • Evaluate latency, bandwidth utilization, congestion events, flow distribution, and workload communication patterns. 

  • Create and automate network stress, scale, and performance qualification methodologies. 

Debugging & Root Cause Analysis 

  • Lead end-to-end troubleshooting of networking issues across physical, data link, network, and transport layers. 

  • Perform packet-level analysis and protocol debugging using telemetry, packet captures, performance counters, and diagnostic tools. 

  • Investigate network switch, NIC, RDMA, routing, congestion control, and protocol-related issues. 

  • Drive corrective actions and long-term reliability improvements using fleet telemetry and lab validation. 

Automation & Observability 

  • Build and improve network observability, diagnostics, telemetry, and monitoring solutions. 

  • Develop tools and automation for network validation, performance analysis, and failure detection. 

  • Improve engineering productivity through automated testing, qualification, and network health assessment frameworks.

    • OR equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of experience in NW HW development
  • 8+ years of experience in GPU based SU/SO development
  • 8+ years of hands on experience with HS interface architecture and development

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  • Experience with RDMA technologies, AI fabrics, and distributed training environments.
  • Understanding of RoCE, congestion control, ECN, PFC, DCQCN, and related AI networking technologies.

The Online Forensics team sits within the Microsoft AI Experiences organization, where we protect the monetization network that funds the products people use every day. Because attackers adapt quickly, effective defense must anticipate emerging abuse—not just respond to incidents. You will establish authoritative ground truth on fraud, surface evolving tactics, identify vulnerabilities before they are exploited at scale, and produce the signals, datasets, and test scenarios partner defense teams need.

As a Principal Applied Scientist on the Online Forensics team, you will shape the scientific strategy for protecting Microsoft’s monetization network. You will assess threats in monetization and advertising flows and LLM-native systems, track adversary behavior and infrastructure, design safe adversarial simulations, and develop test harnesses and investigation platforms that expose blind spots early. When material incidents occur, you will lead rigorous reconstruction and convert validated findings into labeled ground truth, candidate signals, and regression scenarios that partner defense teams can use to strengthen defenses.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.



Responsibilities
  • Identify emerging fraud tactics, adversary infrastructure, and evasion patterns across monetization flows and LLM-native systems through threat modeling, behavioral, graph-based, temporal, and cross-surface big data analysis.
  • Assess high-risk assumptions and attack paths by forming explicit threat hypotheses, identifying observable signals, and validating risk through structured modeling, targeted experiments, and quantitative measurement.
  • Design safe adversarial simulations that expose blind spots, then convert the results into test harnesses, monitored indicators, and reproducible regression scenarios for sister defense teams.
  • Establish authoritative ground truth by correlating evidence across accounts, traffic, transactions, providers, devices, and infrastructure; reconstruct attack chains and document their provenance, confidence, scale, and economic exposure.
  • Develop shared investigation infrastructure, agent-assisted services, and reusable libraries for telemetry analysis, entity resolution, attack-sequence reconstruction, and reproducible case analysis and convert into actionable insights.
  • When material incidents occur, lead end-to-end reconstruction, document actionable findings, and support the sister teams responsible for remediation and enforcement through validation of closure.
  • Shape the scientific and technical strategy for monetization fraud intelligence, validation, and investigation capabilities across organizational boundaries.
  • Embody our Culture and Values.

    • OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR equivalent experience.

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 9+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated experience proactively identifying and investigating adversarial abuse at web scale through hypothesis-driven analysis of large-scale traffic or transaction telemetry and entity resolution across complex ecosystems.

Solution Engineer, Data & AI

Help Denmark’s leading organizations turn data into real-world impact

Do you believe the best Data & AI solutions are built by people who are curious, pragmatic and willing to challenge conventional thinking?

We are looking for a  Solution Engineer, Data & AI to join Microsoft’s Cloud & AI Solution Engineering team in Denmark. You will work with some of Denmark’s most ambitious organisations, helping them modernise their data platforms, prepare their data for AI and turn new technology into measurable business outcomes.

This is not a traditional pre-sales role. You will combine deep technical expertise with creativity, commercial understanding and a hands-on approach. You will engage directly with customers, shape technical strategy and prove what is possible through architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototyping, proofs of concept and collaborative build engagements.

You may come from a large technology company, a consultancy, a scale-up or a startup where you have helped build new platforms, products or capabilities from the ground up. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, simplify complexity and turn ambitious ideas into solutions that work.



Responsibilities
  • Lead technical sales conversations with customer technical and business decision-makers, using consultative discovery to understand requirements and connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
  • Design and recommend secure, scalable, resilient, and governed Data & AI architectures across database, analytics, data engineering, integration, and AI scenarios.
  • Lead architecture sessions, technical workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, and pilots to validate solutions and influence technical decisions.
  • Work hands-on with customers to address technical requirements, resolve blockers, and guide the modernization and migration of database, data, and analytics workloads.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer architects, engineers, developers, data leaders, and business decision-makers, acting as a technical advisor throughout the sales and solution lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with Microsoft account teams, specialists, Solution Engineers, engineering teams, customer success teams, and partners to develop technical plans and support successful implementation and adoption.
  • Maintain and grow technical expertise across Data & AI and cloud technologies, sharing customer insights, technical knowledge, and reusable practices with the wider Solution Engineering community.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Technical pre-sales, technical consulting, technology sales, solution engineering, technology delivery, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with database solutions, analytical workloads, data engineering, or related Data & AI technologies in cloud or hybrid environments.
  • Experience engaging with customers and technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical concepts, and translate customer needs into technical solutions.
  • Experience delivering technical engagements such as architecture workshops, demonstrations, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, or pilots.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, or comparable cloud data technologies.

  • Experience designing or advising on end-to-end data architectures spanning operational databases, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI scenarios.
  • Consultative technical selling skills, including discovery, active listening, storytelling, objection handling, and influencing technical and business decision-makers.
