Overview

As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will help to maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our datacenters up and running. This could be anything from performing basic monitoring and inspection, performing various types of maintenance, participating in equipment troubleshooting, enforcing all safety and security requirements, and developing methods of operating procedures (MOPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. 

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. 

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays. 

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties.



Responsibilities

Critical Environment Culture

  • Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures are met, to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance to applicable Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations, and Microsoft requirements. Recognizes safe versus unsafe working conditions and responds accordingly (e.g., stop/pause tasks, stand down vendors where necessary). Escalates immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed. Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs. Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EHS) objectives. Actively maintains safe working conditions at all times. Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.
Equipment and Systems Maintenance
  • Provides necessary escort to third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site based on the appropriate procedure levels of risk (LOR). Takes part in getting third-party work underway (e.g., making sure systems are properly energized/deenergized), ensuring the work is started and completed in a safe manner in accordance with standard practices, procedures, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations. Ensures work performed by suppliers/vendors is performed to scope, all documentation is performed correctly, and escalates as appropriate. Recognizes circumstances when to stop supplier/vendor work to address potential and/or identified concerns. Coordinates per appropriate LOR applicable to preventative and/or corrective maintenance. Identifies and recommends procedure corrections if/when errors are detected or when appropriate. Reviews and completes appropriate work orders to support approval of vendor supplier field service reports or invoices.
  • Performs troubleshooting of equipment and systems independently within their trained discipline(s). Documents issues found in troubleshooting process within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Ensures equipment and system settings are consistent with established parameters and designs. Communicates and/or escalates troubleshooting issues or anomalies with assistance from more experienced colleagues. Has a hands-on understanding of how equipment works within disciplines they have been trained.
  • Prepares and submits required reports (e.g., turnover, preventative maintenance [PM]) as assigned following preexisting scripts and templates. Develops methods of operating procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and/or digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) for appropriately leveled procedures to ensure safe and reliable execution. Documents completed work using approved tools and procedural templates for more experienced technician review. Completes and provides coaching to support less experienced technicians for mandatory, technical, and procedural training assignments.
  • Develops an understanding of method statement of work (MSOW) documents. Coordinates activities and associated schedules with contractors. Performs inspections of equipment in a facility. Participates in testing and commissioning activities.
  • Performs various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs (e.g., basic replacements, changing of parts) for specific disciplines and equipment for which they have been trained, following methods of procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) with minimal supervision - in consideration of Task Hazard Analysis (THA), Method Statement of Work (MSOW), or varying permit requirements. Communicates and/or escalates maintenance activities per established process and procedure. Prioritizes maintenance activities as required and/or appropriate. Documents tasks or issues during maintenance activities within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Performs lower level maintenance with minimal supervision, and may resolve high level issues with support from more experienced colleagues. Follows recommended maintenance schedules. Maintains all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and understands levels of risk (LORs) associated with varying types of maintenance.
Equipment and Systems Operations
  • Safely responds to and stabilizes abnormal conditions within the required timeframes for various abnormal facility events within data center with minimal supervision, utilizing emergency operating procedures (EOPs). Gathers necessary information and participates in the creation of incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition as required. Identifies appropriate parties to mitigate incidents as they occur. Assists in developing emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) in relation to incidents. Assists in providing emergency monitoring response to irregular or malfunctioning conditions.
  • Works on tasks (e.g., making rounds, initial assessments on equipment performance) as assigned with varying levels of supervision, sometime minimal. Supports senior colleagues as an assistant. Builds knowledge in operating equipment and systems within a set discipline (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls). Operates all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner.
  • Utilizes internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work. Tracks hours for performed tasks within applicable task management systems. Adds required data, documents, logs changes, and upkeeps procedures related to building management systems and reports. Properly signals spare equipment and parts utilization within maintenance work orders.
  • Performs monitoring physical inspection of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds for unsafe or abnormal conditions. Understands critical system alarms for single discipline(s) of equipment, their meanings, and engages with appropriate escalation processes or procedures. Recognizes circumstances where execution would be considered safe to proceed. Performs various inspections and validations of equipment performance. Monitors the performance from central monitoring locations (i.e., Facility Operations Centers) of maintenance and operations of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety) within the data center. Escalates per applicable policies and standards. Utilizes telemetry, control systems, and other platforms to monitor site status, analyze past and current events, as well as other processes, and can identify critical alarms. Advises less experienced colleagues on issues found while monitoring applicable CE systems.
Physical Requirements
  • Applies to but is not limited to US-based Data Center roles: Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting 50lbs / 22.5kg. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg. with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
Working Conditions

Overview

We are looking for a Cloud Network Engineer to join a fast-paced team responsible for designing, building, automating, and operating mission-critical network infrastructure that enables secure data transmission across isolated cloud environments. Our team supports a diverse set of technologies and challenges spanning network architecture, Layer 2/Layer 3 operations, automation, fiber infrastructure, service reliability, and large-scale distributed systems.
In this role, you will help design and automate network services that enable Azure workloads to operate in highly secure and regulated environments. You will work across the full service lifecycle, including architecture, deployment, operations, incident response, and continuous improvement. The systems you support are designed to meet rigorous security, compliance, and availability requirements for both public and private sector customers.
This role offers the opportunity to solve complex networking challenges involving routing, switching, segmentation, automation, and operational excellence while working alongside engineers responsible for some of Microsoft's most critical environments. We are seeking engineers who are passionate about customer impact, technical leadership, and building highly reliable infrastructure at scale.
At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress— people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities

 

  • Help design and implement proactive, scalable infrastructure solutions that improve reliability, optimize performance, and reduce operational complexity through automation and simplified architectures.
  • Troubleshoot complex live-site and production network issues using deep expertise in network protocols, telemetry, tools, and APIs. Drive sustainable remediation through automation and engineering improvements while minimizing customer impact. Participate in on-call rotations and mentor other engineers.
  • Contribute to incident response efforts across engineering teams, ensuring timely mitigation, thorough root cause analysis, and high-quality postmortems. Analyze historical operational data to identify recurring issues and prioritize long-term improvements.
  • Leverage operational and performance data to assess business impact, identify trends, and drive engineering decisions that improve service reliability, network performance, and customer experience.
  • Help design, deploy, and operate Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies, including switching, routing, BGP, VXLAN/EVPN, VRFs, network segmentation, 802.1X/IBNS, and highly available out-of-band (OOB) management networks.
  • Collaborate with partner teams to develop scalable, resilient, and high-performance network architectures. Independently create technical designs, implementation plans, validation strategies, and deployment procedures.
  • Help develop and maintain automation solutions for network deployment, validation, monitoring, and operational workflows to reduce manual effort, improve service availability, and enforce engineering standards within secure environments.
  • Drive operational excellence through documentation, knowledge sharing, process improvement, and continuous learning.
  • Embody our culture and values.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 2+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation

    • OR equivalent experience.

  • Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating enterprise or campus wired networks (switching and routing).
  • Experience with Layer 2 / Layer 3 networking fundamentals: VLANs, spanning tree, routing protocols (BGP), QoS, and network security.

This role demands high judgment, negotiation skills, strong analytical capability, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary, highly technical teams.

Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

 

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Silicon Manufacturing and Product Engineering (SMPE) team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

 

We are looking for a Director of package design to join the team to support our mission as a key leader of the advanced packaging design team.

Do you enjoy solving problems, writing software, and working with customers? Do you want to join a team where learning about new technology is part of our work every day? Then, come join us!
 
The Microsoft Frontier Company team is a global engineering organization that works directly with customers looking to leverage the latest technologies to address their toughest challenges.

 

We work closely with our customers’ engineers to jointly develop code for cloud-based solutions that can accelerate their organization. We work in collaboration with Microsoft product teams, partners, and open-source communities to empower our customers to do more with the cloud. This is a function being built rather than inherited, and this opportunity will allow you to shape it. You will build deep AI and industry fluency at the center of Microsoft’s most complex customer engagements, sharpen your executive influence as you shape how a global engineering organization measures and preserves the value it creates, and learn how to scale a new operating model from the ground up. En tant que Technicien(ne) de Centre de Données Microsoft (Data Center Technician – DCT), vous développerez une compréhension des processus et procédures standard liés à la préparation, l’installation, l’exécution de diagnostics, le dépannage, le remplacement et/ou la mise hors service des équipements, sous la supervision de collègues plus expérimentés du centre de données. Cette opportunité vous permettra de mieux comprendre notre environnement de centres de données, de vous familiariser avec les procédures de sécurité et de gestion des données, tout en accélérant votre évolution professionnelle. 

Les équipes Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) de Microsoft constituent le moteur qui alimente nos services cloud. En tant que DCT au sein de CO+I, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la fourniture des infrastructures fondamentales et des technologies de base soutenant les services en ligne de Microsoft, notamment Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive et la plateforme Microsoft Azure. Le groupe CO+I est fortement engagé dans le développement personnel et professionnel de ses employés et offre des formations ainsi que des opportunités d’évolution, notamment des programmes de rotation de carrière, des formations et événements sur la diversité et l’inclusion, ainsi que des certifications professionnelles. 

Notre infrastructure comprend un vaste portefeuille mondial de plus de 200 centres de données répartis dans 32 pays et comptant des millions de serveurs. Elle repose sur une équipe d’experts techniques qui soutiennent des services destinés à plus d’un milliard de clients et à 20 millions d’entreprises dans plus de 90 pays à travers le monde. 

Avec la durabilité environnementale et l’optimisation au cœur de la conception et de l’exploitation de nos centres de données, nous poursuivons notre croissance et notre évolution afin de répondre aux besoins changeants des entreprises, tout en maintenant Microsoft parmi les leaders mondiaux des fournisseurs de services cloud. 

La mission de Microsoft est de permettre à chaque personne et à chaque organisation de la planète d’accomplir davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous adoptons un état d’esprit axé sur le développement, innovons pour permettre aux autres de réussir et collaborons afin d’atteindre nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d’intégrité et de responsabilité afin de créer une culture inclusive où chacun peut s’épanouir, au travail comme au-delà. 

Ce poste nécessite des déplacements entre différents sites. Il est donc fortement recommandé de posséder un permis de conduire valide. Le poste est basé sur site et la localisation est desservie de manière limitée par les transports en commun ; disposer de son propre moyen de transport est conseillé. 

Ce poste exige une maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais à l’oral, car l’ensemble des opérations commerciales et des communications avec les parties prenantes sont menées dans ces deux langues. 

*Ce poste est basé dans le sud de Paris*



Responsibilities

  • Responsabilités 

    • Contribuer au suivi des incidents via les escalades, poser des questions et solliciter les conseils de techniciens plus expérimentés afin de garantir une résolution rapide des problèmes. 

    • Participer aux briefings quotidiens sur la sécurité, suivre les formations requises en lien avec les responsabilités du poste, notamment les formations sécurité, et respecter les procédures de sécurité (utilisation des équipements, manutention, risques électriques, utilisation des échelles et escaliers roulants). 

    • Traiter efficacement les tickets attribués conformément aux indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et aux accords de niveau de service (SLA), avec l’accompagnement d’autres techniciens. 

    • Respecter les procédures et politiques de sécurité et de gestion des données, avec le soutien d’autres techniciens, et suivre les formations de sécurité obligatoires. 

    • Maintenir une forte orientation client afin de comprendre l’impact de son travail lors du traitement des tickets et des tâches assignées. 

    • Contribuer à un environnement de travail positif et efficace en partageant les informations, en participant aux réunions d’équipe régulières, en posant des questions et en restant informé de l’avancement du travail des autres. 

    • Faire preuve de fierté et d’un fort sens des responsabilités quant à la qualité du service, à l’exhaustivité du travail effectué et à la gestion des installations du centre de données. 

    • Incarner la culture et les valeurs de Microsoft. 

 


Qualifications

Qualifications requises 

  • Diplôme de fin d’études secondaires (ou équivalent), GED, formation en apprentissage ou qualification professionnelle, ou expérience équivalente, ainsi que des connaissances de base en matériel informatique et composants informatiques. 

Exigences relatives aux vérifications d’antécédents 

La capacité à satisfaire aux exigences de contrôle de sécurité de Microsoft, de ses clients et/ou des autorités gouvernementales est requise pour ce poste. Ces exigences comprennent notamment : 

  • Vérification des antécédents Microsoft Cloud : ce poste nécessite la réussite de cette vérification lors de l’embauche ou d’une mutation interne, puis tous les deux ans. 

Qualifications souhaitées 

  • Expérience dans le support d’équipements informatiques ou de technologies connexes. 

  • Certifications pertinentes : CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+) et Basic Structured Cabling (BSC).

Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries as instructed by management.  You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

*You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.  This role requires you to be on-site and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised.   

**This role requires proficiency in conversational French and English, as all business operations and stakeholder communications are conducted in these languages.

**This role is based in South Paris**

 



Responsibilities
  • Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues.   
  • Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices. This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.
  • Develop working knowledge of stock control and inventory management practices and procedures.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of incoming and outgoing deliveries as well as records.
  • Become familiar with guidelines set by Microsoft contractual agreements with suppliers and maintain a strong customer focus.
  • Perform cycle audits and data corrections to ensure all inventory controls are met.
  • Help to reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.
  • Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.
  • Under the supervision of more experienced Data Center colleagues, destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies.
  • Comply with all security and data management policies.
  • Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma AND experience or an internship in inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field
    • OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements: 

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation
    • OR equivalent experience.

Overview

As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, recognizing safe versus unsafe work environment, having a hands-on understanding of how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities
  • Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
  • Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards.  
  • Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
  • Safely and quickly respond to and lead onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision.
  • Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
  • Under minimal oversight, perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems), correct procedures.
  • Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline.
  • Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems.  
  • Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable within Microsoft requirements.
  • Embody our culture and values


Qualifications
  • High School Diploma, or equivalent AND some experience in mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

Background Check Requirements: 

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, or equivalent AND good mission critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
    • OR Associate's Degree or technical trade certification (e.g., military, trade school), or higher-equivalent education AND experience in  mission-critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
    • OR equivalent experience.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Outside Plant Telecom Engineer.

As a Outside Plant Telecom Engineer you will design and engineer outside plant routing for MSFTs metro and longhaul connectivity requirements.  You will work with our Sourcing team, our delivery team, and our fiber providers to ensure our diversity standards are met.  This opportunity will allow you to contribute to building a world-class network infrastructure by working with Metro Dark Fiber, Long-Haul Fiber, subsea, and Lit Wave circuits. With a flexible workplace, you can work from home partially or fully and/or come to the office on an as needed basis.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Outside Plant Telecom Engineer you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities:

  • Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of datacenter activities
  • Outside Plant (OSP) optical Design, Planning and Engineering for new and existing regions
  • Communicate with all peers and departments to ensure optical designs meet Microsoft and Industry standards
  • Maintain accurate cable records and updates
  • Approving vendor designs, conducting site walks, permitting, and performing quality assurance inspections.
  • Reading and understanding highway/road prints, be able to identify conflicts with existing outside plant facilities, and select routing required for work projects.
  • Optical fiber test results analysis for Microsoft’s metro, regional fabric, and long-haul networks are delivered adhering to Microsoft Standards
  • Embody our culture and values.

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.

Overview

Are you interested in joining one of Microsoft’s most important programs for engaging customers in an inspiring environment? Are you motivated by an opportunity to shape the perceptions of senior business leaders? Are you ready to lead a world-class experience for customers, our sales teams and executives that strengthen relationships and plays a vital role in driving sales and satisfaction? You can join us as the next Customer Engagement Program Manager! 

Our Customer Engagement Team (CET) is responsible for managing a portfolio of executive-level programs and a network of state-of-art centers designed to deepen customer and partner relationships, accelerate cloud growth, and inspire through the art of the possible. 

We’re seeking a Customer Engagement Program Manager for our Experience Center Asia in Singapore. Our program engages enterprise customers and partners at our center and through digital briefings. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality briefings to leading strategic, insight-driven engagement programs that help accelerate customer outcomes, strengthen account relationships, and influence measurable business impact.  

You will work closely with global sales teams to understand our customers’ needs and design high-impact briefing agendas, bringing together the right content, speakers, and immersive experiences to delight our customers, strengthening their trust in Microsoft to increase the adoption of Microsoft’s solutions. You will do this as part of a team committed to Microsoft’s culture and an inclusive environment. This role will provide career development through visibility to the breadth of Microsoft’s solutions, executives, and global customers. 



Responsibilities
  • Apply understanding of Microsoft’s breadth solutions and customer goals, taking a consultative approach, to ensure they align with account strategy.
  • Take ownership of the end-to-end management of executive briefings in partnership with account, content, speakers, and operations teams, while prioritizing the best possible customer experience & outcomes  
  • Drive the strategy and execution of the executive briefing program to achieve the Center’s business goals.
  • Drive demand for Microsoft’s customer engagement programs with internal stakeholders and sellers, demonstrating benefits across the customer journey and for increased business impact.
  • Contribute to continuously improve our briefing programs, using business intelligence and feedback to proactively identify areas of opportunity to improve across processes and systems to increase impact.
  • Source the right speakers for the right customer engagements and topics, ensuring a healthy speaker pool is maintained to support the breadth of engagements.
  • Support inclusion of a global audience with an understanding of political, economic, and cultural norms.
  • Build strong relationships with account teams & Stakeholder management to ensure Regional alignment of go to market across industries and solution areas in order to add value to broader sales strategies
  • Intentionally leverage AI, agents, Voice of Customer signals and global best practices to reduce manual effort, increase consistency, and create more capacity for high-value customer and stakeholder work.  


Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 6+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.
  • Track record of stakeholder management and operational excellence with ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously, demonstrating resourcefulness in resolving issues, ability to prioritize, and detail orientation.  
  • Proactively manage and mitigate risks, conflict & misalignment with the customer outcomes in mind 
  • Strong interpersonal skills to work across groups from account executive to Senior Business group leaders.  
  • Foundational understanding of enterprise technology trends such as digital transformation and cloud computing and/or Microsoft’s enterprise solutions.  
  • Strong executive level communication skills - both written and verbal. 
  • Must be a self-starter who takes ownership of opportunities, sets clear direction with account teams, and deals well with ambiguity and last-minute changes. 

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 8+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 12+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

Overview

Step into a role where your ideas spark innovation and your impact is felt every day. As a Data Security Cloud Solution Architect in the Customer Success Unit, you help customers across Europe North strengthen trust in their data by designing and implementing secure cloud solutions. You work at the forefront of data security in an artificial intelligence–driven world, partnering with technical and business stakeholders to solve complex security challenges and unlock safe cloud adoption at scale.

In this role, you lead security adoption motions across seven subsidiaries, providing deep technical cybersecurity expertise on Microsoft cloud data security capabilities. You guide customers through the design and implementation of secure architectures, help them modernize and protect critical data estates, and ensure that security and compliance are embedded in every stage of their cloud journey. You drive reusable best practices and patterns that improve the scalable security posture of the Europe North area and serve as a role model for other security-focused architects and engineers.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities
  • Anticipate, identify, and translate complex customer or partner data security challenges into industry solutions that align with Microsoft cloud platform strategy, helping customers accelerate secure adoption and usage of Microsoft security and data protection capabilities.
  • Guide and mentor virtual teams and technical communities across the Customer Success Unit by role modeling technical readiness in security, resilience, and artificial intelligence–aligned scenarios, and leading upskilling activities that raise overall capability in data security architecture.
  • Proactively act as the voice of the customer, aggregating feedback and patterns across customers and industries, and presenting business cases and insights that influence product roadmaps, security features, and prioritization of fixes to improve customer outcomes.
  • Orchestrate and collaborate across Microsoft and customer teams to deliver secure, resilient, and cost‑optimized architectures, proactively identifying and mitigating technical and business risks to ensure successful deployment and long‑term adoption of data security solutions.
  • Lead strategic partner and customer opportunities in the data security space, leveraging market insights and industry trends to shape security offerings, drive consumption and usage growth, and position Microsoft solutions as trusted, innovative security platforms across Europe North.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field OR 7+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field OR 12+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND strong experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
  • strong experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external).
  • strong experience leading technical projects.
  • Technical and business level Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications, CISSP, CISM).

Overview

At Microsoft, we're empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As a Cloud Solution Architect, you'll help customers accelerate their digital transformation journey through cloud, data, analytics, AI, and modern application technologies.

This role is designed for individuals who have 2 to 4 years of experience and are passionate about technology, curious about AI, and excited to solve real business challenges using innovative solutions.

Working alongside experienced architects and technical specialists, you will build your expertise in Azure, cloud architecture, data and analytics, application development, security, and emerging AI technologies. You'll partner with customers to understand their goals, support solution design and deployment activities, and help them realize value from Microsoft's technology platform.

We're looking for someone who combines strong problem-solving skills, a growth mindset, and the ability to translate technical concepts into customer outcomes. Experience with SQL, Power BI, Python, cloud technologies, automation, APIs, and security will help you succeed in this role.

As part of Microsoft's Customer Success organization, you'll collaborate across teams, learn from industry experts, and contribute to delivering secure, scalable, and innovative cloud solutions that empower organizations to achieve more.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is excited by the future of AI and cloud technologies and wants to build hands-on experience helping customers adopt innovative solutions at scale.

Important Information

Target Start Date: November to December 2026

Please note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and we expect the recruitment process to move quickly. We encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

What You'll Bring

We're particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to learn
  • Foundational data and analytics skills using SQL, Power BI and Python
  • Cloud fundamentals, including Azure certifications or hands-on experience
  • The ability to build or automate simple solutions
  • Understanding of modern application development and APIs
  • Awareness of security, governance, and data protection principles
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • A customer and business outcome mindset
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills
  • Growth mindset and learning agility


Responsibilities

Business Impact

  • Supports team in identifying new opportunities for Consumption, Usage & Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale, based on customer business value and a clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition to empower cloud success, strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation.
  • Learns how to actively listen, respectfully challenge customers and partners, build trust, and advocate for alternative architectures, solutions, and approaches that enhance customer requirements.
  • Assists team members in identifying industry trends, gathering customer and partner insights, and mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer business outcomes.
  • Proactively captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across Microsoft to execute opportunities aligned with the Customer Engagement Model.
  • Learns how to deliver solutions in line with company methodologies, including Value-Based Deliverables (VBDs), training, technical validation, and advisory services, while following proven practices that help customers achieve operational readiness and business goals.
  • Begins to leverage change management practices and support customer deployment and long-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption and usage.
  • Supports team efforts in guiding customers toward well-architected, secure, resilient, AI-enabled, cost- and performance-optimized solutions that increase retention and expansion opportunities.
  • Supports more experienced peers in providing feedback to the Unified Delivery Team to refine and improve Value-Based Deliverables (VBDs).
  • Learns how to operate according to operational excellence standards throughout all sales stages, activities, and systems of record.
  • Supports collaboration across Microsoft and customer or partner teams to achieve business objectives and improve customer satisfaction.
  • Learns how to manage business and technical risks, adapting methodologies and applying governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize risk.
  • Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures while learning how to prioritize competing demands and align work to business priorities.
  • Learns how to identify, escalate, and mitigate blockers to accelerate solution deployment, value realization, and usage/consumption.
  • Develops business, technical, industry, and enterprise knowledge and learns how to apply it to architecture and support projects that address customer requirements and constraints.

Customer Centricity

  • Develops the capability to deliver a seamless and connected customer experience while building an understanding of customer goals and addressing customer or partner dissatisfaction.
  • Learns how to identify and translate customer and partner challenges into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft's product and platform strategy.
  • Begins to demonstrate how proposed solutions support customer outcomes and return on investment (ROI) through approaches such as proof of concepts, minimally viable products (MVPs), and rapid prototypes.
  • Learns how to help customers adopt Microsoft product and platform strategy-aligned solutions across solution areas.
  • Supports team members in building relationships with Technical Decision Makers (TDMs).
  • Learns how to act as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and strategic or technical recommendations with Engineering, Product Offerings, and internal communities.
  • Supports the identification of patterns across customers, partners, territories, and industries and contributes ideas that can be turned into actionable insights.
  • Learns how to present business cases to program managers.

Partner Specialization

  • Provides assistance to partners in identifying opportunities that align with their capabilities and revenue goals.
  • Assists partner and sales teams with opportunities through proof of concept engagements and technical pre-sales support.
  • Begins to understand solution area-specific market opportunities and contributes ideas to programmatic initiatives with support from peers and leadership.
  • Supports partners in developing offerings, practices, products, and solutions.
  • Assists partners in growing their portfolio of solutions and technical capabilities.
  • Supports the delivery of technical enablement and provides assistance during initial customer implementations.

Technical Leadership

  • Begins to leverage market insights and demand signals to identify opportunities for upskilling, accreditations, and technical readiness.
  • Develops technical readiness aligned to solution area priorities and broader Customer Success Unit (CSU) initiatives, including security, resilience, and AI.
  • Participates in team and organizational readiness activities, learning technical and non-technical concepts and proven practices.
  • Identifies delivery gaps and communicates improvement opportunities to more experienced colleagues.
  • Begins to connect patterns across business and technology areas that may drive improvements to products, intellectual property (IP), technologies, and scalable solution practices.
  • Learns structured frameworks and methodologies and may contribute to their development.
  • Participates in virtual teams (v-teams) focused on technologies and customer challenges while developing an understanding of Microsoft architectures and the competitive landscape.
  • Develops industry knowledge and contributes to presentations, materials, and engagements for internal and external audiences, including events such as Tech Connect, Build, and Ignite.
  • Learns how to contribute to Intellectual Property (IP) development and identify scalable opportunities, including Copilot and AI scenarios.
  • May participate in external technical and professional communities, conferences, seminars, meetups, webcasts, blogs, and hackathons that help strengthen the Microsoft brand and share learnings across the team.


Qualifications

Required Minimum Qualifications

Role: Principal Applied Scientist

The AI Economy Team at Microsoft is building the infrastructure that powers how organizations ground, deploy, and scale AI applications. Developers can access it through self-serve, programmatic access, and access at that scale attracts abuse. The AI Economy Trust & Safety team builds the detection behind those access decisions: verifying that customers are who they claim to be, recognizing when many accounts are one actor, and separating ordinary heavy usage from extraction, resale and automated exploitation.

You will own the detection problems behind AI Economy access decisions: establishing who is behind a new account when the evidence is thin, recognizing when accounts that look unrelated belong to one actor, drawing the line between heavy legitimate use and systematic extraction, and deciding what should return an approved account to scrutiny after it was cleared. You will work these problems hands-on from end to end, framing the problem, building the models that answer it, and taking them to production.

The work spans compute, networking, identity, certificates, monitoring, and capacity dependencies, with explicit approval, validation, and recovery controls.

You will write and review production code, define integration contracts, and work with Azure and Microsoft 365 partners to close gaps across the full buildout process. Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. The Microsoft Office of the CISO aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. 

 

The Customer Security Management Office, which is part of the Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (OCISO), is seeking a skilled and experienced Sr. Program Manager - Cybersecurity Incident Communications to join our team. 

 

This role is pivotal in managing and supporting customer-facing and other external communications related to cybersecurity incidents. During a security incident, customers need accurate information to understand the scope and impact of the issue. This role will help ensure that Microsoft can offer our customers and partners critical details about what happened, what data or services are affected, and what steps are being taken to mitigate and remediate the issue. How we communicate this guidance enables our customers and partners to make informed decisions and take necessary actions to protect their own systems and data. This role will need a background in communications, a understanding of cybersecurity, and the ability to navigate complex, high-stakes situations with confidence and clarity. 

 

This Sr. Program Manager - Cybersecurity Incident Communications will also be able to prioritize competing, time-sensitive demands and help manage a diverse set of organizational stakeholders and ensure key stakeholders are informed and aligned, while navigating and balancing the needs and expectations of different teams. Organizational skills, project management, and critical thinking skills are keys to success in this role. 

 

If you enjoy a dynamic work environment, where you will support a global team and are focused on your role as a communications professional – we’d like to learn more about you!

If you love the pursuit of excellence and are inspired by the challenges that come through driving innovations that impact how the world lives, works, and plays, then we invite you to learn more about Microsoft Operations - and the value we deliver across Microsoft, our partners, and our customers. Microsoft Enterprise Direct Services, within Microsoft Business Operations, provides direct and centralized operations services for Direct Enterprise Agreement customers to transact with Microsoft. We are accountable to design and executing transactional services across the Enterprise customer lifecycle. We relentlessly pursue process efficiency, timeliness, quality, and compliance, all while providing world class Customer experience. We are looking for team members to join our team to focused on delivering an exceptional Customer experience with deep expertise in Contracting, Order Management, Billing and Supplier Management and Customer relationship experience.

Position Description:

The Customer Operations Manager is responsible for customer-facing licensing solutions and must be a subject matter expert within our Volume Licensing concepts and processes. The Customer Operations Manager will provide direct, front line transactional support for Microsoft Field sellers and our customers. The Customer Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring adherence with the Microsoft account plan, ensuring deliverables are executed on time and of high quality for our customers. 

The Customer Operations Manager role requires fluency in both English and Japanese to effectively support our Japan-based clients and ensure smooth communication across all transactional and customer service activities. You will be expected to interact directly with Japanese-speaking customers and internal stakeholders.

The role will also provide fantastic opportunities to lead and shape next generation experiences for internal stakeholders and end customers. Are you ready to make an impact in this exciting and challenging role?



Responsibilities

Contracting and Order Management ​

  • Deal and Contract Validation: Manage the validation and execution of agreements and post sales lifecycle transactions enabling accuracy in downstream financial processes followed by compliant issuance of customer contracts in accordance with Policies, Global and SOX approved deal financials.
  • Pipeline Management: Manage critical deal lists on a monthly and quarterly basis​ in alignment with expectations with the Sales, Sales Excellence and key Subsidiary sales stakeholders on all critical deals for the month​​.

Billing Management​

  • Billing Execution: ensuring accurate and compliant order and invoice approval and dispatch (standard and local) to maximize cash flow and collectability for all invoices.​
  • Credit Approval management: including orchestration of all Finance exception approvals on high value credits and execution of all credits and associated rebills.​
  • Billing status and risk management: including tracking and communicating contract billing status to key stakeholders highlighting risks with contractual requirements, customer PO coverage, customer sign offs and credit/payment status. ​

Customer Service

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all operational customer service inquiries, concerns, and issues.
  • Oversee the daily operations of the customer service team to ensure quality standards are met and maintained.
  • Monitor customer service metrics and KPIs to identify areas of improvement and implement strategies to boost performance.
  • Handle escalated customer service issues and complaints in a professional and efficient manner.
  • Work closely with other departments to resolve customer issues and ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Develop and implement processes and procedures to streamline the customer service operation.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices to ensure the customer service team is providing the highest level of service possible.
  • Generate reports on customer service metrics and activity for senior leader consumption and monthly business reviews.

Operations Excellence: Optimization and Process improvement​

  • Acts as a thought leader to drive consistency in processes, capabilities, and services meeting performance expectations for consistency, accuracy, simplification, and timeliness of delivery​.
  • Trusted advisor for customers and internal clients on operational processes and capabilities, and provides efficient, scalable operational solutions across a portfolio of accounts​.

Stakeholder Management (Field, Partners, Customers) ​

  • Uses voice of customer frameworks and metrics to identify trends and influences across multiple customers and internal groups.


Qualifications

Required Experience/Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in Japanese, with the ability to communicate effectively with both external and internal customers/stakeholders, including writing, reading, and speaking.
  • Japanese language certifications, such as JLPT (N2 or higher), BJT, or J.TEST, are preferred to validate language proficiency in a business context.
  • 6+ years of work experience in contracting & order management, pipeline management, & billing execution, with a focus on financial accuracy, compliance, and risk management. 
  • Expertise in contract validation, pipeline management, credit approval, and billing management, with strong capabilities in customer service, stakeholder engagement, process optimization, and operations excellence.
  • Leverages AI to drive operational excellence, accelerate customer outcomes, and enable data-driven decision making.
  • Demonstrates practical application of AI tools to improve productivity, customer engagement, and business impact.
  • Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, using KPIs to monitor performance, and acting as a trusted advisor to internal and external customers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Operations, Finance or related field AND operations, program management or process management work experience
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • On site presence minimum 3 days/week.

 Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in customer service operations, managing escalations, improving service metrics, & implementing process improvements to streamline operations.
  • Experience with similar industry Business Value deal constructions.
  • Experience with Microsoft licensing concepts, including contracts, quotes and invoices, as well as evaluation and review of complex proposals, agreements, and amendments.
  • Experience providing direct support for Microsoft Volume Licensing sales and support lifecycle

As cyber-attacks grow more sophisticated, we help enterprises detect, investigate, and autonomously protect against advanced identity-based attacks and data breaches — from nation-state actors to large-scale ransomware operators. You will work closely with the Key Management team on its PQC product strategy and roadmap, while using that product work as a proving ground for the broader adoption model. Your job is to make the transition concrete: clear requirements, measurable progress, explicit owners, sequenced dependencies, and credible commitments to leadership, customers, and regulators.

The Construction Quality Manager for Johor Bahru metro will work full-time with the project teams to oversee quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes throughout the construction period. Working collaboratively with the project teams, the role will ensure that day-to-day site execution adheres to established processes and project parameters, and achieves the highest standards of performance, functionality and safety.

The role may have responsibility for overseeing quality activities across 3-4 projects/campuses simultaneously and providing leadership, coaching and technical support to site-based quality personnel to ensure consistent implementation of quality standards, processes and reporting requirements across the portfolio.



Responsibilities

Quality Support Execution

  • Manage and coordinate quality activities across 3-4 active construction sites, ensuring consistent application of Microsoft quality standards, processes and expectations.
  • Provide direction, mentoring and technical support to Site Quality Managers, Quality Engineers, and other quality personnel assigned to multiple projects/campuses within the region.
  • Drive consistency in quality reporting, inspections, audits, issue management, and lessons learned across the assigned portfolio of projects.
  • Demonstrate commitment to an Injury-Free Environment through personal actions and mentoring others, ensuring the safety programme is followed.
  • Review the General Contractor’s Project Quality Management Plan (QMP), including QA/QC procedures, inspection and test plans (ITP), and Foreign Object Debris (FOD) management plan.
  • Oversee, train and counsel project staff to ensure consistency in auditing and execution against Microsoft project quality specifications and standards.
  • Lead and manage quality-awareness promotions that enhance the quality culture and project outcomes.
  • Attend and participate in project design and construction meetings, including OAC and weekly quality meetings.

 

Collaboration with Delivery Teams

  • Foster a supportive and inclusive work environment by collaborating closely with construction, quality, commissioning, procurement, design and operations stakeholders.
  • Identify quality issues and ensure necessary modifications are made to maintain budget, schedule and scope and improve project delivery.
  • Facilitate decision-making to drive quality solutions, support schedules and manage change as required.

 

Auditing

  • Execute quality audits onsite and offsite, and ensure audit goals are met.
  • Consolidate, analyse and report key audit data regularly to demonstrate compliance and conformance.
  • Identify areas for improvement and use disciplined problem-solving techniques to recommend corrective and preventive actions for non-conformances. Improve process control through enhanced process capability and error-proofing.
  • Facilitate cross-site collaboration and sharing of best practices, lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives between project teams.

 

Performance Analysis

  • Document, analyse and evaluate project quality metrics.
  • Provide data-driven insights to support process adherence and conformance.

 

Documentation and Reporting

  • Consolidate and communicate portfolio-level quality performance, risks, trends and improvement opportunities across multiple sites to regional and corporate stakeholders.
  • Document, aggregate and report audit results, issues, lessons learned and recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing non-conformances, observations, and audit outcomes in a clear and accessible manner.
  • Support the entry of QA/QC data in the appropriate tool, issue a weekly QA/QC log, maintain quality metrics and track QA/QC items to closure as part of the QA/QC programme.

 

Compliance and Standards

  • Stay up to date with industry standards, regulations and best practices relating to construction and quality.

 

QA/QC Process Improvement

  • Continuously improve QA/QC procedures and protocols for region-wide change management.
  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies within audit and quality-control workflows.
  • Identify defects, data inconsistencies and improvement opportunities to ensure consistent quality delivery.
  • Lead and/or participate in the digitalization of construction-related processes to improve efficiency, transparency, traceability, and accountability.

 

Training and Support

  • Provide training, mentoring and technical support to Site Quality Managers, Quality Engineers and project stakeholders on QA/QC processes, specifications and best practices.

  • Demonstrated experience managing quality programmes across multiple concurrent construction projects or sites, including coordination of geographically distributed quality teams.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach and develop site-based quality personnel while maintaining consistent quality outcomes across a portfolio of projects.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft 365, BIM (Building Information Modelling), Bluebeam and relevant construction software. Proficiency in data analytics and internal reporting tools, including Power BI and other statistical inference tools.

  • Detail Oriented: Meticulous attention to specifications, governing standards and installation compliance, with commitment to high-quality results, including auditing contractor certifications.

CoreAI is at the forefront of Microsoft’s mission to redefine how software is built and experienced. The 1ES (One Engineering System) Inventory team builds the systems that help Microsoft understand what engineering assets exist, who owns them, and how they are used across the company. Our services provide foundational inventory and ownership data that powers engineering governance, security, compliance, permissions, and developer experiences across Microsoft.
 
 
A major focus of the team is Inventory-as-Code, which moves ownership and inventory metadata into source control so that changes are developer-centric, reviewable, auditable, and managed alongside the code itself. Inventory-as-Code has become a foundational dependency for security, permissions, governance, and AI-powered developer experiences across Microsoft.
 
 
The team is continuing to evolve this platform across Azure DevOps, GitHub Proxima, and other engineering environments, while expanding the Inventory-as-Code model beyond repositories to engineering assets such as pipelines.

You will work on systems that integrate with source control, CI/CD platforms, Service Tree, Product Catalog, and other engineering services to provide accurate and trustworthy ownership and classification data.
 
 
You will help evolve our Inventory-as-Code platform, building workflows that validate inventory, enforce governance policies, reconcile data across systems, and provide developers with clear and actionable experiences when inventory changes are required. The team is also developing approval and audit capabilities around sensitive ownership changes, including PR-based workflows, durable state management, telemetry, and operational recovery
 
 
You will have opportunities to solve challenging engineering problems involving distributed systems, data consistency, large-scale automation, developer tooling, security and governance, and AI-assisted engineering experiences. You will collaborate closely with partner teams across Microsoft and work directly with customers to understand their scenarios and improve the platform.

Overview

We’re looking for an experienced and driven Senior Security Engineer to join our STORM security research group and help shape the security posture of Microsoft Specialized Cloud systems from the ground up. 

As part of our mission to embed security throughout the development lifecycle, you’ll lead security design reviews, threat modeling, and architectural security assessments across a wide range of technologies, from OS internals and virtualization to cloud platforms, containerized environments, application security, and AI-enabled systems. 

This role combines deep security engineering and architecture expertise with a forward-looking approach to AI-assisted security engineering. You’ll be expected to reason deeply about complex systems and review designs hands-on, while also using and building AI-powered capabilities that make security analysis more effective, scalable, and repeatable. 

This is a high-impact role for security engineers who thrive on technical depth, enjoy building, and want to influence secure design at scale. 



Responsibilities

🔍 What You’ll Do 

  • Lead security design and architecture reviews and structured threat modeling engagements for complex systems.  

  • Analyze systems and architectures to identify trust-boundary violations, architectural vulnerabilities, unsafe assumptions, and opportunities for security-driven redesign.  

  • Partner closely with engineering and security teams to influence architecture early in the product lifecycle and guide teams toward secure design patterns.  

  • Perform security analysis using a combination of deep manual investigation and AI-augmented workflows, applying engineering judgment to validate findings and challenge assumptions.  

  • Design, prototype, and build AI-assisted security capabilities that augment design review, threat modeling, architecture analysis, vulnerability discovery, and other security engineering workflows.  

  • Experiment with new approaches for combining security expertise, automation, and AI to improve the scale, depth, and consistency of security reviews.  

  • Communicate security findings, design tradeoffs, and recommended mitigations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

  • Drive security hardening and security-driven redesign efforts that address systemic weaknesses rather than individual vulnerabilities.  

  • Help evolve our security engineering methodology, tooling, and practices as AI changes how both products and security analysis are built.  



Qualifications

  • Strong experience in security engineering, security architecture, or related technical security roles.  

  • Deep technical knowledge in one or more of the following areas:  

  • Operating system internals, including Windows/Linux, memory management, boot security, or platform security.  

  • Virtualization, confidential computing, cloud architecture, or container security.  

  • Containerized environments incl. Kubernetes and AKS 

  • Application security and secure software development across services, APIs, and distributed systems.  

  • Cloud-native security, including identity, secrets management, isolation, and service-to-service trust.  

  • Experience building with modern AI technologies to solve real engineering or security problems and designing workflows where AI augments expert analysis 

🌟 Preferred Qualifications  

  • Expertise in structured threat modeling, architectural risk analysis, and reasoning about complex systems and trust boundaries.  

  • Ability to prototype and build tools rather than only consume existing security tooling.  

  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents with existing engineering workflows, tools, data sources, or analysis pipelines.  

  • Experience applying AI to security problems such as threat modeling, design analysis, code analysis, vulnerability discovery, or security automation.  

  • Understanding of security challenges introduced by AI-enabled systems and the ability to threat-model systems incorporating AI components.  

  • Experience with scalable security analysis techniques, including static analysis, dynamic analysis, code analysis, or custom security automation.  

  • Prior expertise and experience with Azure-based solutions and services 

  • Strong understanding of secure coding and code review principles. 


    🤝     Leadership & Collaboration 

    • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility.  

    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex security issues and design tradeoffs clearly and persuasively.  

    • Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical engagements and influence engineering teams without direct authority.  

    • Analytical and curious mindset with a strong drive to understand how systems actually work.  

    • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and working on problems where neither the security answer nor the engineering solution is predetermined.  

    • Builder mindset: willing to experiment, prototype, iterate, and turn promising ideas into capabilities that other security engineers can use.  


    📈     Experience & Impact 

    • 6+ years of experience in security engineering, architecture, software engineering, or related roles.  

    • Demonstrated success leading security design reviews, threat modeling, or architectural security assessments for complex systems.  

    • Track record of identifying and helping mitigate significant architectural or system-level security weaknesses.  

    • Experience influencing engineering decisions and driving security improvements across organizational boundaries.
