Overview

Microsoft’s Corporate, External & Legal Affairs (CELA) organization supports one of the most complex commercial businesses in the world. The Global Frontline team in Customer & Partner Solutions (CPS) serves as a legal front door for Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions (MCAPS) and Microsoft Elevate, helping business clients obtain timely, practical legal support and resolving matters at the appropriate level while partnering with attorneys and subject matter experts on higher-risk or specialized issues.

 

The Legal Service Delivery Specialist is a frontline legal professional operating at the intersection of legal support, service delivery, and workflow improvement. You will serve as a primary legal contact for business clients, resolve complex matters within the team’s scope with minimal supervision, and work across CELA to identify risk, resolve issues, and deliver consistent support across regions.

 

This role offers the opportunity to help define the next generation of legal service delivery within CELA. In addition to supporting individual matters, you will help simplify recurring legal work, strengthen readiness, and develop more scalable ways to support the business. You will work with attorneys, legal professionals, and technology partners to improve workflows and responsibly use data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to increase the speed, quality, and reach of legal support.

 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 



Responsibilities

Frontline Legal Support and Client Counseling

 

  • Serve as a primary legal contact for business clients and complex questions submitted through Global Frontline intake channels. Provide practical legal support with minimal supervision, identify issues and risks, and consult with attorneys or subject matter experts as appropriate.
  • Draft, review, negotiate, and process legal and business materials and correspondence. Apply Microsoft policies and approved legal guidance to help clients move work forward while ensuring appropriate escalation and follow-through.
  • Build strong knowledge of Microsoft’s businesses, commercial priorities, CELA processes, and relevant legal frameworks, and apply regional and cultural context to deliver practical, business-focused support.
  • Manage a high volume of matters across multiple clients, priorities, and regions, exercising sound judgment regarding risk, prioritization, escalation, and resource allocation.


Service Delivery and Readiness

 

  • Identify recurring client needs, readiness gaps, and process inefficiencies. Work with attorneys and other legal professionals to develop practical guidance, playbooks, intake requirements, training, and self-service resources that allow the team to take on work deliberately and consistently.
  • Use service data and stakeholder feedback to identify trends, assess quality, and recommend improvements to Global Frontline’s scope, processes, and client experience.


Continuous Improvement and Workflow Innovation

 

  • Help redesign repeatable legal work for scale and speed. Translate legal and business needs into improved workflows and partner with legal operations, technology, and engineering teams to implement solutions.
  • Support responsible adoption of automation and AI-enabled capabilities in legal workflows, and lead or contribute to projects that help Global Frontline adopt more effective ways of working.

 



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR Paralegal Certification that meets the requirements for the location of work AND 6+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR equivalent experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years experience in program/project management.
  • 8+ years relevant in-house, legal service provider, and/or law firm experience.
  • 8+ years experience in a technology industry environment.
  • Experience supporting complex legal or compliance matters with limited supervision and exercising sound judgment regarding risk, prioritization, and escalation.
  • Experience working directly with business clients and collaborating across legal, operational, or technical teams.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Spanish-language.
  • Experience in an in-house legal department, legal service provider, law firm, compliance function, or legal operations environment.
  • Experience supporting a global organization or client population across regions and time zones.
  • Experience improving legal processes or workflows and developing scalable legal resources.
  • Experience using data, technology, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve legal service delivery.

Overview

Microsoft.com is evolving from a content publishing channel into an AI-powered decision platform and growth engine. We are looking for a Director of Growth Strategy, Operations & Experimentation to shape the strategy and operating model for priority commercial web experiences, translate business goals and customer insights into a focused portfolio roadmap, and use data, personalization, AI-assisted experiences, and experimentation to improve customer journeys and drive measurable business impact. In this role, you will lead a team responsible for portfolio strategy, annual and quarterly planning, investment and resource prioritization, business operations, and the validation of high-impact growth opportunities across Microsoft.com. You will partner with product marketing, engineering, design, analytics, finance, and business teams to develop business cases, align decisions, manage dependencies, and scale proven approaches. This role sits at the intersection of customer intent, business strategy, operations, analytics, and experimentation. This is a cross-functional leadership role with responsibility for a defined portfolio of priority customer journeys. You will bring structure to ambiguous business problems, establish clear decision rights and operating rhythms, align stakeholders around priorities and success measures, and ensure that strategy translates into coordinated execution.

 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.



Responsibilities
  • Lead growth strategy and portfolio planning: Translate Microsoft.com and business priorities into a multi-year strategy, annual and quarterly plans, an integrated portfolio roadmap, clear objectives, and measurable outcomes for priority customer journeys.
  • Drive portfolio prioritization and investment decisions: Establish criteria and governance to evaluate opportunities, sequence initiatives, allocate capacity and resources, manage trade-offs.
  • Own business operations and operating rhythms: Lead planning cycles, portfolio reviews, executive business reviews, scorecards, risk and dependency management, decision tracking, and follow-through across partner teams.
  • Develop strategic business cases and recommendations: Integrate customer, behavioral, financial, operational, and market signals to assess opportunity size, expected impact, feasibility, dependencies, and investment requirements.
  • Oversee experimentation and evidence-based validation: Establish a disciplined program for hypothesis development, intake, prioritization, test design, measurement, readouts, and responsible scaling, using experimentation as one tool to validate strategic portfolio choices.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team: Set clear goals, coach team members, build capabilities across strategy, operations, analytics, and experimentation, and foster strategic thinking, customer focus, collaboration, and accountability for outcomes.
  • Embody our Culture and Values


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 5+ years business strategy, business operations, portfolio or program management, digital growth, web strategy, experimentation, analytics, personalization, product strategy, management consulting, or related work experience 
    • OR equivalent experience.

 

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 3+ years business strategy, business operations, portfolio or program management, digital growth, web strategy, experimentation, analytics, personalization, product strategy, management consulting, or related work experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 7+ years business strategy, business operations, portfolio or program management, digital growth, web strategy, experimentation, analytics, personalization, product strategy, management consulting, or related work experience
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • Experience leading a team or function responsible for growth strategy, business operations, portfolio planning, experimentation, analytics, personalization, customer journey optimization, or performance strategy.
  • Experience translating strategy into multi-year roadmaps, annual plans, investment priorities, governance, and operating practices for complex, cross-functional programs in a large organization.
  • Experience leading executive business reviews and using customer, financial, operational, and performance data to develop recommendations and influence senior stakeholder decisions.
  • Experience implementing or scaling growth, personalization, experimentation, or portfolio operations programs in high-traffic web, Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), cloud, e-commerce, or enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience managing cross-functional dependencies, risks, resource trade-offs, and organizational change across marketing, product, engineering, analytics, finance, or business teams.
  • Experience helping teams adopt more strategic, data-driven, test-and-learn, and outcome-oriented ways of working.

The Windows Servicing & Delivery (WSD) team investigates and remediates security vulnerabilities and high-severity reliability issues across the Windows platform. The Storage & File Systems team within WSD owns NTFS, ReFS, Storage Spaces Direct (S2D), Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC), Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV), the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS), and the full Windows storage driver stack — from NVMe and iSCSI miniport drivers through to the file system minifilter layer and user-mode storage management APIs.

This Senior Software Engineer role sits at the intersection of kernel engineering and enterprise customer reliability. You will resolve the most complex ICMs escalated by top-tier enterprise and cloud customers — issues that have defeated Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and require deep ownership of source code, cluster state machines, and file system on-disk structures. Alongside security vulnerability work, you will own reliability fixes for S2D rebuild storms, CSV failover edge cases, NTFS metadata corruption, and NVMe queue-depth exhaustion scenarios that impact Fortune 500 production environments.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Own end-to-end resolution of critical ICMs escalated from top enterprise customers — analyze memory dumps, ETW traces, Storage Spaces logs, and cluster event logs to root-cause failures in S2D, WSFC, CSV, NTFS, and ReFS that cannot be resolved by field support.
  • Investigate and fix security vulnerabilities in the Windows storage stack: privilege escalation through NTFS reparse points and junctions, information disclosure via uninitialized kernel pool in file system drivers, and denial-of-service through crafted on-disk structures in ReFS or NTFS.
  • Design and implement reliability and correctness fixes in kernel-mode storage miniport drivers (StorPort, NVMe, iSCSI, SMB Direct/RDMA) and file system filter drivers — owning the full fix lifecycle from root cause through regression test to servicing release.
  • Work directly with Storage Spaces Direct (S2D): diagnose and fix rebuild, rebalance, and fault-domain logic errors; investigate cache tier promotion/demotion bugs; resolve pool fragmentation and storage bus layer (SBL) issues in hyper-converged deployments.
  • Maintain and harden Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV): resolve quorum edge cases, CSV ownership transfer failures, cluster validation regressions, and inter-node storage arbitration deadlocks.
  • Contribute to the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) and Windows Backup infrastructure: fix provider/requester interaction bugs, VSS writer timeouts in large-scale environments, and shadow copy metadata consistency failures.
  • Develop diagnostic tooling and automated regression suites for the storage stack — including kernel debugger extensions (!sdt, !storport analysis), ETW provider instrumentation, and Storage Spaces health model validation.
  • Collaborate with MSRC for coordinated disclosure and patch delivery on storage-related CVEs; participate in threat modeling and security design reviews for new file system and storage features.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and Partner Technical Advisors (PTAs) during active outages to provide expert-level guidance and expedite fix delivery through the servicing pipeline.
  • Mentor engineers; drive technical bar through code reviews, design reviews, and active participation in WSD hiring loops.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years of software engineering with deep expertise in C and C++ for Windows kernel-mode development.  .
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Windows storage driver stack: StorPort miniport drivers, storage filter drivers, or file system minifilter drivers — understanding of IRP flow, completion routines, and cancel-safe queue management.
  • Solid grounding in Windows kernel fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform crash dump analysis and live kernel debugging using WinDbg.
  • Working knowledge of NTFS on-disk structures: MFT record layout, attribute types, USN journal, and the NTFS log file for crash recovery.
  • Familiarity with ReFS (Resilient File System): B+ tree metadata structure, integrity streams, block cloning, and the differences in crash recovery model versus NTFS.
  • Experience debugging file system corruption scenarios: cross-linked clusters, orphaned MFT records, directory entry inconsistencies, and reparse point cycles.
  • Understanding of Windows file system minifilter architecture: altitude registration, pre/post operation callbacks.
  • Hands-on experience with Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC): quorum models (Node Majority, Disk Witness, Cloud Witness), cluster network configuration, and the cluster API.
  • Deep understanding of Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV): CSV file system (CSVFS) redirected vs. direct I/O modes, CSV ownership arbitration, and coordination with the Storage Bus Layer.
  • Experience with Storage Spaces Direct (S2D): storage pool creation, virtual disk provisioning, cache tier architecture (NVMe + SSD + HDD), fault domain awareness, and rebuild/rebalance behavior under node and drive failure.
  • Familiarity with storage connectivity protocols in clustered environments: SMB Direct (RDMA), iSCSI multipath (MPIO/DSM), NVMe-oF, and Fibre Channel HBA integration with StorPort.
  • Proven ability to work high-urgency customer escalations (ICMs / CritSits): triage under time pressure, communicate root cause to non-technical stakeholders, and deliver targeted fixes through the Windows servicing pipeline.
  • Experience reading and interpreting Storage Spaces diagnostic packages, cluster logs, and ETW traces (StorPort, ReFS, NTFS providers) to reconstruct failure timelines.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Support tooling: ProcMon/xperf captures, and WPA (Windows Performance Analyzer) for I/O latency profiling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Azure Stack HCI: S2D on validated hardware, stretched clustering across sites, Azure Arc integration, and software-defined storage policy management.
  • Knowledge of NVMe specification internals: submission/completion queue mechanics, NVMe error log page analysis, and namespace management — beyond just driver-level consumption.
  • Familiarity with SMB protocol internals (SMBv3): persistent handles, witness service (SWN), transparent failover, and scale-out file server (SOFS) architecture.
  • Experience with deduplication and compression engines (Windows Data Deduplication): chunk store architecture, scrubbing, and garbage collection edge cases.
  • Knowledge of Windows BitLocker full-volume encryption integration with clustered storage and its interaction with CSV and S2D volumes.
  • Published CVE credits, conference presentations, or technical blog posts on file system or storage security topics.
  • MS/BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Overview

The Microsoft 365 Routing Plane sits on the critical path for billions of requests every day and is fundamental to the scalability, reliability, economics, and security of Microsoft 365. As demand accelerates with Copilot, agentic AI, and continued cloud growth — and as the infrastructure that supports it becomes increasingly supply-constrained — the platform must continuously evolve to increase efficiency, optimize infrastructure investments, and enable the next generation of Microsoft 365 services.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own platform evolution across the Routing Plane. This is a broad role for a builder who moves fluidly from one high-impact problem to the next — taking on the biggest open challenges and, once one is resolved, flowing to the next rather than holding a single fixed area. You will partner across engineering, Azure, capacity planning, and infrastructure organizations to identify the highest-impact opportunities, shape long-term strategy, and drive platform-wide improvements that increase performance, resiliency, scalability, and cost efficiency. You will lead the efficiency strategy that keeps the Microsoft 365 Routing Plane sustainable as it grows — improving both its performance and cost efficiency, advancing Azure-native deployment models, and driving long-term COGS reduction.

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use agents, automation, and AI-driven analysis alongside standard PM tools to read telemetry, model tradeoffs, prototype solutions, and reach decisions faster. You will translate hard technical and financial tradeoffs into terms leaders can act on, and you will help move the team toward AI-forward ways of working, including evaluation sets and agent-based workflows built into how the work gets done.

You will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, data scientists, finance, and supply chain across Microsoft. The role carries broad visibility and influence, and it depends on strong product sense, technical depth, data fluency, and clear judgment under uncertainty.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy for platform evolution across the M365 Routing Plane, and turn that direction into a roadmap teams can execute.

  • Drive platform-wide efficiency — improving how much useful work the platform delivers per unit of infrastructure, and the cost of serving it — through platform optimization, Azure-native deployment models, and long-term COGS reduction.

  • Take on high-impact problems across the charter, including performance, resiliency, scalability, capacity, and platform transitions, and drive them to a result.

  • Ensure the Routing Plane can sustainably absorb new demand from Copilot, agentic AI, and continued cloud growth within a supply-constrained infrastructure environment.

  • Use AI-driven analysis of demand signals, telemetry, and operational data to forecast more accurately, catch performance and reliability issues early, and fix them at the root.

  • Use agents, automation, and AI Ops to analyze data, coordinate work, and act on what you learn.

  • Model capacity, platform, and hardware tradeoffs with AI prototyping and scenario testing before committing investment, paired with solid product, engineering, and financial judgment.

  • Weigh cost, performance, and reliability against each other, and prioritize multi-year platform investments with partners across engineering, Azure, finance, and supply chain.

  • Advance Azure-native deployment and platform transition strategy, and help the platform run more efficiently as workloads grow.

  • Set success metrics, OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), and KPIs (key performance indicators), and shape investment priorities with leadership.

  • Explain complex technical and financial tradeoffs to executives in a way that leads to decisions.

  • Mentor other product managers and move the team toward better, AI-forward ways of working.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.

 

Other Requirements:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development

  • 4+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).

Overview

エンタープライズ領域において、複数のお客様と戦略的な関係を築き、クラウド活用の推進をリードする営業職(AE：Account Executive)を募集します。

AEには重要性の高い顧客を担当いただくと共に、担当する顧客そしてインダストリー全般のデジタルトランスフォーメーションの取り組みの最前線で活躍いただきます。

候補者には、日々の営業活動やチーム全体の成長をリードするだけでなく、ロールモデルとして顧客やステークホルダーと密接にビジネスを推進していくことが期待されています。

また、お客様への付加価値の創造や課題の解決を訴求していただくために組織横断的な活動ができることも求められます。

あなたのこれまでのIT業界でのビジネスキャリアを活かし、マイクロソフトの先端かつセキュアなクラウドソリューションでお客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーション/AIトランスフォーメーションを共に推進していきましょう。



Responsibilities

顧客のビジネス上の課題を起点に、顧客および業界の情報を常に把握したうえでアカウントプランを策定し、v-team（バーチャルチーム）での実行をリードします。顧客組織の複数レイヤーにわたって関係を構築し、短期の案件成果と中長期の変革構想の両方を接続させながら、競合が容易に切り崩せないレベルの信頼関係を築きます。あわせて社内の業界スペシャリストネットワークと連携し、業界・競合・顧客の優先事項に関する知見を深め、当社の価値提案の精度を高めていきます。

 

この役割では、以下の事に責任を持ちます。

  1. エンタープライズ組織向けの営業経験を活かし、担当顧客のビジネスプランおよび実行プランを立案し、売上・利用拡大の両面でコミットした成果を出します。
  2. プランの実現に向けて社内外のリソースをオーケストレーションし、顧客にとって最適な提案とサポートを継続的に提供します。
  3. 顧客の組織構造と意思決定プロセスを把握し、意思決定者とのリレーションを構築・維持しながら、顧客の優先事項実現に向けたアドバイザーとなります。
  4. 顧客が取り組むデジタルトランスフォーメーションを、構想段階から実行・定着まで一貫して支援します。
  5. 社内v-teamのマネジメント、ソリューション営業とアカウント戦略のコーチング、複雑なソリューションの提案・クロージングを担います。
  6. リーダーシップと対人スキルを発揮し、チーム間・組織の境界を越えて周囲を動かします。役割の線引きに留まらず、拾われていない課題や機会を自ら取りに行く姿勢を求めます。
  7. 担当顧客の事業構造と経営課題を深く理解し、そこから得た示唆をチームや関連部門に還元します。

 

具体的に求められるアクション

  1. デジタルトランスフォーメーション：顧客と営業チームの前提そのものを問い直し、テクノロジーの導入にとどまらず、経営・組織運営の変革につながるアイデアを提示します。
  2. アカウントプランニング：顧客の優先事項を実現する計画と実行プランを立案し、四半期単位で進捗と軌道修正を自らドライブします。
  3. インスピレーショナルリーダーシップ：v-teamをリードし、複雑な課題に対して解決に至る道筋を明確に示します。専門性の異なるメンバーが動きやすい状態を作ることも役割のうちです。
  4. エグゼクティブプレゼンス：意思決定者レベルのエグゼクティブと対等に議論できる関係を構築し、顧客の成長計画そのものに影響を与えます。
  5. 競合環境下でのポジショニング：他ベンダーが先行している領域を含めて現実を直視し、勝ち筋を定義したうえで中長期のシェア獲得シナリオを描きます。

The Microsoft Windows Security team is looking for a learn-it-all security engineer that will help secure Microsoft Windows products and devices, with focus on offensive security and security engineering & mitigations for Windows. 

The Windows Security team is responsible for securing the Windows client and server operating systems, used by billions of customers every day and in businesses worldwide. This team performs security design reviews, code reviews, penetration testing, vulnerability research and driving systematic mitigations to security risks on Windows to make sure they meet the highest possible security standards and proactively defend cybersecurity threats. This role is hands-on, technically demanding, and central to strengthening the security posture of OS platforms. 
 
In this Security Engineer II - Windows Security role, you will uncover novel attack vectors, develop proof-of-concept mitigations, and partner directly with Windows product engineering teams to design durable & scalable defense. The candidate will have hands-on experience with native code (C/C++), penetration testing (code audit, writing fuzzers, finding creative ways to break assumptions), a clear understanding of OS security fundamentals, solid computer science skills, and a passion for keeping Microsoft customers safe. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  • Identify security vulnerabilities in a wide variety of key OS features such as network protocols, security features, and Microsoft devices Leverage a broad and current understanding of security to devise new protections.
  • Interact with the external security community and security researchers.
  • Collaborate with product teams to improve security, and articulate the business value of security investments.

    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  • 2+ years identifying vulnerabilities in operating systems and/or native (C/C++) applications. 
  • 5+ years of experience in a software engineering or security-related engineering.
  • Public track record of relevant security research, especially around vulnerability discovery. 
  • Experience exploiting bugs and bypassing security mitigations in operating systems. 
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows architecture.

Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate, high-energy engineers to help achieve that mission.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Hardware, Infrastructure Management, and Fundamentals Engineering (HIFE) team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a < Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer > to join the team.

The Manufacturing Test Engineering team collaborates with Microsoft’s product design, validation, software, supply chain, and manufacturing teams, as well as global manufacturing partners, to develop and deploy test solutions for the hardware that powers Microsoft’s cloud services. The team defines manufacturing test strategies, develops automated test hardware and software, ensures sufficient test coverage, and uses production data to improve product quality, reliability, yield, throughput, and cost.

 

In this role, you will own manufacturing test solutions from early product development and New Product Introduction (NPI) through production ramp and sustaining. You will investigate complex hardware, software, firmware, and manufacturing issues; lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions; and deliver robust, scalable, and reusable test solutions across global factory environments.

 

We are looking for a passionate, curious, and collaborative engineer with experience in server systems and manufacturing test. The candidate has a technical foundation in Compute and GPU-based AI platforms, test automation, system-level debugging, and manufacturing data analysis. You will help ensure that Microsoft’s newest cloud hardware is manufactured efficiently and delivered to customers on time and at the highest levels of quality.

 

#azurehwjobs #HIFE #SCHIE



Responsibilities
  • Develop manufacturing test hardware, software, firmware, and automation solutions to validate product and system-level functionality.
  • Define and implement robust, scalable, reusable, and adaptable test strategies covering new product introduction, mass production, repair, and sustaining operations.
  • Analyze manufacturing yield, test results, and failure trends to identify systemic hardware, software, firmware, and process issues; lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Define test coverage, test flows, equipment requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria to prevent manufacturing escapes and meet product quality goals.
  • Improve test cycle time, throughput, capacity, reliability, and cost through process simplification, automation, statistical analysis, and data-driven optimization.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators for test-system health, product quality, manufacturing yield, and operational performance.
  • Support factory deployment, qualification, readiness assessment, configuration management, bill of materials, and engineering change processes for manufacturing test systems.
  • Partner with design, validation, NPI, manufacturing, sourcing, and supplier teams to assess technical risks, resolve production issues, and ensure continuity of supply.
  • Develop and maintain test requirements, technical specifications, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and other manufacturing documentation.
  • Incorporate security, sustainability, serviceability, and reliability principles throughout the test-system lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and apply AI and machine-learning capabilities to improve test coverage, failure prediction, anomaly detection, and manufacturing intelligence.
  • Communicate technical findings, project status, risks, schedules, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and business stakeholders.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications  

  • Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; **or**
  • Master’s degree in a related field and 3+ years of experience in enterprise computing, consumer electronics, hardware test engineering, manufacturing engineering, or hyperscale supply-chain systems; **or**
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field and 4+ years of relevant industry experience; **or equivalent experience**.
  • Experience developing or deploying manufacturing test solutions for complex electronic, computing, server, networking, storage, or electromechanical products.
  • Experience with system-level debugging, failure analysis, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action processes.
  • Programming or scripting experience using languages such as Python, C#, C++, Java, or equivalent.
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing or test data using statistical methods and translating findings into engineering actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive technical projects and collaborate across engineering disciplines, suppliers, and manufacturing sites.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in English.

    

Preferred Qualifications (Desired): 

  • Doctorate and 3+ years, Master’s degree and 6+ years, or Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Experience with high-volume manufacturing, new product introduction, contract manufacturers, or global manufacturing operations.
  • Experience designing automated test equipment, fixtures, diagnostics, test frameworks, or factory data systems.
  • Knowledge of server architecture, networking, storage, power, thermal systems, firmware, or rack-level integration.
  • Experience with statistical process control, design of experiments, yield improvement, reliability engineering, or failure-mode analysis.
  • Experience using AI or machine learning for anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, failure classification, or test optimization.
  • Experience managing technical schedules, risks, engineering changes, equipment readiness, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and deliver results across teams without direct authority.

Creates mid- to long-term digital transformation roadmaps while ensuring execution of technological strategy, providing analysis of customer needs, and translating the customer business objectives to develop technology architecture. Leads industry and digital transformation acceleration to identify, create demand, and deliver customer solutions. Drives new opportunities, leads internal teams to accelerate customer digital transformation, and drive conversations regarding value of Microsoft solutions over competitors. Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft solutions. Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates internal teams and local partners to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation. Drives account planning to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Influences customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of customer, partner and Microsoft towards customer’s digital transformation. Uses existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level.



Responsibilities

Customer and Industry Insights

  • Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) in customer businesses. technology platforms, and maturity to build digital technology strategy with the customer that is aligned to business outcomes. Challenges customers’ assumptions with constructive dialogue about their business and technology. Leverages industry trends to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries.
  • Generates business insights based on knowledge of the customer's technology landscape, engagement experience, and proactive collaboration with the customer, internal teams, and industry, to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts. Challenges customers to consider alternative business models to meet business and market needs, and adapts plans to insights. Orchestrates teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Leads technical teams for driving opportunities with other teams, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.

Differentiated Value Proposition

  • Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with senior leaders including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the CIO or CIO direct-report level by researching organization charts, identifying and contacting TDMs/BDMs, and beginning to advise on solutions and position Microsoft capabilities to best meet the customer's needs. Leads new opportunities and orchestrates internal teams to accelerate the customer business transformations through digital technologies by understanding the customer industry and position, engaging with customers to lead strategic technology direction/transformation within assigned accounts, and ensuring line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., testimonials) for referencing.
  • Drives conversations with enterprise customers that present the strategic relationship between Microsoft technologies, products, and services compared with the competitor's solution and the customer's overall business goals and objectives. Provides an outside-in perspective around compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.

Education and Thought Leadership

  • Uses existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level. Contributes to innovations to accelerate meeting goals for customer capacity, maximize reach and impact, and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform. Supports customer skilling initiatives and execution.
  • Influences customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Contributes to the delivery of regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology decision-makers and technical teams.

Mapping and Account Planning

  • Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
  • Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, and determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan.
  • Drives account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates extended account teams and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.

Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration

  • Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues.
  • Identifies customer issues, creates demand, and creates opportunities to uncover new solutions. Creates and qualifies a set number of opportunities for product sales, solution sales, or consumption. Leverages partners to drive demand generation and capitalize on opportunities. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Works within a broader strategy to lead efforts with technical teams for driving opportunities including Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Contributes to efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
  • Introduces the customer to benefits of AI and Industrial Metaverse to create interest and excitement about Microsoft's capabilities and shows them how Microsoft technologies can help accelerate their productivity as well as differentiate themselves in the market. Creates follow-up opportunities and orchestrates appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue and close.

Technology Strategy Formulation

  • Creates mid- to long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) technology and business roadmaps for one or more accounts, to outline the digital transformation journey and core wins. Updates and articulates business changes in the roadmaps around foundational, traditional capabilities. Builds technical engagement or enablement plan, captures baseline, and drives envisioning to support mid- to long-term business plans. Discusses the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders. Translates an understanding of the customer's business objectives and scenarios in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays to develop technology architecture. Ensures that developed architecture influences cloud journey to position all Microsoft clouds and drives consumption, usage, and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
  • Ensures execution of technology strategy and/or digital transformation by identifying and resolving technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation and driving technology adoption.
  • Provides analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and potential blockers. Leverages understanding of business strategies and outcomes that technology can support to advise on gaps that would benefit from Microsoft solutions, and guides internal teams in overall strategy development (e.g., block identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end solutions.

Trusted Advisor

  • Proactively builds and maintains a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy in the industry of assigned accounts, as well as of the business priorities and potential threats the customers face. Leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Coordinates with internal industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts) to gather industry data of assigned accounts and leverages knowledge of competitors to improve planning. Demonstrates a strong understanding of the customer's business strategy and the direction of the industry.
  • Leverages account information technology (IT), industry, and business strategy to provide coaching to internal Microsoft teams on customer technology profiles and strategies. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge.
  • Advises customer technical decision maker (TDM) and business decision maker (BDM) stakeholders on the benefits of embedding security throughout their technology landscape through the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives. Establishes a sense of creating business value through implementing security and positions Microsoft's security credentials. Creates follow-up opportunities and orchestrates appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue and close.

Overview

 

Windows の根本部分を理解し、複雑な技術課題を AI を活用しながら解き明かす仕事に挑戦しませんか。 

Microsoft Customer Service & Support の Technical Support Engineer は、単に既知の解決策を案内する役割ではありません。お客様のシステムで発生する複雑な問題に対して、ログ、メモリダンプ、トレース、ソースコードや公開情報などを活用し、仮説を立て、検証を重ねながら根本原因と最適な解決策を導き出すエンジニアリングロールです。 

Windows OS、デバイス、展開、更新、パフォーマンス、仮想デスクトップなどの幅広い技術に向き合い、必要に応じて国内外のエンジニアや Microsoft の製品開発チームと連携します。そこで得られた知見は、一件のお客様対応にとどまらず、製品改善、ナレッジ、診断ツール、自動化へと還元されます。 

私たちは、AI をエンジニアの専門性を拡張する重要な手段と捉えています。AI を活用した情報整理、調査支援、ログ分析、スクリプト作成、ナレッジ生成などを進める一方で、出力を鵜呑みにせず、技術的な正確性、セキュリティ、プライバシー、Responsible AI の観点から検証できる判断力を重視します。 

Windows の経験がすべて揃っている必要はありません。未知の技術を楽しみ、自ら学び、試し、周囲と知識を共有しながら成長できる方を歓迎します。 

このポジションで得られる経験 

  • Windows のアーキテクチャや内部動作に関する深い知識 

  • ログ、イベント、トレース、メモリダンプなどを用いた体系的なトラブルシューティング 

  • 大規模かつミッションクリティカルな環境における実践的な問題解決 

  • Microsoft の国内外のエンジニアおよび製品開発チームとの協業 

  • AI、スクリプティング、自動化を活用したエンジニアリングプロセスの改善 

  • 技術文書、ナレッジ、ツールを通じて、個人の知見を組織の能力に変える経験 

  • 技術スペシャリスト、エスカレーションエンジニア、テクニカルリード、マネージャーなどへの多様なキャリアパス 



Responsibilities

 

複雑な技術課題の解決 

  • お客様のビジネスへの影響と技術的な事象を正確に把握し、問題解決まで一貫してオーナーシップを持ちます。 

  • 仮説の設定、データ収集、再現環境の構築、実験、ログやダンプの解析を通じて、根本原因を特定します。 

  • 回避策、復旧方法、恒久対策を整理し、お客様の環境とビジネス要件に適した解決策を提案します。 

  • 高い緊急度や複雑性を持つ問題について、国内外の専門エンジニアや製品開発チームと連携します。 

エンジニアリングによる改善 

  • 繰り返し発生する問題からパターンを見つけ、診断手順、ツール、ナレッジ、自動化などの改善につなげます。 

  • 調査によって得た技術的知見やお客様のフィードバックを製品開発チームへ共有し、Microsoft 製品とサービスの改善に貢献します。 

  • 技術文書、社内外のナレッジ、勉強会、メンタリングを通じて、チーム全体の技術力向上に貢献します。 

AI を活用したサポートエンジニアリング 

  • AI を調査、情報整理、データ分析、コードやスクリプトの作成、ナレッジ生成などに活用し、問題解決の質とスピードを高めます。 

  • AI が生成した内容を、一次情報、実際のログ、再現結果などに基づいて検証します。 

  • セキュリティ、プライバシー、機密情報の取り扱い、Responsible AI の原則を守りながら、安全な活用方法をチームに展開します。 

  • 新しい AI 技術やツールを継続的に学び、実務でのユースケースを見つけ、試行と改善を進めます。 

お客様およびチームとの協働 

  • 複雑な技術情報を、お客様の役割や理解度に応じて明確に説明します。 

  • 調査状況、次のアクション、リスクを適切に共有し、お客様との信頼関係を築きます。 

  • 他者の視点を尊重し、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーと協力して成果を生み出します。 

  • 自分だけで問題を抱え込まず、適切なタイミングで助けを求めるとともに、他のメンバーを積極的に支援します。

入社後は、体系的なオンボーディング、技術トレーニング、1 対 1 のメンター制度を通じて、担当領域の専門性を段階的に身につけます。 

Microsoft Learn、社内技術コミュニティ、検証環境、国内外のエンジニアとの協働など、継続的に学ぶための機会があります。学習するだけでなく、実務で試し、振り返り、ナレッジやツールとして共有することを大切にしています。 

将来的には、シニアサポートエンジニア、サポートエスカレーションエンジニア、製品開発と連携する専門職、テクニカルリード、マネージャーなど、専門性と志向に応じたキャリアを目指せます。

Overview

 

世界中の企業で利用されている Active Directory や認証基盤の内部動作を深く理解し、お客様が直面する最も複雑な技術課題を解決する仕事です。 
障害の原因がネットワークなのか、認証なのか、セキュリティなのか、製品の実装なのか。仮説を立てながら真相を追いかける、まるで技術者向けの探偵のような役割です。 

Microsoft Customer Service & Support （CSS） の Technical Support Engineer は、単に既知の解決策を案内する役割ではありません。お客様のシステムで発生する複雑な技術課題に対して、ログ、ネットワークトレース、イベント、構成情報、プロトコル仕様などを活用し、仮説と検証を重ねながら根本原因と最適な解決策を導き出します。 

また、 Technical Support Engineer の魅力は、「常に最先端の技術に触れ、学ぶことができる環境が整っていること」です。純粋に技術を追求し、国内のみならず世界における製品の第一人者になれる、非常に魅力的な職種です。 

 

CSS の Active Directory Services チームは、Active Directory、認証、グループポリシー、PKI、Hybrid Identity など、企業の ID 管理とセキュリティを支える中核技術を担当します。 

これらの技術は、ユーザーがシステムへサインインする、複数の拠点でディレクトリ情報を同期する、アプリケーションやサービスへ安全にアクセスする、証明書を利用して通信やデータを保護するといった、多くの企業活動の基盤となっています。 

問題の解決には、Windows Server、ネットワーク、セキュリティ、クラウドサービスなど、複数の技術領域を横断した調査が必要です。必要に応じて、国内外の専門エンジニアや Microsoft の製品開発チームと連携し、お客様のミッションクリティカルな環境を支援します。 

また、私たちは AI をエンジニアの専門性を拡張する重要な手段と捉えています。AIを活用した情報整理、ナレッジ検索、ログ分析、スクリプト作成、ケース履歴の要約、ナレッジ生成などを業務プロセスに取り入れています。一方で、AIの出力をそのまま利用するのではなく、実際のログ、一次情報、再現結果に基づいて検証し、技術的に正しい判断を行うことを重視します。 

Active Directory Services に関するすべての経験が、応募時点で揃っている必要はありません。未知の技術に興味を持ち、自ら調べ、試し、周囲と知識を共有しながら成長できる方を歓迎します。 

このポジションで得られる経験 

  • Active Directory の設計、運用、レプリケーション、障害復旧に関する深い知識 

  • Kerberos、NTLM、LDAPなど、Windows の認証プロトコルに関する実践的な理解 

  • ドメイン、フォレスト、信頼関係、アクセス許可など、企業のID管理基盤に関する専門性 

  • Group Policyを利用した、大規模なWindows環境の構成管理に関する知識 

  • AD CS、証明書、TLS/SSLなど、PKIとセキュリティ基盤に関する実践経験 

  • Windows Hello for Business、FIDO2、WAMなど、Hybrid Identityに関連する技術経験 

  • ログ、イベント、ネットワークトレース、プロトコル解析を用いた体系的なトラブルシューティング 

  • 大規模かつミッションクリティカルな環境における問題解決 

  • Microsoftの国内外のエンジニアおよび製品開発チームとの協業 

  • AI、PowerShell、スクリプティング、自動化を活用したサポートプロセスの改善 

  • 技術文書、ナレッジ、ツールを通じて、個人の知見をチームの能力へ変える経験 

  • 技術スペシャリスト、エスカレーションエンジニア、テクニカルリード、マネージャーなどへの多様なキャリアパス 



Responsibilities

 

複雑な技術課題の解決 

  • お客様のビジネスへの影響と技術的な事象を正確に把握し、問題解決まで一貫してオーナーシップを持ちます。 

  • 事実と仮説を整理し、必要なデータ、ログ、イベント、ネットワークトレース、構成情報を特定します。 

  • 検証環境での再現、構成比較、ログ解析、プロトコル解析などを通じて、問題を体系的に切り分けます。 

  • 回避策、復旧方法、恒久対策を整理し、お客様の環境とビジネス要件に適した解決策を提案します。 

  • 高い緊急度や複雑性を持つ問題について、国内外の専門エンジニアや製品開発チームと連携します。 

  • 調査の進捗、確認結果、次のアクション、技術的なリスクを分かりやすくお客様へ説明します。 

エンジニアリングによる改善 

  • 繰り返し発生する問題からパターンを見つけ、診断手順、ツール、ナレッジ、自動化などの改善につなげます。 

  • 調査で得られた技術的知見やお客様からのフィードバックを製品開発チームへ共有し、Microsoft製品とサービスの改善に貢献します。 

  • PowerShellなどを活用して、情報収集、解析、診断を効率化します。 

  • 技術文書、社内外のナレッジ、勉強会、ケースレビュー、メンタリングを通じて、チーム全体の技術力向上に貢献します。 

  • 自分が担当した問題の解決だけでなく、将来同じ問題が発生した際に、より速く解決できる仕組みを考えます。 

AIを活用したサポートエンジニアリング 

  • AIを調査、情報整理、ナレッジ検索、ログ分析、スクリプト作成、ケース履歴の要約、ナレッジ生成などに活用します。 

  • AIが生成した内容を、一次情報、製品ドキュメント、実際のログ、再現結果などに基づいて検証します。 

  • AIを活用できる業務プロセスを見つけ、チームで共有できるプロンプト、ツール、エージェント、標準手順などへ発展させます。 

  • セキュリティ、プライバシー、機密情報の取り扱い、Responsible AIの原則を守りながら、安全な活用方法をチームへ展開します。 

  • 新しいAI技術やツールを継続的に学び、実務で試行し、結果を評価しながら改善を進めます。 

お客様およびチームとの協働 

  • 複雑な技術情報を、お客様の役割、技術的背景、理解度に応じて明確に説明します。 

  • 調査状況、次のアクション、想定されるリスクを適切なタイミングで共有し、お客様との信頼関係を築きます。 

  • Windows、Azure、Microsoft 365、セキュリティなど、関連する製品チームと協力して問題解決を進めます。 

  • 他者の視点を尊重し、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーと協力して成果を生み出します。 

  • 自分だけで問題を抱え込まず、適切なタイミングで支援を求めるとともに、他のメンバーを積極的に支援します。 

  • 自分の経験や失敗から得た学びを共有し、チーム全体が成長できる環境づくりに貢献します。

Learning and Career Growth 

入社後は、体系的なオンボーディング、技術トレーニング、メンタリング、ケースレビューなどを通じて、担当領域の専門性を段階的に身につけます。 

最初からすべての技術領域を一人で担当することはありません。既存のナレッジ、検証環境、技術コミュニティ、チーム内の相談チャネルを活用しながら、実際の問題解決を通じて経験を積んでいきます。 

Microsoft Learn、社内技術コミュニティ、国内外のエンジニアとの協働など、継続的に学ぶための機会があります。学習するだけでなく、実務で試し、振り返り、得られた知見をナレッジやツールとして共有することを大切にしています。 

将来的には、シニアサポートエンジニア、サポートエスカレーションエンジニア、製品開発チームと連携する技術専門職、テクニカルアドバイザー、テクニカルリード、マネージャーなど、専門性と志向に応じたキャリアを目指すことができます。 

 

Work Environment 

私たちは、個々の事情やライフステージを尊重し、チームで支え合う文化を大切にしています。チームには、多様な職務経験、専門性、国籍、文化的背景を持つメンバーが在籍し、それぞれの強みを活かして協働しています。 

難しいケースを一人で抱え込むのではなく、相談チャネル、チームミーティング、技術レビューなどを通じて、メンバー同士で支援しながら問題解決を進めます。技術的な質問や異なる意見を歓迎し、互いの知識と経験から学ぶことを重視しています。 

オフィスは品川を拠点としています。オフィス勤務ももちろん可能ですが、リモート+オフィス勤務のハイブリットスタイルも含めた柔軟な勤務スタイルが選択可能です。

Manager Message 

Active Directory Servicesは、普段は目に見えにくい技術ですが、企業のIT環境を支える非常に重要な基盤です。 

ユーザーが安全にサインインできること、必要なシステムへアクセスできること、複数の拠点やサービスが正しく連携すること。その一つひとつの背後には、Active Directory、認証、Group Policy、証明書など、Directory Servicesチームが担当する技術があります。 

私たちが探しているのは、すでにすべての答えを知っている人ではありません。 

難しい問題に出会ったときに、「分からない」で止まるのではなく、何が分かっていて、何が分かっていないのかを整理し、必要な情報を集め、次の一手を考えられる方です。 

新しい技術やAIを積極的に試しながらも、結果を自ら検証し、お客様に対して責任ある判断ができる方を歓迎します。 

このチームには、Active Directory Servicesに関する深い専門知識を持つエンジニアと、互いの成功を支援する文化があります。技術への好奇心、お客様への情熱、そして成長への意欲を持つ方と一緒に、企業のIDとセキュリティを支える、より良いサポートエンジニアリングをつくっていきたいと考えています。

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues.  This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

 

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

 

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities
  • Perform diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Perform post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommission hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follow procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.

Overview

Microsoft Commerce is building the shopping layer that spans Copilot, Bing, Edge, and partner surfaces — from the moment a shopper forms an intent, through discovery and comparison, to checkout and the experience that follows it. As shopping moves from browsing pages to conversational and agentic interaction, the patterns that govern it are largely unsettled.

We are seeking a design leader to own that experience and to lead the team that delivers it. The role is accountable for design quality, cross-surface coherence, and the development of the Commerce Design, Research & Content team. It reports to the VP of Product for Commerce and operates as a peer to the product pillar leads.

The central problem is trust. A shopper expresses intent in conversation, evaluates options they did not browse for, and acts on a recommendation they did not search for. Defining how those interactions work — and what earns confidence when a system acts on someone's behalf — is the substance of the job.

The successful candidate will have led design organizations in areas without established precedent, and will be equally effective directing design craft, developing managers, and representing design among senior product and engineering leadership.

The Product Design Director will own design for Commerce end to end. Commerce UX on Copilot covers the conversational shopping experience — how a shopper expresses and refines intent, how products are represented in dialogue, and how a purchase completes without leaving the conversation. Commerce UX on Bing covers shopping within search: vertical results, generative shopping experiences, product detail, and the discovery patterns that convert high-intent search traffic. Commerce UX on Edge and Checkout covers the browser shopping surface and the checkout flow itself, including native checkout, wallet, and the payment moments that determine whether a shopper completes or abandons. Special projects covers pitch work, partner-facing concepts, and the exploratory design that shapes where Commerce goes next. The team spans three disciplines. Product design owns the interaction and visual design of these surfaces. Content design owns the language of the shopping experience — the terminology, guidance, and conversational copy through which an agentic surface communicates with a shopper. User research is embedded within the organization and provides the evidence base for design decisions across all of these areas.

Success Measures

  • A coherent Commerce shopping experience across Copilot, Bing, and Edge that presents as a single product rather than three separate ones.
  • Established, documented interaction patterns for agentic commerce that other teams adopt.
  • Measurable improvement in shopping engagement and conversion attributable to experience quality.
  • Design patterns and standards that are adopted by partner teams building on Commerce surfaces.
  • A design team that grows in capability and retains its talent, with managers capable of leading independently.
  • Design credibility with product and engineering peers, evidenced by design influencing the roadmap rather than responding to it.

  • Design the shopping experience for an agentic era: goal expression, guided discovery, recommendation, comparison, approvals, transparency, confidence, recovery, and purchase — establishing the interaction patterns where no settled conventions exist.
  • Partner as a peer with the product pillar leads for Consumer, Core Experiences, Business Enablement, and Platform, and represent design in roadmap and prioritization decisions.

EMEA – Frontier Industry Advisor – Banking (the Netherlands)

Are you passionate about banking industry transformation for the Frontier AI era? Banking is undergoing a fundamental shift in how institutions grow, operate, manage risk, meet regulatory expectations, and serve customers. Banks are moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale transformation, reshaping customer engagement, relationship management, lending, payments, deposits, treasury services, fraud and financial crime, credit and risk decisioning, compliance, operations, and core banking modernization. By applying trustworthy, secure, scalable AI, Microsoft is helping banks reimagine their businesses from outcomes inward—using breakthrough technologies to simplify operations, improve decision quality, strengthen resilience, deepen customer trust, and unlock new sources of growth. Microsoft’s Frontier Industry Advisory team is at the heart of that innovation, working directly with banking business leaders to rewrite the playbook in light of disruption while staying grounded in the mission and business objectives of the industry. 

Across EMEA, banks are navigating a distinctive regulatory and market environment—spanning the EU AI Act, GDPR, the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), PSD2/PSD3 and open banking, and the Basel and MiFID II frameworks—alongside supervisory expectations from the European Central Bank, national regulators, and the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA). This role brings that regional context to how Microsoft helps banks scale trustworthy AI. 

As a Frontier Industry Advisor on the EMEA Frontier Banking Industry team, you will help Microsoft’s most strategic banking customers define and execute AI-led transformation agendas. This role is responsible for originating industry-led business opportunities and executive conversations that connect business outcomes to Microsoft cloud, data, AI, security, and partner capabilities. You will be the banking industry subject matter expert engaging with senior business decision makers to identify, generate, and nurture transformational opportunities. You will go deep with select customers to help them move beyond isolated pilots toward governed, scalable AI adoption that delivers enterprise outcomes such as profitable growth, improved operating leverage, faster and more trusted credit decisioning, stronger fraud and financial crime controls, better customer and banker experiences, operational resilience, and regulatory confidence. You will also develop Microsoft’s frontier banking practice through thought leadership, targeted customer engagements, and strategic planning with Microsoft’s account teams and industry leadership. 

A defining element of Microsoft’s Frontier Company strategy is Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)—multidisciplinary, AI-accelerated engineering teams that embed with customers to co-build and productionize AI and agent solutions. As an Industry Advisor, you are a primary originator of FDE opportunities: you identify where embedded engineering can move a bank from AI ambition and isolated pilots to production-grade outcomes, and you partner closely with FDE teams and the account team to turn industry vision into deployed business value.

Responsibilities 

Planning and Engagement

Provides thought leadership via focus on broad global industry trends to evangelize worldwide industry strategies and/or large ecosystem plays into local market and/or must-win accounts. Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first APIs, including the Work IQ API, CLI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, while respecting Microsoft Graph permissions, tenant policies, and compliance boundaries.

We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot extensibility engineering team, are looking for a Principal Product Manager for Work IQ whose primary product focus is evaluation — the load-bearing quality gate of the Work IQ agent developer lifecycle. Evaluation is where an agent earns the right to ship: it spans the committed eval suite and its correspondence to the success criteria declared at scoping, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage against the response playbook, and the advisory-board sign-off that governs what customers actually receive. You will own that gate end to end — including A/B testing with BizChat, the feedback loop from production signals back into the suite, and post-release drift detection — and you will make it fast, evidence-rich, and continuous rather than a milestone event.

This role is deliberately an AI-native transformation role, and it maps directly to the two M365 core priorities. On Changing the Way We Work, you are expected to redesign the lifecycle itself rather than staff it: apply an agentic loop approach to the evaluation stage so that evidence assembly, failure classification, remediation drafting, and drift detection run zero-touch, while accountable judgment — quality-gate sign-off, accepting a known failure into production, tenant admin consent, and any irreversible or externally visible action — stays with a named human by design. On Leading with New AI Products, you will dogfood Work IQ’s own surfaces to build those loops, so the platform team experiences its activation, evaluation, and metering surfaces as a developer does, and feeds that evidence straight back into the roadmap.

We are looking for a growth mindset and thought leadership measured in outcomes, not mechanism: human involvements per agent shipped trending toward zero for removable coordination toil, a rising acceptance rate for the loops’ recommendations, shrinking time from eval failure to resolution, a growing share of drift found by the platform before a customer reports it, and an absolute bar of no agent-caused false gate pass. You will set the point of view, publish it, and bring partner teams along.

This is a platform PM role at the intersection of Copilot, agents, Graph, and enterprise trust.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Evaluation & Quality — Primary Focus

  • Own the evaluation stage end to end: the eval suite and its baseline, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage, and the advisory-board quality gate.

  • Make evaluation continuous rather than a milestone, keep each agent’s eval suite in correspondence with its declared success criteria, and run A/B testing with BizChat plus post-release drift detection.

  • Protect the trust boundary: gate sign-off, accepting a known failure, and admin consent stay accountable human decisions, and every gate decision stays auditable.

AI-Native Transformation & Thought Leadership

  • Changing the Way We Work: apply an agentic loop approach to evaluation so evidence assembly, failure triage, and drift detection run zero-touch — while irreversible or customer-visible decisions stay human.

  • Leading with New AI Products: dogfood Work IQ’s own surfaces to build those loops, and turn that developer experience into platform investments.

  • Lead with outcomes and a published point of view: less human effort per agent shipped, faster resolution of eval failures, drift caught before customers see it — and never a false gate pass.

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for the focused Work IQ areas serving for the core Copilot extensibility

  • Clarify what Work IQ focus areas provide vs. what is handled by Copilot Chat, Microsoft Graph, or agent frameworks

  • Translate customer, partner, and internal agent scenarios into clear engineering investments and priorities

  • Make evaluation a first-class product surface, not an internal process: define what the platform owes developers in eval tooling, evidence, and quality signals, and decide how much of it extends to third-party developers versus first-party and contributing teams.

You'll provide proactive guidance, technical advocacy, and crisis leadership to help customers maximize their Microsoft Security investments, strengthen operational excellence, and collaborate seamlessly across Microsoft. This is a deeply technical, customer-focused, and relationship-driven role. 

 

Candidates may bring relevant experience from consulting, enterprise architecture, technical account management, cloud architecture, or other customer-facing technical security roles, along with experience managing complex, time-sensitive, and high-visibility situations and driving customer outcomes through engineering-led support. 

 

We're not just looking for someone who can do this job well; we're seeking someone who will improve how we do it. In your first year, success looks like customers who escalate less because their environments are healthier, and at least one change you drove that enhanced how the whole team works. 

 

This role supports flexible work arrangements consistent with Microsoft policies, customer commitments, and business needs. Microsoft Azure’s Artificial Intelligence and High‑Performance Computing (AI/HPC) organization powers some of the world’s largest cloud‑native supercomputers used for frontier AI training, scientific computing, and large‑scale distributed simulations. Our team builds and operates hyperscale GPU clusters that consistently place Azure among global leaders in the Top500, MLPerf, and Graph500 benchmarks. By joining us, you step into the engineering core responsible for ensuring these systems remain reliable, performant, and ready for the next wave of AI innovation.

At this supercomputing scale, reliability and operational excellence are engineering challenges of their own. As a Senior Supercomputing Operations Engineer, you will own day‑to‑day operations of GPU interconnect fabrics and treating them as a single, mission‑critical reliability domain that directly impacts GPU availability, training throughput, and customer SLAs. You will lead incident triage and mitigation, debug complex fabric‑layer failures, and correlate telemetry across nodes, switches, SM behavior, and GPU subsystems to identify true root causes. Your work will focus on resolving real production incidents at scale, improving operational readiness, and preventing recurrence through better tooling, automation, and deep systems understanding.


You will build and use state‑of‑the‑art tools to detect issues proactively, close operational gaps, and improve observability across our fabrics. You will contribute to TSGs, operational playbooks, and escalation guides while partnering with internal engineering teams and industry leading manufacturers to drive meaningful fixes. At this scale, interconnect fabrics are a first order reliability system that directly determines GPU availability, training throughput, and customer SLAs. As a Principal Supercomputing Operations Engineer, you serve as the technical authority and strategic owner for interconnect fabric operations across flagship AI supercomputing environments. You will lead the most complex and impactful fabric related incidents, making high stakes technical decisions under ambiguity while balancing availability, risk, long term correctness, and customer impact. Beyond resolving incidents, you define failure models, operational strategy, and systemic prevention mechanisms that reduce recurrence at fleet scale. Your impact multiplies through technical leadership: setting operational standards, influencing engineering direction across teams, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering deeply with platform, hardware, firmware, and service teams to drive durable reliability improvements.

You will architect and drive automation, diagnostics, and telemetry that materially improve operability and debuggability of interconnect fabrics, and author authoritative playbooks, TSGs, and escalation models relied on across the organization. Through your judgment, designs, and operational strategy, Azure’s largest AI platforms scale safely, predictably, and sustainably to meet the demands of next generation AI workloads.

Overview
 

The Windows Ecosystem and Commercial Engagement team (WECE) sits at the center of how Microsoft brings the full power of Windows to life across a global ecosystem of partners, customers, and engineering teams. Our mission is to transform strategic priorities into real-world innovation—connecting technology, insight, and collaboration so Windows continues to deliver outstanding experiences on every device. Within WECE, Hardware Engineering Enablement (HEE) accelerates the integration of modern hardware capabilities into Windows PCs and provides the tools, guidance, and engineering partnership that elevate device quality, performance, efficiency, and user delight across the ecosystem. 

Power efficiency and battery life are fundamental to every Windows device—they shape how customers work, create, connect, and experience mobility every day. The Windows Assessment Toolkit (WAT), part of the Windows Assessment and Deployment Kit (ADK), is the trusted measurement platform that OEMs, silicon partners, and retailers rely on to evaluate energy efficiency and bring high-quality devices to market. Our team owns the power and battery-life assessments that turn Microsoft’s measurement approach into a credible, scalable ecosystem practice. We are looking for a self-motivated, innovative, and accountable Software Engineer II to help evolve the next generation of power and energy-efficiency assessments within WAT. In this role, you will collaborate across Microsoft to enable high-quality, delightful PC experiences with outstanding battery life, while applying advances in AI and data to make the toolkit smarter, more reliable, and more impactful for the entire Windows ecosystem. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  



Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated assessment solutions that measure battery life, energy consumption, and power efficiency across Windows devices.
  • Own the accuracy, reliability, and repeatability of energy-efficiency measurements across test cycles, hardware platforms, and product releases.
  • Define and evolve methodologies, metrics, and validation approaches used to evaluate power-related user experiences.
  • Build automation frameworks and deployment mechanisms that simplify execution and maintenance of assessment workloads.
  • Analyze power-consumption patterns and energy-related system behavior to identify opportunities for measurement improvements and ecosystem alignment.
  • Collaborate with hardware, silicon, OEM, and platform engineering teams to improve energy-efficiency evaluation and validation practices.
  • Deliver secure, maintainable, production-quality software that meets engineering, compliance, and release requirements.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and contribute to engineering excellence practices, code quality, and knowledge sharing.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
      • OR equivalent experience.
  • Solid understanding of power management and measurement, sleep and power-state transitions, and device/driver behavior.
  • Outstanding troubleshooting skills, especially for Windows debugging.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on features with minimal supervision and diagnose non-deterministic or flaky measurement results.
  • Outstanding communication, collaboration, and presentation skills in Mandarin and English. 

 

Additional / Preferred Qualification

  • Hands-on experience with ETW tracing and the Windows Performance Toolkit (WPR/WPA); familiarity with ADK/WAT.
  • Good understanding of Windows OS internals relevant to power (power management, sleep/Modern Standby, device/driver behavior).
  • Familiarity with energy-efficiency validation concepts and battery-life goals for Windows devices.
  • Experience with CI/CD, code signing, and secure-by-default engineering practices.
  • Good command of AI tools and data analytical skills.
  • Prior collaboration with OEM/IHV partners.
